United States

This position is not eligible for employer sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work and must not require employer sponsorship.

Location:

2727 N Central Ave, Phoenix, Arizona 85004 United States of America

Part-Time - Live Verify Phone Agent (Remote)


Important: Please complete your application on the same computer you intend to use for work. The application includes required compatibility testing and is not mobile-friendly.


Agents support U-Haul's TruckShare 24/7 program by reviewing customer information, IDs, and selfies to approve rentals and help prevent fraud. This is a phone-focused customer service role that includes inbound/outbound calls, customer chats, and verification sessions in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. Successful agents can multitask, navigate multiple systems, identify potential fraud concerns, and deliver excellent customer service while assisting multiple customers simultaneously. Candidates should be able to effectively manage stress, remain adaptable, and maintain performance standards in a fast-paced environment.


Essential Functions

  • Review customer information and verification documents
  • Verify identity and rental eligibility
  • Handle inbound and outbound customer calls
  • Support customers through phone, chat, and online verification tools
  • Document customer interactions and verification outcomes
  • Meet quality, accuracy, and productivity standards

Requirements

  • 1+ year of customer service experience (high-volume phone experience preferred)
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and multitasking skills
  • Comfortable navigating multiple systems simultaneously
  • Strong attention to detail and decision-making abilities
  • Reliable attendance and punctuality

Pay & Benefits

  • Starting pay: $16/hour
  • Growth opportunities up to $19/hour within 6-9 months based on performance and attendance
  • Eligible bilingual agents may earn $18/hour after passing bilingual assessments
  • Comprehensive part-time benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Rx Savings, and 401(k)

Availability Requirements

  • Minimum 25 hours of availability per week
  • Must be available to work Saturday and Sunday (6 consecutive hours each day)
  • Must be available Friday, Saturday, and Sunday
  • Schedule commitment required for the first 6 months
  • Holiday availability required
  • Hours and schedules vary based on business needs

Current Priority Shifts (Arizona Time)

  • 5:00 PM - 11:00 PM AZ
  • 1:00 PM - 7:00 PM AZ
  • 3:00 AM - 9:00 AM AZ (limited need)

Education Program

  • Virtual Instructor-led education followed by hands-on experience and ongoing coaching
  • Phone calls are introduced early in education
  • Full 90-day training commitment required
  • Consistent attendance, camera on participation, and professionalism are essential

Current Education Class

  • Start Date: 10/27/2026
  • Schedule: 2 weeks: Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday, Saturday & Sunday
  • Hours: 8:00 AM - 2:00 PM (Arizona Time)

Work-From-Home Requirements

  • Quiet, professional, distraction-free home workspace
  • Reliable high-speed internet with Ethernet connection
  • Childcare/dependent care arrangements in place during working hours
  • Camera participation required during training and meetings
  • Virtual backgrounds are not permitted

Technical Requirements

  • Windows 11 PC
  • 16GB RAM minimum (32GB recommended)
  • SSD with available storage
  • Webcam and wired USB headset
  • Internet speeds:
  • 50 Mbps download minimum
  • 5 Mbps upload minimum
  • Under 100ms ping

Application Requirements - Must be included in your application to be considered:

  • Screenshot of your results for the Computer Specs test
  • Screenshots of your scores for the in your Facial Recognition Assessment
  • Complete Criteria Assessments: Live Verify: 4 Part Assessment

Applications are not currently accepted from Residents of: CA, CO, MD, MA, OR, RI, NJ, WA, or the District of Columbia or outside of the US.


To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation process, candidates are expected to complete all interviews and assessments independently and without the use of artificial intelligence tools (including AI-generated responses, prompts, or real-time assistance). Use of AI throughout the application and recruiting process may result in removal from consideration. Our goal is to get to know your authentic experiences, communication style, and problem-solving approach.

raw.excerpt: ResponsibilitiesJoin Peraton in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the FAA’s Brand New Air Traffic Control System (BNATCS) contract.
raw.description:
Responsibilities

Join Peraton in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the FAA’s Brand New Air Traffic Control System (BNATCS) contract. As a trusted partner to the Federal Aviation Administration, Peraton helps deliver the systems and services that keep our nation’s skies safe and connected. We’re looking for innovative professionals who thrive in mission-critical environments and are passionate about shaping the future of air traffic management. This is your chance to make an impact on one of the world’s most vital transportation infrastructures, working alongside leaders in aviation, engineering, data science, and systems integration.

At Peraton, you won’t just support the mission — you’ll define it.

Peraton is seeking an experienced Automation Program Manager to support a Automation workstream NEEDS package execution, oversight, and growth of large-scale IT programs aligned to the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) most significant modernization initiatives supporting the National Airspace System (NAS). This role partners closely with the Program Director to manage daily operations, technical delivery, workforce performance, and stakeholder engagement for a diverse team of 100+ IT professionals spanning Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, System Software Testing and Cloud.

The ideal candidate is a proven leader with strong operational discipline, financial acumen, and experience delivering complex IT services in a regulated federal environment.

Work Location:

  • Remote work is permitted; candidates must reside within the contiguous United States.

Your Impact:

This Director-Level leadership role is responsible for translating strategic objectives into successful operational execution while ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction, technical excellence, workforce performance, financial stewardship, and program growth. You will lead cross-functional workstreams, partner directly with Peraton and FAA leadership, and drive successful delivery across multiple complex modernization initiatives.

Strategic Program Leadership

  • Serve as Program Manager providing leadership across all operational and technical aspects of the workstream.
  • Translate strategic program objectives into executable operational plans.
  • Oversee end-to-end execution of NEEDS Package activities.
  • Ensure successful delivery of all contractual requirements while maintaining cost, schedule, quality, and performance objectives.

Operational Leadership

  • Lead day-to-day operations supporting a workforce of 100+ Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, System Software Testing and Cloud professionals.
  • Partner with functional managers to optimize resource allocation across multiple programs and priorities.
  • Lead cross-functional planning efforts.

Technical Program Execution

  • Direct execution of large, complex engineering and technology initiatives from planning through deployment and operational transition.
  • Manage scope, schedule, technical baselines, dependencies, and integration activities across multiple engineering disciplines.
  • Lead technical reviews, milestone assessments, operational readiness reviews, and executive decision forums.

Financial & Business Management (P&L Responsibility)

  • Assist the Workstream Lead with Profit and Loss (P&L) management for a multi-million-dollar portfolio, ensuring financial performance aligns with business objectives.
  • Support development and execution of annual operating plans, budgets, labor forecasts, indirect planning, and revenue projections.
  • Monitor program financial health, including revenue, margin, labor utilization, backlog, burn rates, and cost performance.
  • Identify opportunities to improve profitability through operational efficiencies, workforce optimization, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with Contracts, Finance, Program Controls, and Business Operations to manage budgets, forecasts and financial reporting.
  • Support business growth through proposal development, capture activities, staffing strategies, and transition planning.

Customer Engagement

  • Develop trusted relationships with FAA leaders, Peraton executives, and key stakeholders.
  • Lead executive program reviews, customer briefings, milestone reviews, and operational governance meetings.
  • Ensure customer priorities remain aligned with program execution.
  • Represent Peraton during executive-level meetings and strategic planning sessions.

Risk, Compliance & Governance

  • Lead enterprise risk management activities across operational, technical, financial, and schedule performance.
  • Drive quality assurance, operational governance, and continuous service improvement.
  • Resolve complex technical, organizational, staffing, and customer issues.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • U.S. Citizenship Required.
  • Must have an active FAA Public Trust clearance.
  • 16 years of experience managing large federal IT programs of 100+ personnel.
  • Proven success managing and delivering federal IT programs with annual budgets exceeding $100M+.
  • Experience managing Profit and Loss (P&L) for large federal programs, including budget planning, revenue forecasting, labor management, cost control, revenue, margin performance, and financial reporting.
  • Proven ability to manage project scope, schedules, technical performance and budgets using structured project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid).
  • Hands-on experience with risk identification, mitigation, and issue resolution.
  • Ability to lead geographically dispersed, cross-functional programs.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience briefing senior leadership and external customers.
  • Demonstrated workforce planning, resource allocation and workload-management experience.
  • Demonstrated success delivering IT services delivery models, operational governance or systems in federal or highly regulated environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Certifications such as PMP, ITIL Managing Professional, or SAFe Agilist.
  • Experience supporting FAA, DOT, or other aviation or transportation programs.
  • Familiarity with NextGen, large-scale modernization, or safety-critical systems.
  • Background in change management, organizational transformation, or program turnarounds.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate, mentor, and retain high-performing teams.

#BNATCS

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Target Salary Range

$146,000 - $234,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

EEO

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

Quant Developer (FinTech) – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Quant Developer (FinTech)
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $89,000–$112,000 Annually
Experience Required: 7+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Quant Developer (FinTech) to build low-latency, high-reliability trading, risk, and analytics systems for fintech applications. In this role you will partner closely with quants and traders to translate mathematical models into production-quality software that meets strict performance, accuracy, and operational requirements. The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering skills with solid quantitative fundamentals and deep familiarity with financial markets, instruments, and risk management practices. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Six or more years of software engineering experience, with significant time in fintech.
  • Strong programming skills in C++, Java, or Python (preferably more than one).
  • Solid grounding in financial markets, instruments, and basic quantitative methods.
  • Hands-on experience building low-latency, high-throughput systems.
  • Experience with market data systems and FIX protocol implementations.
  • Strong understanding of risk and P&L attribution.
  • Experience with high-performance computing patterns and concurrency.
  • Excellent debugging, profiling, and performance-tuning skills.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with derivatives pricing libraries (QuantLib).
  • Familiarity with kdb+/q or similar columnar tick databases.
  • Exposure to GPU-accelerated pricing or risk computation.
  • Experience with cloud-native fintech architectures.
  • Advanced degree in a quantitative discipline.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to . earn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

Job Summary

The Chief Analytics Officer (CAO) is the executive leader responsible for using enterprise data, advanced analytics, AI, and business intelligence to improve strategic and operational decision-making.

Within Insurance & Investments, the CAO typically oversees analytics across underwriting, claims, pricing, customer intelligence, fraud, risk, actuarial insights, investment performance, portfolio analytics, financial planning, regulatory reporting, and enterprise performance.

Key Responsibilities

Define and execute the organization's enterprise analytics strategy.

Establish an enterprise-wide analytics operating model, roadmap, standards, and priorities.

Lead advanced analytics, predictive analytics, AI/ML, data science, and business intelligence.

Translate complex data into actionable insights for CEO, Board, executives, and business leaders.

Develop analytics capabilities for:

Underwriting and risk selection

Claims and loss analysis

Pricing and profitability

Customer segmentation and retention

Fraud detection

Risk and capital analytics

Portfolio and investment performance

Asset allocation

Market and investment research

Financial forecasting

Regulatory and management reporting

Establish enterprise analytics KPIs and measurement frameworks.

Drive predictive modelling and scenario analysis to support strategic decisions.

Partner with the CIO/CDO/CTO on data architecture, data platforms, governance, integration, and technology modernization.

Ensure analytical models use reliable, governed, secure, and appropriately controlled data.

Develop self-service BI and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities for AI and automation across business functions.

Establish model governance, validation, monitoring, and responsible AI practices.

Support actuarial, risk, finance, investment, compliance, and executive decision-making.

Lead enterprise analytics transformation and data-driven culture.

Build, manage, and develop high-performing teams across analytics, data science, BI, and AI.

Manage analytics budgets, vendors, strategic technology partners, and external data providers.

Communicate analytical findings and business implications to senior executives and the Board.

Ensure analytics activities align with regulatory, privacy, risk, and financial-services requirements.

Ideal Candidate Profile

15+ years of experience across analytics, data science, BI, statistics, quantitative analysis, or related fields.

7+ years in senior analytics/data leadership.

Previous experience as:

Chief Analytics Officer

Chief Data & Analytics Officer

Chief Data Officer

Head of Data & Analytics

Head of Analytics

Group Head of Analytics

Director of Data & Analytics

Analytics Director

VP Data & Analytics

Strong experience in Insurance, Banking, Investment Management, Asset Management, Wealth Management, or Financial Services.

Strong understanding of:

Advanced analytics

Predictive modelling

AI/ML

Data science

Business intelligence

Data strategy

Data governance

Data architecture

Statistical modelling

Data visualization

Scenario/stress testing

Experience converting analytics into measurable business outcomes.

Strong executive stakeholder management and Board-level communication.

Experience leading large, multidisciplinary analytics/data teams.

Strong commercial and strategic understanding of financial-services businesses.

Bachelor's degree required; Master's/PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, Actuarial Science, or a related field is advantageous.

raw.excerpt: Role OverviewThe Senior Manager, Finance is responsible for a hybrid role combining financial planning & analysis (FP&A), business operations finance, and support for the state-specific EPR programs.
raw.description:
Role Overview

The Senior Manager, Finance is responsible for a hybrid role combining financial planning & analysis (FP&A), business operations finance, and support for the state-specific EPR programs. This role will ensure that the organization’s and each state EPR programs’ financial health, reporting, and operations are aligned with both long-term strategy and regulatory requirements. The Senior Manager will collaborate closely with internal teams (programs, operations, communications, legal, compliance) to provide financial insights, manage budgets, track performance, and ensure the proper allocation of funds to EPR programs across various states and various spend areas.

The successful candidate will be a highly organized, analytical, and proactive finance leader who thrives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the Business Operations Finance Director in budgeting, forecasting and reconciling actuals verses budget, developing and improving internal tracking and external reporting processes.
  • Develop financial models to evaluate the performance of EPR programs, linking system performance metrics (including participation, collection, capture and contamination rates) to specific investments, enabling the tracking and analysis of program cost ROIs.
  • Provide actionable financial insights and recommendations to state leadership on cash flow, revenue forecasts, cost saving opportunities, cost-benefit analyses of reimbursable system expansion investments and expense management, leveraging scenario planning and long-term projections to guide decision making.
  • Assume leadership role in the financial evaluation and recommendation for CAA’s California EPR program reimbursement applications.
  • Assist in preparing reports for state agencies or other stakeholders, ensuring the accurate and timely submission of required financial data and developing accompanying message tracks on state program costs, funding utilization, and financial sustainability.
  • Design and refine internal financial policies and procedures to drive consistent, transparent, accountable and best-in-class company operations.
  • Act as a finance partner and first point of contact for state program operations, collaborating in ad hoc projects related to day-to-day operations, providing financial guidance and frameworks to guide decision making, interpreting financial data, and educating multi-functional partners on proper cost accounting.
  • Assist in ensuring compliance with state-specific EPR regulations related to financial reporting, fee collection, and producer obligations.
  • Support funding negotiations and contracting processes for state-specific EPR programs, ensuring financial transparency and proper resource allocation.
  • Prepare high-quality presentations, reports and briefings for senior leadership of CAA including Board and Committee meetings.

Skills & Competencies

  • Proven ability to understand financial modeling, forecasting, and scenario analysis.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with cross-functional teams (programs, operations, legal, compliance, communications) and support business operations in a dynamic environment.
  • Proficiency in Excel and experience with financial software systems (Workday Financials or similar).
  • Highly driven individual with a flow to work mindset and passion for navigating change and spear-heading impactful action in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present financial data to non-financial stakeholders.
  • Experience with Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) or environmental sustainability programs a plus.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in finance or accounting roles, with a focus on financial planning & analysis, budgeting, and business operations finance.
  • Bachelor's degree in finance or business administration or a related field, Master’s degree preferred.

About the role

The Solution Architect – Fiber & Structured Cabling, AI Data Center is a customer-facing technical role responsible for designing and architecting high-density fiber and structured cabling solutions for large-scale AI data center environments. The role works closely with customers, Solution Specialists, Account Executives, engineering, Professional Services, OEMs, manufacturers, and delivery teams to translate AI infrastructure requirements into scalable, repeatable, and executable physical connectivity designs. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in data center fiber infrastructure and understands the unique density, speed, scale, quality, and deployment requirements associated with GPU clusters, high-performance networks, and hyperscale AI environments.

Annual Salary Range: $135,000 - $170,000

What you'll be doing

  • Lead technical discovery and architecture for fiber and structured cabling solutions supporting AI data center programs.
  • Translate customer compute, network, rack, and deployment requirements into physical layer designs, standards, BOMs, and implementation requirements.
  • Design high-density fiber architectures supporting GPU clusters, Ethernet and InfiniBand fabrics, storage networks, and data center interconnects.
  • Develop rack-to-rack, row, zone, meet-me-room, backbone, horizontal, and cross-connect cabling architectures.
  • Define fiber types, connectorization, polarity, patching, labeling, pathway, containment, and cable management standards.
  • Develop and validate cable matrices, port maps, connectivity schedules, rack elevations, drawings, BOMs, and installation documentation.
  • Partner with OEMs and infrastructure manufacturers to validate interoperability, standards, product selection, and technical roadmaps.
  • Support estimating, proposals, statements of work, RFQs/RFPs, technical presentations, and customer design reviews.
  • Work with Professional Services and field delivery teams to ensure designs are constructible, scalable, testable, and repeatable across large deployments.
  • Support design-to-delivery handoff, installation standards, QA/QC requirements, testing, certification, documentation, and closeout.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize and automate fiber design, documentation, BOM creation, and deployment methodologies.

What you have

  • 5+ years of experience designing fiber, structured cabling, or physical network infrastructure in data center environments.
  • Strong background in one or more AI Data Center connectivity areas, including high-density fiber architectures, GPU cluster connectivity, Ethernet/InfiniBand fabrics, structured cabling, data center interconnect, rack-level connectivity, and large-scale fiber deployment.
  • Strong knowledge of single-mode and multimode fiber, MPO/MTP and LC connectivity, polarity methods, transceivers/optics, patching architectures, and high-density fiber management.
  • Experience supporting large-scale data centers, hyperscale environments, AI infrastructure, HPC, cloud providers, NCPs, or major colocation/data center operators is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to interpret network designs, rack elevations, port maps, equipment layouts, construction drawings, and customer technical standards.
  • Experience creating or validating BOMs, cable matrices, connectivity schedules, design packages, test requirements, and as-built documentation.
  • Knowledge of structured cabling standards, installation practices, testing/certification, labeling, pathways, and data center QA/QC processes.
  • Experience working with major networking OEMs, optics providers, fiber manufacturers, and structured cabling partners.
  • Strong customer-facing communication, technical presentation, documentation, and design-review skills.
  • Ability to collaborate across sales, architecture, engineering, Professional Services, project management, operations, field delivery, and partner organizations.
  • Ability to operate in fast-moving environments where designs and deployment requirements evolve rapidly.
  • AI infrastructure and large GPU clusters
  • 400G, 800G, and emerging high-speed data center connectivity
  • High-performance Ethernet and InfiniBand fabrics
  • Hyperscale or cloud data center fiber architecture
  • High-density rack and row-level connectivity
  • Large-scale fiber installation and patching programs
  • Pre-terminated and modular fiber solutions
  • Offsite fiber preparation, kitting, labeling, and pre-integration
  • Fiber testing, certification, troubleshooting, and remediation
  • Automated cable matrices, BOMs, port mapping, and design documentation
  • Multi-site deployment standards and repeatable data center design methodologies
  • Fiber Architecture – Deep understanding of high-density data center fiber design and physical connectivity.
  • AI Infrastructure Knowledge – Understands how GPU compute, networking, storage, and rack architectures drive physical layer requirements.
  • Design at Scale – Creates repeatable architectures capable of supporting thousands of racks and very large connection counts.
  • Technical Accuracy – Maintains rigorous attention to port mapping, polarity, labeling, testing, documentation, and quality.
  • Customer Engagement – Can lead technical discovery, design workshops, and customer architecture reviews.
  • Design-to-Delivery Thinking – Develops solutions that can be efficiently sourced, pre-built, installed, tested, and operated.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Connects customer requirements with sales, engineering, sourcing, partners, and field delivery.
  • Quality and accuracy of fiber and structured cabling designs
  • Speed from customer requirements to executable solution architecture
  • Design standardization and repeatability across AI Data Center programs
  • Reduction of field changes, rework, and connectivity defects
  • Successful technical support of pipeline and customer pursuits
  • Accuracy of BOMs, cable matrices, port maps, and design documentation
  • Successful transition from solution architecture into deployment
  • Customer satisfaction and technical credibility
  • Continuous improvement of fiber design and deployment methodology
  • The ideal candidate is a hands-on data center fiber architect who understands how to turn complex AI infrastructure and network requirements into highly accurate, scalable physical connectivity solutions. They should be comfortable working from GPU and network architecture down to the rack, port, optic, fiber, connector, pathway, and patching level.
  • This individual should combine strong technical depth with practical deployment experience—someone who can design for scale while understanding how the solution will actually be sourced, staged, installed, tested, documented, and supported in a high-velocity AI Data Center environment.

What you can expect

There’s so much more to enjoy about being at Computacenter than just having a rewarding career. In addition to offering competitive compensation plans and long-term career opportunities, we provide an attractive mix of benefit plans to contribute to your good health, future financial security, and peace of mind.

About us

Computacenter is a leading independent technology partner, trusted by large corporate and public sector organizations. We help our world-renowned customers to source, transform, and manage their IT infrastructure to deliver digital transformation, enabling users and their business. We’re a public company quoted on the London FTSE 250 (CCC.L) and employ over 21,000 people worldwide. In the US, we support some of the country’s best-known businesses with regional hubs in San Francisco and Irvine, CA; Norcross, GA; Plano, TX; and New York City; and Integration Centers in Silicon Valley and Atlanta.

raw.title: Revenue Operations Support Analyst
raw.excerpt: About KojoIt's time to build.  Whether it's creating more housing, upgrading our infrastructure, or adapting to climate change, one thing is clear: the construction industry is at the center of solving our biggest problems.
raw.description:
About Kojo

It's time to build. Whether it's creating more housing, upgrading our infrastructure, or adapting to climate change, one thing is clear: the construction industry is at the center of solving our biggest problems. We’re making buildings cheaper and easier to build by transforming the way commercial construction companies buy their materials. Join us.

Founded in 2018, Kojo is now one of the fastest-growing construction technology companies in the world. Construction accounts for $10 trillion in global spend annually and we can’t live without its output - our roads, schools, hospitals, and offices. Despite this, there’s been very little innovation over the past 70 years in how materials - which constitute up to 40% of project costs - are bought and sold. This is our opportunity.

About the Role

Kojo's Sales and Customer Success teams run on Salesforce, and when something in that world needs a hand — a quote that has to be built by hand, an account that needs to move, a duplicate that needs merging, a report that doesn't add up — the request lands in one queue. You'll be the first person to pick it up.

The most important part of the job is custom quotes. Most agreements go out on a standard template a rep can send alone. The ones that don't — a mid-term expansion co-termed to an existing subscription, a split payment schedule, a multi-year deal paid upfront, a contract that has to list every module with its own dates and price, an amendment to something already signed — come to you. You'll get the opportunity and quote right, generate the order form, edit it where the template can't, and get it out through DocuSign, quickly and correctly.

Around that core you'll work the rest of the RevOps queue: account ownership and routing changes, duplicate merges, small Salesforce fixes, data questions, and tool questions. You'll report to the Revenue Operations Coordinator, and the two of you will run the queue together — you resolving what can be resolved directly, escalating what needs deeper Salesforce work, and both of you turning the patterns you see into fixes so the same request stops coming back.

Commercial decisions — pricing, discounts, non-standard terms — belong to the go-to-market organization, Sales and Customer Success. Your role is to make sure what they've agreed is captured accurately, approved where it needs to be, and reflected exactly in what the customer signs and in Salesforce afterwards.

What you'll own

  • Efficiently shipping custom quotes and order forms. This is the most important part of your role. Take a rep's request — a co-term with a prorated amount, a custom payment schedule, a one-time fee on a multi-year term, a multi-entity or module-level contract, an entity or start-date change, a rider or addendum, a credit — and turn it into a correct opportunity, quote, order form and DocuSign envelope. Same day where the deal needs it. Work with the RevOps Coordinate to iterate SFDC and DocuSign to accelerate our ability to ship an accurate quote. You ensure the GTM team is focused on the customer and not the critical CRM data we need to onboard, recognize revenue, and bill customer accurately.

  • Quotes and DocuSign when they misbehave. Diagnose why a generated agreement came out wrong — quote not syncing, billing or shipping details missing, products missing or duplicated, a price not reading through, no signature field, a Closed Won that won't save — work with the revenue operations coordinator to identify how SFDC should be updated, and / or show the rep how to avoid it next time.

  • The approval layer. Understand Kojo’s deal policies and how they show up in the SFDC deal flow. Keep approval status accurate, and confirm the right approvals are in place before an envelope goes out.

  • The rest of the queue. Account ownership and routing changes, inbound credits, duplicate account and contact merges, picklist and field tweaks, user access issues, renewal record discrepancies, cancellation processing, and answering questions about RevOps-owned tools, and knowing which tools are not owned by RevOps and routing the question to the owner of that tool. Triage fast, resolve what you can, escalate cleanly, and keep the requester informed.

  • The record after signature. Make sure term dates, amounts, products, and credits in Salesforce match the signed agreement to the day, that the renewal opportunities that should exist do exist, and that cancellations and amendments leave clean data behind.

  • Making requests disappear. Spot the recurring patterns in the queue and create business requirements to reduce the incidence of the recurring pattern in the future. Work with the Coordinator who will perform the configuration and development work to turn those business requirements into a template fix, a field, a validation rule, a small flow, or a how-to that lets reps self-serve.

About You

What we're looking for:

  • Revenue operations or deal desk experience: 2+ years at a B2B SaaS company in a seat where quotes, orders, or Salesforce requests came to you — deal desk, sales operations, revenue operations, order management, or Salesforce support.

  • Hands-on in Salesforce: you're fluent in the Opportunity → Quote → Product data model, comfortable with reports, list views, and bulk updates, and you've made real configuration changes — fields, picklists, validation rules, page layouts, simple flows — in an org other people depended on. Salesforce Administrator certification, or experience that clearly stands in for it.

  • DocuSign beyond the send button: templates, merge fields and tabs, routing, reminders and expiry. Experience with DocuSign for Salesforce or Gen for Salesforce is a strong advantage.

  • Contract math as a reflex: prorations, co-terms, day counts, split payment schedules, multi-year totals — and the habit of stating your convention before your number.

  • Precision with documents: you can edit an order form in Word so the language, table, and totals are exactly right, and you notice when they aren't.

  • Precise written English: you'll write to reps, CSMs, and customers all day. Spoken English sufficient for a daily working session with the team.

  • A queue temperament: organized, quick to acknowledge, quick to close the loop, and able to tell a rep at quarter-end that a document isn't ready yet — with the reason and the fastest path forward.

  • Based in Latin America, with at least four hours of daily overlap with US Central time and flexibility in the final week of each quarter.

Nice to have:

  • Admin exposure to the GTM tools around Salesforce — Chili Piper, Outreach, ZoomInfo, Gong.

  • Exposure to how a signed contract becomes an invoice (Stripe or another billing platform).

  • A recurring manual request you turned into a template, automation, or how-to — and what it removed.

  • Experience supporting construction, manufacturing, or another industrial market.

What you care about

  • Accountability: when an order form goes out wrong or a record doesn't match the paper, you treat it as yours to fix — and then you fix the reason it happened.

  • Impact: you sequence the queue by what unblocks a deal and what protects a customer relationship, not by what arrived first.

  • Intentional Communication: you write with the right context and no ambiguity — to a rep who's stuck, a CSM mid-renewal, or a customer reading an order form.

  • Collaboration: you check with the rep, the CSM, and the Coordinator before you build, so the contract that goes out is the one everyone thinks went out.

Working at Kojo

Salary: Your salary will be dependent upon many factors, including your experience level, skillset, market dynamics and balancing internal equity relative to other Kojo employees. The compensation and benefits information that we provide is based on Kojo’s good-faith estimate as of the date of the job posting and may be modified in the future.

Benefits: This position is also eligible for a new hire equity grant and all US-based full time employees are eligible for our full suite of perks and benefits. For more information about our perks and benefits, check out

Location: Kojo’s team members work from home 100% of the time across North and South America. If applicable, we’ll identify the travel and/or location-specific requirements of a position in the text above. Otherwise, team members can expect to work business hours congruent with their local time zone and remotely.

Inclusive Workplace: Kojo values diverse perspectives and is committed to building an inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, color, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, citizenship, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply.



Scam Notice: Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of Kojo. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Kojo will never ask for any personal account information, such credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process.

SAP System Administrator- Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: SAP System Administrator
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

We are seeking a seasoned SAP System Administrator responsible for the architecture, installation, configuration, performance tuning, and day-to-day operation of complex SAP landscapes that may span on-premises, hybrid, and cloud-hosted environments. This role is critical to keeping mission-critical SAP systems available, performant, secure, and compliant. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise across SAP NetWeaver, S/4HANA, HANA database administration, system copies, upgrades, and migrations, and will partner with infrastructure, security, and SAP functional teams to deliver a stable, well-governed SAP platform.



Key Responsibilities
  • Architect, install, configure, and operate SAP landscapes including S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, Solution Manager, and other NetWeaver-based systems across on-prem and cloud environments.
  • Administer SAP HANA databases — including installation, sizing, replication, backup, recovery, and performance tuning — to meet demanding availability and performance SLAs.
  • Plan and execute SAP system copies, refreshes, and post-copy automation activities to support development, testing, training, and migration scenarios.
  • Lead SAP upgrades, EHP installations, Support Package application, kernel upgrades, and S/4HANA conversions with minimal disruption to business operations.
  • Design and implement SAP migrations to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and SAP RISE/Grow environments, including network and identity integration.
  • Configure and operate high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions for SAP, including HANA System Replication, cluster-based failover, and validated DR runbooks.
  • Implement and maintain SAP transport management strategies, including Solution Manager ChaRM and CTS+ workflows.
  • Manage SAP user provisioning, role management, and audit support in close collaboration with the SAP Security/GRC team.
  • Monitor SAP system performance, capacity, and health using Solution Manager, Focused Run, native HANA tools, and external APM platforms.
  • Develop automation scripts and runbooks using Ansible, PowerShell, or Python to reduce operational toil and accelerate routine tasks.
  • Manage and remediate SAP security notes, kernel patches, and database patches in accordance with internal security and compliance policies.
  • Provide 24x7 on-call support for production SAP systems and lead structured incident response and post-incident reviews.
  • Document SAP architecture, operations procedures, and standard operating processes to support knowledge sharing and team scalability.
  • Mentor junior Basis engineers and contribute to the broader SAP platform roadmap.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of SAP Basis / platform engineering experience in large enterprise environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience administering SAP HANA databases in production.
  • Experience operating S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, Solution Manager, and other NetWeaver systems.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP migrations to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong experience with SAP upgrades, EHP/SP application, and system conversions.
  • Solid experience with SAP HA/DR strategies, including HANA System Replication and clustering.
  • Working knowledge of SAP transport management and Solution Manager ChaRM.
  • Scripting skills in Bash, PowerShell, Python, or Ansible.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  • SAP certifications in HANA, S/4HANA, or Basis administration.
  • Experience with SAP RISE / Grow and SAP Cloud ALM.
  • Familiarity with SAP BTP and integration with hyperscaler-native services.
  • Exposure to infrastructure-as-code for SAP landscapes (Ansible, Terraform).
  • Experience operating regulated SAP workloads (SOX, GxP, PCI).

How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to  or contact us at (908) 505-3544. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at .

Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

raw.title: Bridge Design Engineer (Projektant Mostów)
raw.excerpt: WSP jest wiodącą na świecie firmą inżynieryjną, specjalizującą się w infrastrukturze, transporcie, ochronie środowiska, energii i budynkach.
raw.description:
WSP jest wiodącą na świecie firmą inżynieryjną, specjalizującą się w infrastrukturze, transporcie, ochronie środowiska, energii i budynkach.

Mamy jasną wizję tego, w jaki sposób chcemy pomóc uczynić świat lepszym miejscem, wspierając społeczności i to, co jest naprawdę ważne dla naszej przyszłości.

Wyobraź sobie lepszą przyszłość dla nas wszystkich - i lepszą przyszłość dla Ciebie.

Do naszego zespołu Infrastruktury poszukujemy Projektanta Mostów.

Będziesz uczestniczyć w realizacji projektów mostowych i infrastrukturalnych dla rynków skandynawskich, współpracując na co dzień z zespołami WSP w Szwecji i Finlandii. W tej roli będziesz brać udział w opracowywaniu dokumentacji projektowej, analizie i modelowaniu konstrukcji oraz przygotowywaniu rozwiązań technicznych dla złożonych inwestycji infrastrukturalnych.
Możliwość pracy zdalnej lub hybrydowej w naszym biurze w Warszawie lub w Krakowie.

Twoje zadania

  • Projektowanie obiektów mostowych oraz opracowywanie obliczeń i modeli konstrukcyjnych 3D.

  • Analiza i dobór rozwiązań technicznych, materiałów oraz technologii budowlanych.

  • Opracowywanie i weryfikacja dokumentacji projektowej oraz optymalizacja rozwiązań projektowych.

  • Przygotowywanie przedmiarów robót i wsparcie procesu realizacji projektów.

  • Współpraca z zespołami projektowymi WSP w Szwecji i Finlandii.

  • Koordynacja projektów z innymi branżami oraz udział w spotkaniach projektowych.

  • Współpraca z klientami, podwykonawcami i interesariuszami projektu.

  • Dbanie o terminową realizację powierzonych zadań oraz wysoką jakość opracowań projektowych.

O zespole

Dołączysz do zespołu infrastrukturalnego WSP, który realizuje projekty mostowe i transportowe dla klientów w Polsce i za granicą. Współpracujemy na co dzień z zespołami WSP w Szwecji i Finlandii, wykorzystując nowoczesne narzędzia projektowe oraz środowisko BIM.

Projektujemy nowe obiekty mostowe, modernizacje istniejącej infrastruktury oraz opracowujemy rozwiązania wspierające optymalizację kosztową inwestycji. W swojej pracy korzystamy m.in. z programów SOFiSTiK, Robot Structural Analysis, BRIGADE, Mathcad, Tekla i Revit.

Wybrane projekty

  • Östlänken (Szwecja) - jedna z największych inwestycji kolejowych realizowanych w Szwecji.

  • Klara City View (Sztokholm, Szwecja) - projekt wielobranżowy realizowany w centrum Sztokholmu.

  • Most Kirjalansalmi (Finlandia) - jeden z najbardziej rozpoznawalnych projektów mostowych realizowanych przez WSP w Finlandii.

Kogo szukamy?

Niezbędne kwalifikacje

  • Wykształcenie wyższe techniczne w zakresie budownictwa, preferowana specjalność mostowa.

  • Doświadczenie w projektowaniu obiektów mostowych i infrastrukturalnych.

  • Znajomość polskiego prawa budowlanego, norm i standardów branżowych.

  • Umiejętność rozwiązywania problemów technicznych i analizowania rozwiązań projektowych.

  • Komunikatywna znajomość języka angielskiego.

  • Bardzo dobra znajomość AutoCAD oraz innych programów CAD.

  • Dobra znajomość pakietu Microsoft Office (Word, Excel).

Mile widziane

  • Znajomość programów Revit, Tekla lub SOFiSTiK.

  • Doświadczenie w pracy w środowisku BIM.

  • Doświadczenie przy projektach międzynarodowych.

Co oferujemy?

  • Rozwój w międzynarodowym biurze projektowym

  • Możliwość realizacji prestiżowych projektów

  • Opiekę medyczną

  • Dofinansowanie do karty Multisport

  • Dostęp do platformy wellbeing (w tym 5 bezpłatnych konsultacji z psychologiem, prawnikiem i/lub doradcą finansowym rocznie)

  • Dofinansowanie lekcji językowych, kursów i szkoleń

  • Możliwość pracy zdalnej

Nasz proces rekrutacji:

  • Analiza CV.

  • Krótka rozmowa telefoniczna z rekruterem.

  • Spotkanie online lub w biurze z kierownikiem zespołu.

  • Możliwe dodatkowe spotkanie techniczne.

Pracuj z WSP.

Z nami możesz.

#WeAreWSP

raw.description:
Attain Partners is an innovative consulting firm dedicated to disrupting the status quo to change the world and improve the lives of those we touch. From strategy to technology and everywhere in between, our experts use their unique skills to advance the important missions of education, nonprofit, healthcare, and state and local government clients.

People are at the center of all we do, and that’s why we empower career growth, provide industry-leading benefits packages, encourage a flexible work environment, and foster a culture of inclusion to support the needs of our team. We share a collective passion for our mission and our people. Guided by our seven core values, The Attain Way, our vision is the foundation of our culture—to be and attain the best.

Attain Partners is seeking an experienced MuleSoft Architect & Developer to join our Data Services & Analytics practice. This individual will be responsible for architecting, designing, developing, and deploying enterprise integrations using the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform for our clients, with a strong emphasis on Higher Education and Salesforce ecosystems. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical professional who combines MuleSoft architecture and development expertise with extensive Salesforce integration experience. This role requires someone who can independently design and build integrations, troubleshoot complex technical challenges, and work directly within Salesforce configuration environments to support end-to-end integration delivery. Active MuleSoft certification is mandatory, and previous experience supporting Higher Education institutions is strongly preferred. Important: Candidates must possess at least one active MuleSoft certification and demonstrate strong hands-on MuleSoft development and Salesforce integration/configuration experience.

Required Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying integrations using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.
  • Expertise with Anypoint Studio, DataWeave, API Manager, CloudHub, and MuleSoft connectors.
  • Proven experience developing REST APIs, SOAP APIs, batch integrations, and real-time integrations.
  • Hands-on Salesforce integration and configuration experience, including the ability to navigate Salesforce Setup, objects, fields, relationships, connected apps, permissions, and API configurations.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce using MuleSoft Salesforce Connector, REST API, SOAP API, and Bulk API.
  • Strong understanding of API-led connectivity, integration architecture, authentication, OAuth 2.0, and error-handling frameworks.
  • Ability to independently architect, build, test, troubleshoot, and deploy MuleSoft integrations.
  • Experience developing technical specifications, integration mappings, API documentation, and solution architecture diagrams.
  • Strong client-facing communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with Salesforce administrators, developers, and business stakeholders.

Desired Skills

  • Higher Education experience is strongly preferred, particularly working with universities, Advancement organizations, and Student Information Systems.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce Education Cloud, Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud, or Salesforce Advancement solutions.
  • Familiarity with Higher Education platforms such as PeopleSoft Campus Solutions, Ellucian Banner, Workday, Slate, Anthology, and other campus systems.
  • Experience with MuleSoft API-led architecture and reusable integration frameworks.
  • Knowledge of data migration, source-to-target mapping, data quality, and enterprise data architecture.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, automated testing, and deployment automation.
  • Experience with event-driven architecture, message queues, and asynchronous processing.
  • Prior consulting or professional services experience supporting multiple enterprise clients.
  • Ability to lead technical discovery sessions, architectural design discussions, and integration troubleshooting activities.

Years of Experience

  • 7+ years of overall enterprise application integration, software development, or solution architecture experience.
  • 4+ years of hands-on MuleSoft development and integration implementation experience.
  • 3+ years of Salesforce integration experience, including direct exposure to Salesforce administration and configuration.

Certifications

Active MuleSoft certification, such as Salesforce Certified MuleSoft Developer or Salesforce Certified MuleSoft Integration Architect.

Additional Requirements

  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships with clients
  • Experience supporting sales and business development
  • Position requires flexibility to travel periodically based on business and client needs

Additional Information

Attain Partners values your mental, emotional, and physical health and wellbeing. Our comprehensive benefits package starts on your first day of employment and includes benefits such as:

  • Competitive health, dental, and vision coverage, HSA and FSA accounts, life and disability insurance, fertility and family planning benefits, and employee assistance and discount programs
  • 11 paid federal holidays and flexible unlimited time off (UTO)
  • Generous 401(k) matching with immediate vesting
  • Flexible career paths – our career tracks provide advancement, mobility, and flexibility as you continue to grow with us
  • A healthy environment where we value unique experiences, and care about everything that makes you, you.

Attain Partners is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The individual base salary for this position is unique to each candidate and will be commensurate with experience, education, and skills. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.

Interested in this position but the compensation isn’t quite right? Let us know your expectations, and we’ll see if we can make it happen based on your qualifications.

Salary Range
$150,000—$180,000 USD

Attain Partners is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws. For more Information visit EEO, EEO Poster Supplement, Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA), and Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA).

If you are unable to complete this application due to a disability, contact this employer to ask for an accommodation or an alternative application process.

Account Technical Lead, Enterprise Sales

In this Technical Sales role, you will partner with and inspire our strategic AECO customers helping them realise their full potential. Partnering closely with the Enterprise Account Executive and our Enterprise Customer organisation, you will focus on increasing expansion and building long-term partnerships by gaining a clear understanding of our customers’ business challenges and translating these into a Technical Vision and Technical Proposals that will deliver tangible results.

We support hybrid or remote working, and you will report to the Senior Technical Solutions Manager.

Let us give you a few impressions of the rapid change and great opportunities in this market that Autodesk has been a part of: Autodesk Showreel 

Main Responsibilities 

  • Technical Discovery: Lead discovery sessions to understand customer systems, workflows, pain points, and objectives. Translate findings into actionable insights.
  • Solution Architecture: Design and define tailored technical solutions that demonstrate ROI and align with customer business initiatives.
  • Customer Technical Vision (CTV): Develop and maintain a strategic technical roadmap for each account, ensuring alignment between customer goals and Autodesk capabilities.
  • Building Trust: Establish credibility through consistent delivery, accurate information, and solution-oriented engagement.
  • Technical Relationships: Cultivate long-term technical partnerships with customers to support ongoing success and innovation.
  • Sales Collaboration: Partner with Account Executives (AEs) to identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities and co-develop customer success plans.
  • Issue Resolution: Lead and mentor resolution of complex technical issues escalated by Customer Success.
  • Technical Orchestration: Coordinate and lead technical specialists to deliver demos, benchmarks, evaluations, and ROI modelling.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • Degree, education or equivalent work experience in AECO or Data and Platform solutions 
  • You have > 8 years experience in customer-facing roles 
  • You have fluent French and English language skills
  • Ideally you have knowledge of the Autodesk solution portfolio (AECO – Architecture, Engineering, Construction & Operations) 
  • You have an outcome-focused approach to solving customer challenges 
  • You are experienced or interested in a sales-supporting function (e.g., presales) 
  • You have excellent communication and presentation skills 
  • You influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus building 
  • You enjoy working as a team player, who can manage multiple priorities 
  • You can travel up to 20% within the EMEA region

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For France based sales roles, we expect a starting On-Target Earnings (OTE) between 92,250 EUR and 135,300 EUR. OTE is comprised of base salary plus commission target for sales roles. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Belonging

OR

Dołączysz do zespołu infrastrukturalnego WSP, który realizuje projekty mostowe i transportowe dla klientów w Polsce i za granicą. Współpracujemy na co dzień z zespołami WSP w Szwecji i Finlandii, wykorzystując nowoczesne narzędzia projektowe oraz środowisko BIM.

Projektujemy nowe obiekty mostowe, modernizacje istniejącej infrastruktury oraz opracowujemy rozwiązania wspierające optymalizację kosztową inwestycji. W swojej pracy korzystamy m.in. z programów SOFiSTiK, Robot Structural Analysis, BRIGADE, Mathcad, Tekla i Revit.

Wybrane projekty

  • Östlänken (Szwecja) - jedna z największych inwestycji kolejowych realizowanych w Szwecji.

  • Klara City View (Sztokholm, Szwecja) - projekt wielobranżowy realizowany w centrum Sztokholmu.

  • Most Kirjalansalmi (Finlandia) - jeden z najbardziej rozpoznawalnych projektów mostowych realizowanych przez WSP w Finlandii.

Kogo szukamy?

Niezbędne kwalifikacje

  • Wykształcenie wyższe techniczne w zakresie budownictwa, preferowana specjalność mostowa.

  • Doświadczenie w projektowaniu obiektów mostowych i infrastrukturalnych.

  • Znajomość polskiego prawa budowlanego, norm i standardów branżowych.

  • Umiejętność rozwiązywania problemów technicznych i analizowania rozwiązań projektowych.

  • Komunikatywna znajomość języka angielskiego.

  • Bardzo dobra znajomość AutoCAD oraz innych programów CAD.

  • Dobra znajomość pakietu Microsoft Office (Word, Excel).

Mile widziane

  • Znajomość programów Revit, Tekla lub SOFiSTiK.

  • Doświadczenie w pracy w środowisku BIM.

  • Doświadczenie przy projektach międzynarodowych.

Co oferujemy?

  • Rozwój w międzynarodowym biurze projektowym

  • Możliwość realizacji prestiżowych projektów

  • Opiekę medyczną

  • Dofinansowanie do karty Multisport

  • Dostęp do platformy wellbeing (w tym 5 bezpłatnych konsultacji z psychologiem, prawnikiem i/lub doradcą finansowym rocznie)

  • Dofinansowanie lekcji językowych, kursów i szkoleń

  • Możliwość pracy zdalnej

Nasz proces rekrutacji:

  • Analiza CV.

  • Krótka rozmowa telefoniczna z rekruterem.

  • Spotkanie online lub w biurze z kierownikiem zespołu.

  • Możliwe dodatkowe spotkanie techniczne.

Pracuj z WSP.

Z nami możesz.

Attain Partners is an innovative consulting firm dedicated to disrupting the status quo to change the world and improve the lives of those we touch. From strategy to technology and everywhere in between, our experts use their unique skills to advance the important missions of education, nonprofit, healthcare, and state and local government clients.

People are at the center of all we do, and that’s why we empower career growth, provide industry-leading benefits packages, encourage a flexible work environment, and foster a culture of inclusion to support the needs of our team. We share a collective passion for our mission and our people. Guided by our seven core values, The Attain Way, our vision is the foundation of our culture—to be and attain the best.

Attain Partners is seeking an experienced MuleSoft Architect & Developer to join our Data Services & Analytics practice. This individual will be responsible for architecting, designing, developing, and deploying enterprise integrations using the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform for our clients, with a strong emphasis on Higher Education and Salesforce ecosystems. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical professional who combines MuleSoft architecture and development expertise with extensive Salesforce integration experience. This role requires someone who can independently design and build integrations, troubleshoot complex technical challenges, and work directly within Salesforce configuration environments to support end-to-end integration delivery. Active MuleSoft certification is mandatory, and previous experience supporting Higher Education institutions is strongly preferred. Important: Candidates must possess at least one active MuleSoft certification and demonstrate strong hands-on MuleSoft development and Salesforce integration/configuration experience.

Required Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying integrations using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.
  • Expertise with Anypoint Studio, DataWeave, API Manager, CloudHub, and MuleSoft connectors.
  • Proven experience developing REST APIs, SOAP APIs, batch integrations, and real-time integrations.
  • Hands-on Salesforce integration and configuration experience, including the ability to navigate Salesforce Setup, objects, fields, relationships, connected apps, permissions, and API configurations.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce using MuleSoft Salesforce Connector, REST API, SOAP API, and Bulk API.
  • Strong understanding of API-led connectivity, integration architecture, authentication, OAuth 2.0, and error-handling frameworks.
  • Ability to independently architect, build, test, troubleshoot, and deploy MuleSoft integrations.
  • Experience developing technical specifications, integration mappings, API documentation, and solution architecture diagrams.
  • Strong client-facing communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with Salesforce administrators, developers, and business stakeholders.

Desired Skills

  • Higher Education experience is strongly preferred, particularly working with universities, Advancement organizations, and Student Information Systems.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce Education Cloud, Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud, or Salesforce Advancement solutions.
  • Familiarity with Higher Education platforms such as PeopleSoft Campus Solutions, Ellucian Banner, Workday, Slate, Anthology, and other campus systems.
  • Experience with MuleSoft API-led architecture and reusable integration frameworks.
  • Knowledge of data migration, source-to-target mapping, data quality, and enterprise data architecture.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, automated testing, and deployment automation.
  • Experience with event-driven architecture, message queues, and asynchronous processing.
  • Prior consulting or professional services experience supporting multiple enterprise clients.
  • Ability to lead technical discovery sessions, architectural design discussions, and integration troubleshooting activities.

Years of Experience

  • 7+ years of overall enterprise application integration, software development, or solution architecture experience.
  • 4+ years of hands-on MuleSoft development and integration implementation experience.
  • 3+ years of Salesforce integration experience, including direct exposure to Salesforce administration and configuration.

Certifications

Active MuleSoft certification, such as Salesforce Certified MuleSoft Developer or Salesforce Certified MuleSoft Integration Architect.

Additional Requirements

  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships with clients
  • Experience supporting sales and business development
  • Position requires flexibility to travel periodically based on business and client needs

Additional Information

Attain Partners values your mental, emotional, and physical health and wellbeing. Our comprehensive benefits package starts on your first day of employment and includes benefits such as:

  • Competitive health, dental, and vision coverage, HSA and FSA accounts, life and disability insurance, fertility and family planning benefits, and employee assistance and discount programs
  • 11 paid federal holidays and flexible unlimited time off (UTO)
  • Generous 401(k) matching with immediate vesting
  • Flexible career paths – our career tracks provide advancement, mobility, and flexibility as you continue to grow with us
  • A healthy environment where we value unique experiences, and care about everything that makes you, you.

Attain Partners is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The individual base salary for this position is unique to each candidate and will be commensurate with experience, education, and skills. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.

Interested in this position but the compensation isn’t quite right? Let us know your expectations, and we’ll see if we can make it happen based on your qualifications.

$150,000—$180,000 USD

raw.description:
Overview

POSITION SUMMARY: The Project Manager – EPMO is responsible for planning, executing, and closing individual IT projects that support key business stakeholders such as revenue cycle, clinical operations, finance, HR, and other functional areas. This role applies standard project management methodologies and tools to deliver projects on time, within scope, and within budget.

The Project Manager – EPMO works closely with business stakeholders, IT solution teams, and vendors to define requirements, develop project plans, manage risks and issues, track progress, and ensure quality deliverables. The role focuses on day-to-day project execution and coordination, escalating risks and decisions as appropriate to program or portfolio leadership.

The base pay estimate for this role is $89,000-$151,300 annually. The final offer will depend on the skills, experience, and qualifications of the selected candidate. This range is for base pay only and does not include bonuses or other compensation. This position is eligible for an annual bonus. Bonuses are not guaranteed and are awarded based on company and individual performance.

Job Highlights

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: (The ideal candidate must be able to complete all physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation):

  • Partners with business stakeholders and IT solution managers to capture and document project requirements and define project scope.
  • Creates and maintains detailed project plans, schedules, resource plans, and cost estimates.
  • Facilitates project kickoff meetings, status meetings, and working sessions.
  • Tracks project progress against scope, schedule, budget, and quality targets.
  • Identifies, documents, and manages project risks, issues, and dependencies, escalating when needed.
  • Coordinates project tasks and activities across technical teams, business users, and vendors.
  • Supports business case development and project intake documentation as required.
  • Ensures adherence to established EPMO standards, processes, and reporting requirements.
  • Produces and maintains accurate project documentation, including:
    • Requirements documentation.
    • Scope and change control artifacts.
    • Project schedules and status reports.
    • Issue and risk logs.
    • Test plans and test results.
    • Project budgets and forecasts.
  • Manages change requests and supports formal change control processes.
  • Coordinates quality assurance activities and ensures testing plans are executed.
  • Supports vendor coordination by tracking assigned deliverables and timelines.
  • Communicates project status, risks, and outcomes clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Performs post-project closeout activities, including lessons learned and documentation archiving.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES (KSAs):

  • Bachelor’s degree required; information systems, business, or related field preferred.
  • 2-4 years of experience in project coordination or project management.
  • Experience supporting IT and business application projects preferred.
  • Experience managing projects within the Smartsheet work management platform strongly preferred.
  • PMP or CAPM certification is a plus but not required.
  • Experience with healthcare IT strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of project management principles, methodologies, and tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Basic understanding of IT systems, applications, and solution delivery lifecycles.
  • Ability to identify risks, analyze issues, and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Customer-focused mindset with attention to quality and delivery outcomes.

*The physical demands described here are representative of those that may need to be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Occasional Standing
  • Occasional Walking
  • Frequent Sitting
  • Frequent hand, finger movement
  • Use office equipment (in office or remote)

Communicate verbally and in writing

raw.description:
As a leading game localization company, we offer integrated text, audio localization, and localization QA for all regions, languages and platforms, ensuring a fully authentic offering for players worldwide.

Our global footprint across Asia, Oceania, Europe, and the Americas enables us to run 24-hour follow-the-sun workflows, allowing our professional translators and game developers continue to work on your project around the clock and delivering on even the most challenging timelines.

The team at Keywords Studios handles media localization and translation services for any project size, from indie to AAA games. We help you speak to global audiences by translating your games for your target language and dialect, and ensure expert quality control throughout the game development and translation process through both technology solutions and human oversight.

Job Summary

The Quality Management team ensures that localized content consistently meets the highest standards of accuracy, creativity, and player experience. We achieve this by evaluating performance, driving continuous improvement initiatives, enabling linguists and vendors through training and feedback, and partnering with stakeholders to prevent issues before they reach the player. Our work spans resource evaluation, process optimization, and tool enhancement, ensuring quality is embedded at every stage of the localization workflow.

The Localization Quality Coordinator supports Localization teams across Keywords in implementing and upholding quality processes, ensuring that content meets client expectations, style guidelines, and franchise-specific requirements. This role combines data-driven analysis with linguistic expertise, acting as a bridge between Project Management, Resource Management, and external vendors.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Localization Managers and Project Managers to assess risk & create quality plans, reviewing them regularly and making sure they are effective.
  • Analyze and present timely, actionable reports on quality performance against set standards, identifying risks and recommending corrective or preventive measures.
  • Champion quality standards and processes across Localisation teams, promoting a consistent approach across projects and languages.
  • Define, deliver, and continuously improve training sessions and guidance materials for internal linguists, external vendors, and other stakeholders on quality processes.
  • Validate, arbitrate, and finalise quality evaluations, ensuring consistent application of scoring frameworks and fair dispute resolution.
  • Support PMs in delivering constructive, actionable feedback to external resources.
  • Collaborate on tool and process improvements, including the Quality Evaluation Portal, translation quality evaluation systems, and automated QA checks, suggesting enhancements based on recurring trends or workflow bottlenecks.
  • Contribute to root cause analysis for quality incidents and client complaints, helping define preventive actions and assess their effectiveness.
  • Assist in onboarding and testing processes for new linguists, ensuring alignment with quality standards before integration into live projects.
  • Leverage Generative AI tools (such as Gemini) to optimize daily workflows, streamline data analysis, and assist in drafting quality reports and CAPAs.

Requirements

  • Based in an Asian timezone with the ability to work closely with regional teams and vendors.
  • Minimum 2 years’ experience in a related role within the localisation industry.
  • A degree in Translation, Linguistics, or a related field.
  • Ideally, a native speaker of Korean, Japanese, or Chinese, with excellent proficiency in English.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to provide clear, actionable feedback.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with distributed, multicultural teams.
  • Intermediate to advanced Excel skills; ability to extract, process, and interpret data for decision-making.
  • Familiarity with translation quality evaluation systems, frameworks (e.g., MQM), and CAT tools.
  • Experience with linguistic arbitration or dispute resolution in a professional setting is desirable.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify patterns, prioritise issues, and propose process improvements.
  • Knowledge of localisation quality control processes and industry best practices.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to new tools and workflows, with demonstrated hands-on experience using using generative AI (specifically Gemini) for day-to-day productivity, process improvement, and problem-solving.
  • Ideally, a familiarity with Audio Localization processes.

Important Notes for Applicants:

  • Please submit your CV/resume in English.
  • Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Benefits

Keywords Studios is dedicated to following a well-established Equal Opportunities Policy. We endeavour to create a workplace which provides for equal opportunities for all employees and potential employees.

At KWS, we value and encourage diversity in all its forms. We foster an inclusive environment and give special priority to the inclusion of people with disabilities, convinced that diversity enriches and strengthens us as a team. This is why a valid disability certificate will be highly valued.

Keywords Studios is committed to fair and ethical hiring practices. We expect candidates to conduct themselves with honesty and to participate in all applications and interviews independently, presenting their own knowledge and experience. Candidates should refrain from using AI assistance or third-party tools or services that could influence, capture, or otherwise interfere with the authenticity of the assessment process.
