raw.description:
About Infiterra

Join our mission to grow and transform the subscription economy by simplifying subscription service delivery.

Infiterra enables IT distributors, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), and telcos to succeed in the subscription economy. Our subscription commerce platform automates and unifies subscription workflows - from quote to bill- driving operational efficiency, billing accuracy, and scalable growth.

Recognized as a global leader in subscription commerce, Infiterra combines innovation, performance excellence, and trusted expertise to help partners transform and grow.

About The Role

As a Senior AI Engineer, you will be part of R&D and will design, build, evaluate and operate production AI systems that solve meaningful product and engineering problems.

This is an Applied AI Engineering role combining deep AI specialization, strong software engineering and business/domain understanding. You will work across LLM-based systems, retrieval, agents, tool use, predictive techniques and model adaptation/fine-tuning where appropriate - choosing the approach based on the problem and evidence rather than defaulting to one AI technique.

You will take complex AI capabilities end-to-end: from understanding an ambiguous business problem, through experimentation and solution design, to implementation, evaluation, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.

This is a fully remote senior individual-contributor role based in either Greece or the UK, with periodic in-person collaboration.

Our AI engineering environment includes Python, cloud-native services, containers/Kubernetes, CI/CD, model APIs, retrieval and agent/tool frameworks, and evaluation/observability tooling. We choose technologies based on the problem rather than standardizing on one AI framework.

What You Will Work On

  • AI-native product engineering and knowledge systems that reconcile business knowledge from product, engineering and production evidence.

  • Automated and reusable vendor-integration capabilities, including the evolution of our Integration Hub from implementation automation toward learning from real integration outcomes.

  • AI-assisted software delivery: analysis, requirements, implementation, testing, knowledge reuse, code review and delivery acceleration.

  • AI-enabled quality and production intelligence, such as anomaly detection, failure-pattern analysis, data-quality/error detection and intelligent monitoring.

  • Predictive, analytical or model-adaptation capabilities where evidence shows they are the right solution.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you will have developed a strong understanding of our platform and domain, contributed materially to a production AI capability, established meaningful evaluation evidence around your work, and identified opportunities where AI can create measurable product or engineering leverage.

By six months, you will independently own one or more complex production AI systems or workflows - evaluated, observable and operationally reliable - and will have introduced reusable technical knowledge or practices that improve how the wider engineering team builds with AI.

Success is not measured by the number of AI features introduced. It is measured by business correctness, AI behavioural quality, engineering quality, production reliability and demonstrated value.

Who You Are

You are comfortable being given a business problem rather than a detailed technical specification. You can experiment quickly, but you also do the harder engineering work required to make AI behaviour measurable, reliable and maintainable in production. You understand that AI output is not automatically truth, make assumptions and limitations explicit, and design evaluation and human controls according to risk. You are equally comfortable discussing model behaviour, APIs and distributed-system failures as you are understanding the business rules the system is expected to support.

Responsibilities

  • Own the design, implementation, evaluation and production operation of complex AI systems involving multiple components, integrations or workflows.

  • Translate ambiguous business problems, rules and domain constraints into measurable AI/system behaviour.

  • Select the appropriate AI approach based on evidence - including prompting, retrieval, orchestration, predictive ML, model adaptation/fine-tuning or specialized models where justified.

  • Build production systems using model APIs, structured outputs, retrieval/RAG, agentic and tool-based workflows, predictive techniques and other appropriate AI patterns.

  • Design evaluation strategies covering functional behaviour, groundedness, business correctness, robustness and regressions.

  • Establish production monitoring and feedback loops using evaluation evidence, logs, metrics, traces and operational data.

  • Engineer for reliability, testability, observability, maintainability, latency and cost.

  • Design production learning loops and determine whether behaviour should be improved through context, retrieval, orchestration, model choice, adaptation/fine-tuning or other techniques.

  • Diagnose complex AI and software failures and convert production learning into prevention and system improvement.

  • Identify and validate AI-enabled improvements to SDLC, Product and operational workflows.

  • Explore AI-enabled platform-quality capabilities such as anomaly detection, data-quality/error detection, failure-pattern analysis and intelligent monitoring where they provide measurable value.

  • Work with Architecture, Platform, Security, Data, Quality, Product and domain specialists while retaining technical accountability for the AI capability within your scope.

  • Mentor less-experienced engineers and contribute reusable patterns, knowledge and practices.

Qualifications

Essential

  • AI systems: Strong hands-on experience delivering production AI systems; model APIs, structured outputs, tool-based systems, retrieval/RAG, agentic workflows, predictive techniques and model adaptation/fine-tuning where appropriate; able to select the appropriate AI approach based on problem context and evaluation evidence.

  • Evaluation: Experience designing behavioural, groundedness/business-correctness, robustness and regression evaluations, including production evaluation, monitoring and feedback loops.

  • Engineering: Strong software-engineering background, particularly Python; distributed systems, APIs, integrations, data pipelines, automated testing, CI/CD, containers/cloud and production-grade engineering practices.

  • Production: Strong observability and production troubleshooting skills including logs, metrics and traces; reliability, testability, latency/cost awareness and complex failure investigation.

  • Business/domain: Ability to understand complex workflows, business rules, dependencies and constraints and translate ambiguous business problems into reliable system behaviour.

  • Ownership: Demonstrated ability to take complex technical problems from discovery and experimentation through production and continuous improvement.

  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

Desirable

  • Experience with MCP or equivalent tool/context interoperability patterns.

  • Experience with orchestration technologies such as LangGraph, Temporal or equivalent.

  • Experience with model adaptation/fine-tuning or production predictive ML.

  • Experience building evaluation harnesses and datasets from real production/user feedback.

  • Experience with unstructured data and knowledge/retrieval systems at scale.

  • Working knowledge of AI security, privacy and responsible-AI practices.

  • Experience improving developer/product workflows through applied AI.

  • Experience with anomaly detection, intelligent monitoring or AI-assisted operational analysis.

Benefits

  • Work-from-anywhere scheme — plus regular team get-togethers in person, with travel and accommodation covered.

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Health and life insurance programme.

  • Learning & development budget.

  • Tech-driven, friendly team with an international mindset.

If you feel you’re a great fit, please apply! We’d love to hear from you!

All applications will be treated with confidentiality. Please note that due to the high volume of CVs received, only candidates who are a good fit will be contacted for an interview.

raw.description:
about us:

Spectrum.Life is a whole-of-health digital partner that guides organisations and their people to thrive, delivering clinically backed digital health, mental health and wellbeing solutions.

Our HealthTech delivers digital transformation for Insurers, Educators and Employers through Co-creation or seamlessly integrated out-of-the-box solutions, that decrease digital fragmentation and engage, empower, and transform their people’s lives.

Established in 2018 by Stuart McGoldrick and Stephen Costello, Spectrum.Life provides services internationally to over 7.2m insurance members, 3,000 corporate clients, 60 universities and 650,000 university students. Spectrum.Life currently employs over 450 people.

Our vision is to change and save as many lives as possible.

role brief:

The role of Adult, Children and Young People’s Digital Psychotherapist is suited to fully qualified and fully accredited psychotherapists. The Adult, Children and Young People’s Digital Psychotherapist is a key part of the Spectrum clinical team, providing access to evidence-based talking therapies to adults, children and young people, such as integrative psychotherapy pulling on techniques such as CBT and Goal Based Intervention (GBI) as clinically appropriate. Sessions are for adults aged 18 and over and for children and young people aged 6 to 17, last up to 50 minutes, are delivered online, and are booked through the member platform once our 24/7 clinical team has completed clinical triage and activated the service. Minimum of two to three years of post-qualification experience working with adults and children, adolescents, and families

responsibilities:

  • Provide goal-focused therapeutic support to adults, children, adolescents, using age- and developmentally appropriate interventions to address a range of emotional and psychological difficulties, including anxiety, depression, trauma, grief and complex presentations.
  • Conduct a comprehensive assessment at the start of each episode of care, building on the clinical triage completed by our 24/7 clinical team, to identify the individual's needs, developmental stage (for children and young people), risk factors, and protective factors, ensuring appropriate intervention strategies.
  • Deliver evidence-based psychological interventions, including but not limited to:
    • Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) for anxiety, depression, and trauma.
    • Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT) skills for emotional regulation and self-harm reduction.
    • Play Therapy and Art Therapy for younger children with attachment or developmental needs.
    • Family-Based Interventions (FBT, Systemic Therapy) for eating disorders, behavioural challenges, and family distress.
  • Provide immediate crisis interventions through telephone or video support, including risk assessment, suicide prevention strategies, and emotional regulation techniques.
  • Assess and manage risk effectively, identifying and escalating concerns related to self-harm, suicidal ideation, abuse, neglect, or exploitation in line with child protection procedures, adult safeguarding procedures and safeguarding policies.
  • Follow safeguarding protocols by recognising, reporting, and responding appropriately to child protection and adult safeguarding concerns, liaising with relevant agencies (e.g., TUSLA, education, and law enforcement).
  • Determine the appropriate service response level based on the severity and complexity of the individual's presenting difficulties, following case response level standards.
  • Work collaboratively with families, caregivers, and educational staff, where appropriate, to provide psychoeducation and support strategies that reinforce therapeutic goals.
  • Recommend liaison with multidisciplinary teams (MDTs), including social workers, psychiatrists, teachers, GPs, and other healthcare professionals, ensuring a holistic approach to care.
  • Maintain accurate, professional, and confidential clinical records, adhering to GDPR, service policies, and ethical guidelines for data protection on our internal clinical case management system.
  • Engage in research, evaluation, and clinical audits to support service development and ensure the continuous improvement of therapeutic outcomes.
  • Operate within all clinical governance frameworks, policies, and procedures, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and ethical guidelines.
  • Attend clinical supervision, safeguarding training, and CPD activities to maintain high standards of practice and stay updated on emerging evidence-based practices.
  • Contribute to service development and expansion, working on projects related to improving mental health provision for adults, children and young people, including digital innovations and accessibility.
  • Advocate for the needs and rights of adults, children and young people, ensuring interventions are inclusive, neuroaffirmative, culturally sensitive, and trauma-informed.
  • Deliver online sessions of up to 50 minutes to adults aged 18 and over and to children and young people aged 6 to 17 who have been triaged by our 24/7 clinical team and who book directly into your diary once the service has been activated for them.
  • Keep your availability up to date so that first appointments can be offered within 10 working days of clinical activation, in line with our agreed service levels.
  • For children and young people, work within our child and adolescent pathway, in which parental or guardian consent is embedded, and ensure consent is documented before therapy begins.
  • Apply our cancellation and missed-appointment policies
  • Make informed clinical decisions, including modality, session frequency and discharge, within our clinical governance framework.

requirements:

Essential Qualifications and Registration:

  • Full accredited membership with one of the following:
    • Irish Association for Counselling and Psychotherapy (IACP)
    • Irish Council for Psychotherapy
    • British Association of Behavioural and Cognitive Psychotherapy
    • Irish Association of Behavioural and Cognitive Psychotherapy
    • Chartered with Psychological Society of Ireland (PSI)
  • A clean record with the associated regulatory body
  • Accreditation and Training – Meets IACP requirements for working with adults and children, including:
    • Specialist training in child development, play therapy, systemic therapy, and legal aspects of child counselling.
    • Understanding of psychopharmacology relevant to the mental health of adults, children and young people.
    • Experience in practical, supervised training with children and adolescents.
  • A clean record with the associated regulatory body.
Essential Experience:
  • Experience and interest in working with adults, and with children and young people aged 6 to 17 years
  • Multidisciplinary Collaboration – Experience working with social workers, CAMHS, schools, and healthcare professionals to ensure holistic care.
  • Culturally Sensitive and Neuroaffirmative Practice – Experience working with diverse populations, including neurodivergent clients, LGBTQ+ youth, and children from different cultural backgrounds.
  • Innovation in Digital Mental Health – Experience in digital or hybrid therapy models, ensuring accessibility for clients of all ages.
Essential Knowledge and Skills:
  • Evidence-Based Interventions – Proficiency in delivering developmentally appropriate psychological integrative therapies, including:
    • Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT)
    • Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT) skills
    • Goal Based Interventions (GBI)
    • Play Therapy and Art Therapy
    • Family-Based Interventions (FBT, Systemic Therapy)
  • Child and Adolescent Development – Strong understanding of typical and atypical development, attachment theory, and neurodevelopmental conditions.
  • Crisis Intervention and Risk Management – Ability to assess and manage crisis situations, including self-harm, suicidal ideation, abuse, and neglect.
  • Child Protection and Safeguarding – In-depth knowledge of child protection laws, policies, and procedures, including the Children First Act and GDPR, and of adult safeguarding procedures.
  • Consent and Confidentiality – Understanding of legal and ethical responsibilities regarding consent and confidentiality for under-18s, including:
    • Parental/guardian consent processes
    • Contracting with families for therapy
    • Limits of confidentiality in safeguarding situations
  • Mandatory Reporting – Ability to identify, document, and escalate safeguarding concerns appropriately.
  • Clinical Governance and Record-Keeping – Adheres to professional and ethical guidelines, including GDPR, clinical documentation, and service policies.
  • Commitment to Continuous Professional Development (CPD) – Engages in regular CPD, supervision, and training to maintain accreditation and ensure best practice.
  • Building Rapport with Adults, Children and Adolescents – Skilled in adapting therapeutic approaches to meet the needs of each individual, including developmental needs.
  • Working with Families and Caregivers – Ability to provide psychoeducation, support strategies, and involve caregivers in the therapeutic process.
  • Research and Evaluation – Contributes to service audits, clinical evaluations, and outcome measures for continuous service improvement.
  • Multi-Agency Liaison and Advocacy – Advocates for the needs and rights of adults, children and young people, ensuring accessible, effective, and ethical care.
  • Strong understanding of clinical governance, GDPR, and safeguarding procedures.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a multidisciplinary team.
  • Ability to work afternoons and evenings,
  • Good computing skills: Microsoft software (e.g., Word, Excel, Teams), email, internet, video conferencing software, and clinical record-keeping software (we use Salesforce), including approved AI-assisted clinical transcription tools.
Values and Behaviours:

In addition to professional competency, the Adult, Children and Young People’s Digital Psychotherapist is expected to demonstrate the following:
  • Person-centred practice — keeping the voice, rights and wellbeing of the adults, children and young people we support at the heart of every decision, and advocating for them.
  • Commitment to psychological safety — creating conditions where adults, young people, families and colleagues can ask questions, raise concerns and disclose errors without fear of judgement.
  • Equity and inclusion — active attention to the needs of diverse populations, and neuroaffirmative, culturally sensitive and trauma-informed practice.
  • Data literacy — using outcome data and feedback as genuine quality improvement tools.
  • Collaborative practice — working openly with families, schools, the multidisciplinary team and partner agencies.
  • Commitment to the evidence base — maintaining fidelity to NICE guidelines and professional accreditation standards, and exercising independent clinical judgement within clinical governance frameworks.

what are the benefits of working at spectrum.life?

  • Competitive salary (dependent on experience).
  • Remote working
  • 25 days annual leave
  • 24/7 EAP and a wide range of health and wellbeing support
  • The opportunity to work in a strengths based and inclusive way and contribute to a bigger shift in changing societal attitudes towards mental health and wellbeing
  • Remote supervision
  • Opportunities to develop your skills and expertise through learning and training
  • The chance to contribute to the development and shaping of a new and exciting service
  • Extensive list of employee perks and benefits 
  • Technology that works with you; digital infrastructure designed to support clinical delivery and reduce administrative burden
  • Structured CPD programme with protected time for professional development and IACP accreditation maintenance

Job Title: Senior Director, Delivery Excellence

Job Location: Remote (US)

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:


The Senior Director, Delivery Excellence leads the delivery function for BeOne's global ERP Center of Excellence (CoE), focused on SAP. The role defines how ERP work is planned, staffed, executed, tested, validated, released, measured, and improved across functional, technical, architecture, business-facing technology, and partner teams.


The goal is simple: predictable delivery, measurable quality, controlled releases, and transparent resource utilization and capacity.


As a senior ERP CoE leader, the Senior Director builds and leads a global Delivery Excellence organization and drives end-to-end execution from intake through deployment and continuous improvement.



Essential Functions of the Job:


Delivery Operating Model


  • Define and continuously improve ERP delivery governance, roles, controls, and standards.
  • Implement end-to-end delivery ways of working that incorporate Agile principles to improve flow, transparency, responsiveness, and accountability.
  • Orchestrate end-to-end execution across the SAP Functional and Technical CoEs, from intake through stabilization.

Capacity & Portfolio Management


  • Maximize utilization of resources by aligning skills and capacity to prioritized demand and actively managing constraints and trade-offs.
  • Manage capacity elastically across internal teams, partners, and contingent resources; align commitments to available capacity.
  • Ensure team members charge time to projects accurately and capitalize eligible labor where appropriate, consistent with Finance policy.

Quality & Compliance


  • Lead test strategy, regression automation, quality gates, defect management, and quality metrics.
  • Embed GxP, computer system validation, and quality requirements into delivery using risk-based approaches and clear GxP/non-GxP scope.

Release, Lifecycle & Tooling


  • Own release calendars, environment coordination, deployment readiness, cutover governance, and upgrade/lifecycle planning.
  • Own JIRA/ALM workflows, data standards, dashboards, automation, and delivery reporting.

Performance & Continuous Improvement


  • Establish metrics for throughput, predictability, cycle time, quality, release performance, testing effectiveness, resource utilization, and capacity; turn insights into action.
  • Remove bottlenecks, simplify processes, expand automation, and drive adoption of standard ways of working.

Governance & Leadership


  • Partner with Enterprise Architecture and the Design Authority to reinforce standards, Clean Core, and cross-functional solution integrity.
  • Hold delivery partners accountable for quality, documentation, controls, performance, and knowledge transfer.
  • Build and lead a high-performing global Delivery Excellence team with clear accountability, development, and succession.

Supervisory Responsibilities:


  • Leads a global Delivery Excellence organization spanning delivery management, release and lifecycle management, quality/testing/validation, test automation, process and tooling, ALM/JIRA enablement, and delivery reporting.
  • Provides direct and matrix leadership, talent development, succession planning, and elastic workforce/capacity management across employees and contingent resources.

Required Education:


  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.


Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field with 12+ years of progressive enterprise technology, ERP delivery, applications, or program/portfolio management experience, including senior leadership in complex global environments or a Master's degree (preferred) with 10 + years of progressive enterprise technology, ERP delivery, applications, or program/portfolio management experience, including senior leadership in complex global environments.
  • Demonstrated experience leading large-scale SAP/ERP delivery organizations or transformation programs across functional, technical, testing, release, and operations teams.
  • Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA delivery lifecycles and dependencies across configuration, development, integration, security, Basis/platform, data, testing, and release management.
  • Proven experience with demand management, estimation, capacity planning, portfolio governance, resource allocation, and delivery performance management across concurrent initiatives.
  • Strong experience in quality engineering, enterprise testing strategy, regression automation, defect management, and release-quality metrics.
  • Experience in a regulated life sciences, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or similarly controlled environment; working knowledge of GxP and computer system validation strongly preferred.
  • Experience with JIRA and SAP-focused ALM platforms; strong use of data and metrics to drive decisions and continuous improvement.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, organizational change, and vendor management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead globally distributed teams and strategic service partners across geographies and time zones.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budgeting, resource planning, and balancing internal capacity with external services.
  • Ability to travel internationally as needed.


Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity

Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.


Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.


Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.


As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.


We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.


We are hiring an Analytics Manager to join the PSA team. This team is responsible for the strategy and execution of scaling the PSA business and new key strategic initiatives. This is a high impact role that will have exposure to all aspects of the business. The ideal candidate is an independent thinker with a bias for action, and is equal parts analytical, strategic, and entrepreneurial. This candidate will be familiar with core concepts across the technology landscape, and will have expertise in data modeling, marketing analytics and/or product analytics, and program management. Intellectual curiosity is a must, and prior experience or interest in D2C businesses is a bonus.

  • Conduct in-depth analyses to identify opportunities to optimize existing customer experience flows, identify new opportunities, and inform business strategy; synthesize findings and make recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Partner with data platform, engineering and product teams to define key metrics necessary to meet business objectives
  • Build automated reports and dashboards to evaluate business performance and provide actionable insights to executives and stakeholders

​

    • Marketplace or Ecommerce experience preferred
  • A marketplace or ecommerce background is a huge plus

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; highly organized and detail oriented

  • Highly autonomous, great with ambiguity, bias for action

Care Coordinator (CST) - Bilingual, Spanish

Location: Remote (must be located in CST)

Who We Are:

Tuesday Health is a value-based palliative care provider group dedicated to transforming serious illness and end-of-life care. We deliver goal-centered care focused on alleviating physical symptoms and emotional stress for individuals and their caregivers. Our interdisciplinary care teams reduce avoidable hospitalizations and improve quality of life wherever individuals call home. Through our leading-edge care model, Tuesday Health is shaping the future of community-based palliative care nationwide.

The Role:

The Care Coordinator is responsible for facilitating conversations and collaboration between interdisciplinary care teams including complex care navigators, health plan care managers, primary care providers, and specialists. The Care Coordinator supports the scheduling process, makes reminder calls, facilitates collaboration with health plan clinicians, and works cross-functionally to provide a seamless patient experience. As a patient-facing role, the ability to foster patient relationships through empathy and striving to provide a patient-centered experience at every contact is critical.

Key responsibilities of this role may include:

  • Support scheduling for Complex Care Navigators
  • Make patient reminder calls
  • Facilitate collaboration with health plan care managers
  • Ensure proper documentation of all patient contacts
  • Support outreach and navigation teams with operational and non-clinical tasks
  • Answer patient calls and appropriately transfer escalated patient issues, ensuring the appropriate resources are involved
  • Identify and request necessary patient documentation from patients and community providers
  • Other duties may be assigned

A strong candidate will demonstrate the following:

  • Required Qualifications:
    • Bilingual in Spanish
    • High School Diploma / GED (or higher)
    • Experience with escalated customer service issue resolution
    • Knowledge of Microsoft Office products – Microsoft Word (create and edit correspondence), Microsoft Outlook (email and calendar management), Microsoft PowerPoint (ability to create and edit slides) – and proficiency in Microsoft Excel (ability to create, edit, and sort spreadsheets, basic analytical formulas (VLOOKUP, if)
    • Phone/Fax system experience
    • EMR experience
  • Preferred Qualifications
    • Associates Degree or higher
    • Typing speed of 40+ WPM
    • Experience as a Medical Assistant, Certified Nursing Assistant, Pharmacy Tech, or other clinical or administrative role in a health care setting

Skills:

  • Operational and Technical Skills – Supports operational process improvement; understand market and optimizes clinician travel to home/facility visits; able to navigate clinical management system
  • Customer Service – Puts the patient first and delivers a high level of customer service and professionalism in all interactions
  • Interpersonal Skills – Focuses on solving conflict; listens to others; remains open to new ideas
  • Oral Communication – Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; listens and seeks clarification; responds openly to questions. Must be able to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events
  • Dependability – Follows instructions, responds to management direction; takes responsibility for own actions; keeps commitments; completes tasks on time or notifies appropriate person with an alternate plan
  • Initiative – Solution-oriented, asks for and offers help when needed; generates suggestions for improving work and workflow

What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation, reflecting our commitment to attracting, retaining, and motivating the best talent in the industry
  • Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, paid time off and holidays, employer 401(K) match, etc.
  • Remote work with multiple onsite sessions each year to maximize collaboration and team building
  • A dynamic and inclusive team environment where you can lean on your teammates, offer candid feedback, bring your true self to work each day, and deliver tremendous impact while having fun along the way
  • Meaningful work each day; we care deeply about our mission, our patients, and each other

Tuesday Health seeks to recruit and retain staff from diverse backgrounds and encourages qualified candidates to apply. Tuesday Health is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, sex, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, color, race, creed, national origin, ancestry, religion, marital status, political belief, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, military, or veteran status.

Cardinal Health Sonexus™ Access and Patient Support helps specialty pharmaceutical manufacturers remove barriers to care so that patients can access, afford and remain on the therapy they need for a better quality of life. Our diverse expertise in pharma, payer and hub services allows us to deliver best-in-class solutions—driving brand and patient markers of success. We’re continuously integrating advanced and emerging technologies to streamline patient onboarding, qualification and adherence. Our non-commercial specialty pharmacy is centralized at our custom-designed facility outside of Dallas, Texas, empowering manufacturers to rethink the reach and impact of their products.

Together, we can get life-changing therapies to patients who need them—faster.

What Customer Service Management contributes to Cardinal Health

Customer Service Leadership is responsible for strategic oversight and management of personnel directly interacting with external groups including but not limited to patients, caregivers, healthcare providers, insurance providers, and pharmaceutical clients.

Job Summary

The Supervisor, Access and Patient Support will oversee program staff performing customer service, enrollment and reimbursement activities, benefit investigations for pharmacy benefit coverage, prior authorization assistance, copay enrollment and other hub services. The supervisor will be serving clients with advanced therapies and unique patient journeys.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in related field, or equivalent work experience, preferred
  • 2-3 years proven experience in a leadership position within a call center preferred, exposure to customer service
  • Strong communication and customer service skills, (written and verbal)
  • Excellent leadership, troubleshooting, time management, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to prioritize multiple, concurrent assignments and work with a sense of urgency
  • Highly organized by utilizing time management skills
  • Commitment to the continued development of oneself and team members
  • Ability to lead and engage remote employees
  • Shift flexibility required if coverage is needed on an early/later shift

What is expected of you and others at this level

  • Consistently demonstrate Cardinal Health values (What we value): Integrity – We hold ourselves to the highest ethical standard Accountable – We bring passion, determination, and grit to deliver on our commitments Inclusive – We embrace differences to drive the best outcomes Mission Driven – We serve the greater goal of healthcare Innovative – We develop new ways of thinking, operating, and serving customers
  • Regularly practice the Cardinal Heath behaviors (The way we act): Invites curiosity Builds partnerships Inspires commitment Develops self and others

Responsibilities

  • Collaboratively oversees daily operations for an inbound and outbound patient access support team.
  • Ability to maintain development/training goals for team members in a 100% remote setting.
  • Responsible for creating and maintaining Standard Operating Procedures and work instructions & metrics specific to the program.

  • Responsible for managing Workday tasks; approvals timecards, PTO, etc.
  • Comply with all Local, State, and Federal laws and regulations as they pertain to services provided by the Company. This includes supporting and demonstrating compliance with the Company’s Compliance and HIPAA Plans.

  • Other duties as assigned.

TRAINING AND WORK SCHEDULES: Your new hire training will take place 8:00am-5:00pm CT the first week of employment. Attendance is mandatory.

This position is full-time (40 hours/week). Employees are required to have flexibility to work a scheduled shift of 7am-7pm CT.

REMOTE DETAILS: All U.S. residents are eligible to apply to this position. You will work remotely, full-time. It will require a dedicated, quiet, private, distraction free environment with access to high-speed internet. We will provide you with the computer, technology and equipment needed to successfully perform your job. You will be responsible for providing high-speed internet. Internet requirements include the following:

Maintain a secure, high-speed, broadband internet connection (DSL, Cable, or Fiber) at the remote location. Dial-up, satellite, WIFI, Cellular connections are NOT acceptable. Download speed of 15Mbps (megabyte per second)

  • Upload speed of 5Mbps (megabyte per second)

Application window anticipated to close: 12/11/2026 if interested in opportunity, please submit application as soon as possible.

The salary range listed is an estimate. Pay at Cardinal Health is determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s geographical location, relevant education, experience and skills and an evaluation of internal pay equity.

Cardinal Health supports an inclusive workplace that values diversity of thought, experience and background. Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io.

At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career.

Enterprise Revenue Architects at Gong are strategic partners to our largest customers. Focused on driving revenue transformation from Gong’s AI Operating System. You’ll guide executive stakeholders and operational teams to drive revenue with Gong by architecting workflows, accelerating adoption, and realizing business results across the entire revenue lifecycle.

You will combine a deep understanding of how revenue teams operate with leading change management strategy to help customers operationalise the use of Gong into tangible business results. Your success is measured by activation and adoption, key persona engagement, customer value realization, and revenue impact (retention and expansion).

RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Team Leadership & Coaching: Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing team of Revenue Architects. Provide consistent coaching on account strategy, executive presence, and value realization.
  • Revenue Transformation Strategy: Partner with senior GTM leaders to design and oversee the execution of strategies that modernize their revenue operations through Gong’s AIOS. Develop a distinct point of view for how Gong drives these outcomes for customers specifically in the financial services and healthcare industries.
  • Workflow Architecture Oversight: Guide your team in mapping current-state customer processes to AI-driven workflows that translate to revenue outcomes.
  • Adoption and Change Management: Drive adoption initiatives that foster behavior change and embed Gong into daily team rhythms across the Enterprise customer segment.
  • Value Realization: Empower your team to use data-driven insights to quantify measurable business outcomes that demonstrate Gong’s ROI and strategic value.
  • Renewal and Expansion Management: Own the aggregate renewal strategy and execution for the team, partnering with cross-functional leaders on growth and NDR.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with internal leadership teams (Product, Sales, Marketing) to ensure an exceptional and seamless customer experience throughout the entire journey.
  • Adoption & Usage: Drive focus on adoption and usage to accelerate time-to-value for enterprise accounts, ensuring strong retention and expansion outcomes.
QUALIFICATIONS
  • 2+ years of direct people management experience leading Customer Success, Account Management, or Professional Services teams in a B2B SaaS company.
  • 6–10+ years of total proven experience in customer-facing roles (CSM, AM, Implementation, or similar).

  • Proven track record of coaching others to own relationships with senior (VP and C-suite) stakeholders and lead value/ROI conversations.
  • Passion for driving customer centricity by leveraging internal stakeholders such as Sales, Product, Support, Marketing, and executives.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence at the leadership level.
  • Data-driven mindset with a focus on delivering measurable outcomes and tracking team-wide KPIs.
  • Passion for driving customer outcomes and contributing to a high-performing and accountable work culture.
  • Our Managers are self-starters who excel in high-paced environments and thrive in change and ambiguity. Our top leaders have a growth mindset, pride themselves in being coachable, and are dedicated to winning together, enjoying the ride, and challenging conventional wisdom. If that’s you too, we want to hear from you!

  • Wellbeing Fund - flexible wellness stipend to support a healthy lifestyle.
  • Mental Health benefits with covered therapy and coaching.

  • Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend.

raw.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101496

Sr. Program Manager, Flow Growth (Flow Studio & Flow Capture)


Position Overview

Do you thrive at the intersection of strategy and execution? Can you take a big growth ambition, break it into a clear operating rhythm, and keep a room full of sales, marketing, strategy, and analytics partners moving in the same direction? Do you get energized by helping build something new? If so, this might be the opportunity for you!

Autodesk Flow is our industry cloud for Media & Entertainment, connecting artists, productions, and studios from first frame to final pixel. Two of its fastest growing businesses are Flow Capture, our secure, cloud-based camera-to-cloud dailies and review solution connecting production and post, and Flow Studio, our AI-powered toolset that turns live-action footage into editable CG scenes and helps creators move from idea to final frame faster. Both sit at the center of how content is being made today, and both have a significant opportunity to scale.

To capture that opportunity, the Director of Sales, Flow is standing up two Cross-Functional Growth Teams, one dedicated to Flow Studio and one dedicated to Flow Capture. Each brings together partners from Sales, Marketing, Strategy, and Analytics who share accountability for scaling these businesses. We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to serve as the Sales Director's right hand in building and running these teams. You will help shape the operating model from the ground up, then own the program management that keeps both teams focused, aligned, and delivering.

In this role you will be at the center of it all, working closely with the Director and senior leaders across Go-To-Market, Product, Marketing, Sales, Strategy, and Business Analytics. You will use your analytical mindset and strong program leadership to bring structure, clear accountabilities, and decision ownership to the work, and you will keep stakeholders engaged with regular communication on progress, risks, and wins. This role reports to the Director of Sales, Flow.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with the Director of Sales, Flow to stand up the Flow Studio and Flow Capture Growth Teams, helping define charters, roles and responsibilities, and decision rights
  • Own the program management for both teams: planning cycles, meeting cadence, business reviews, quarterly priorities, and retrospectives
  • Translate the Director's growth strategy into executable plans with clear goals, milestones, owners, and measures, and track progress against them
  • Partner with Analytics to define and maintain the KPIs that matter for scale (pipeline, ACV/ARR, conversion, adoption, expansion, retention), giving the teams and leadership a single source of truth
  • Coordinate key go-to-market workstreams across functions, such as segment and market prioritization, campaigns, pricing and packaging inputs, partner and channel motions, and sales enablement
  • Identify dependencies, risks, and blockers across teams, drive issues to resolution, and bring the right decisions to the Director at the right time
  • Prepare the Director for leadership reviews and develop executive communications that deliver the right level of detail for each audience, from team working sessions to senior leadership and business-wide updates
  • Proactively spot opportunities to improve efficiency, accountability, and operational excellence, and codify what works so the model can scale as the businesses grow
  • Build strong alliances and foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and trust across every team you touch

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in program management, project management, or PMO roles, managing complex cross-functional programs with senior stakeholders
  • Experience building new programs, teams, or operating models from the ground up
  • Proven experience leading go-to-market or revenue growth programs that span Sales, Marketing, Strategy, and Analytics, including defining the plan, not just executing it
  • Experience partnering closely with a senior leader as a trusted advisor, chief of staff, or program lead
  • A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership, a bias for action, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves
  • Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with comfort defining metrics and using data to drive decisions
  • Ability to influence without authority in a matrixed environment
  • A consummate planner who stays cool and calm in high-stakes situations and thrives at taming complexity
  • Demonstrated executive presence and exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
  • BA/BS or equivalent work experience
  • Able to travel up to 20%

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a startup or high-growth business, with comfort operating in an unstructured environment and leading through ambiguity
  • Experience in Media & Entertainment, creative tools, or production technology
  • Experience scaling SaaS, cloud, or AI-powered products, ideally emerging or high-growth businesses
  • Familiarity with subscription business metrics (ARR, ACV, NRR, pipeline coverage) and sales motions (direct, inside, channel, self-serve)
  • Strong financial acumen
  • Experience with program management and collaboration tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Jira, Asana, Power BI, Tableau)

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Benefits

From health and financial benefits to time away and everyday wellness, we give Autodeskers the best, so they can do their best work. Learn more about our benefits in the U.S. by visiting

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For U.S.-based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $102,000 and $182,710. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Equal Employment Opportunity

At Autodesk, we're building a diverse workplace and an inclusive culture to give more people the chance to imagine, design, and make a better world. Autodesk is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic. We also consider for employment all qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable law.


Belonging

We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here:


In-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification

This role may require in-person onboarding and/or in-person ID verification.

Why Join Keypath?

The Opportunity

As a Paid Media Specialist at Keypath Education, you'll play a pivotal role in driving student enrolment outcomes for leading university partners across the APAC region.

Working within a high-performing digital marketing team, you'll design, execute and optimise paid media campaigns across search, social and emerging digital channels, using data, automation and AI-powered technologies to maximise performance and return on investment.

Company: TurFresh

Reports to: Growth Operations Manager

Type: Full-time

Location: Remote, with working overlap with U.S. Pacific Time business hours

Compensation: to be defined

About TurFresh

TurFresh is a professional artificial turf cleaning and pet odor removal company serving homeowners and businesses in 22 U.S. metro areas, with more than 150,000 jobs completed. Customers find us on Google, on social media and through reviews, and they trust us when they see real work from real technicians.

The role

    You are TurFresh's voice in public. You run our social channels as a community manager: you write the posts, talk with our community, listen to what people say about us and our category, and own our reputation on review sites. Strong writing is at the core of this job.

    TurFresh already has graphic design and creative resources, so this is not a design role. You brief them on what you need, and you can make basic edits yourself when it's faster (crop, resize, change text on a template, trim a clip). You work alongside AI agents that draft calendars, captions and review replies, and your judgment decides what goes live. This is a hands-on seat: you will be in the tools every day.

What you'll do

    1. Own reviews and reputation

    • Respond to every review on Google Business Profile, Yelp and Birdseye within 48 hours, in a voice that sounds human and local. Use approved guidelines and AI-drafted replies that you review and edit.

    • Handle negative reviews and public complaints with care: acknowledge, take the conversation offline and escalate to Customer Service for resolution. A public reply never replaces fixing the customer's problem.

    • Write and maintain our review response guidelines: tone, replies by scenario, what never to say and when to escalate.

    • Work with Customer Service on review generation, so more happy customers leave a review after a job.

    • Track rating, review volume, response rate and recurring themes by location; flag at-risk locations and brand risks early.

    • Profile data, NAP, categories and citations stay with our SEO and Local SEO team.

    1. Build and manage the community

    • Answer comments, DMs and mentions on our channels with a consistent, helpful voice.

    • Monitor conversations about TurFresh, competitors and turf care in local groups, Reddit and review sites, and join them when it helps.

    • Route every sales or service inquiry to our Customer Service team in GoHighLevel and confirm it was received.

    • Send a weekly listening digest: recurring questions, objections, complaints, competitor moves and content ideas.

    1. Write and run the channels

    • Turn the content pillars set by our Content & Campaign Strategist into a weekly channel calendar: formats, series and timing.

    • Write the posts: hooks, captions, story text and calls to action, adapted to each channel's tone.

    • Brief our creative resources on the visuals you need and make basic edits yourself when it's faster.

    • Coordinate field capture with our technicians shot lists, what to film and how to send it.

    • Schedule and publish in GoHighLevel Social Planner (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube); verify every post is live, links work and UTM tags are in place. Fix publishing issues or escalate them with evidence.

    1. Work with AI agents and measure

    • Review and approve agent outputs (calendar drafts, caption variations, reply drafts, weekly reports) and improve prompts, brand voice rules and the prompt library.

    • Report weekly on what was published and what performed, with organic and paid separate, tracked clicks and inquiries handed to Sales.

    • Propose and run copy and format tests, and record what you learn.

What you bring

    • 3+ years managing social media and online communities for a brand or agency, ideally in home services, local services or multi-location businesses.

    • Excellent written English: clear, warm, persuasive copy with a natural tone for U.S. homeowners. This is the most important skill for the role.

    • Proven community management: you have grown engagement and kept a busy inbox of comments and DMs under control.

    • Reputation management experience: responding to reviews at scale on Google Business Profile, Yelp or Birdseye, with sound judgment on negative reviews and public complaints. Multi-location experience is a plus.

    • Social listening experience, using native tools or platforms such as Sprout Social or Brand24.

    • Results you can show with numbers: channels you grew and posts that performed.

    • Basic visual editing (Canva, CapCut or similar) to adjust templates and trim clips. You don't need to be a designer.

    • Comfort using AI as a drafting partner while keeping quality, accuracy and brand judgment your own.

    • Organized and self-directed: you close the loop on your own work and escalate early, with a recommendation.

Nice to have

    • Experience with GoHighLevel

    • Birdseye or another review management platform

    • Experience writing ad copy for Meta

    • UGC and creator-style content

    • experience with pet-owner audiences

What success looks like in the first 90 days

    • Days 1–30: access to every channel and tool confirmed; baseline set for each channel and for rating, review volume and response rate by location; review queue at zero with the 48-hour response time running; first draft of the review response guidelines.

    • Days 31–60: the agreed weekly cadence published on time for four consecutive weeks; review response guidelines approved; first weekly listening digest and reputation report by location delivered; review generation routine agreed with Customer Service.

    • Days 61–90: AI drafting workflow running for calendar, captions and review replies, with your approval on every item; at least two copy or format tests completed with findings; every inquiry from social and reviews handed to Sales with confirmation.

Selection process: written test

    The test is about writing and judgment, not design. Using sample photos, clips and brand templates that we provide, you will:

    1. Write one week of posts for Instagram, Facebook and TikTok (hooks, captions and calls to action), with one line on why each post should work.

    1. Reply to three reviews (5-star, 3-star and a 1-star complaint), to one DM asking for a price and to one public complaint in the comments.

    1. Write a half-page listening read: what people ask about turf cleaning and how we should respond.

    1. Optional: make a basic edit to one of our templates or clips.

    We look at writing quality, judgment on sensitive replies and how you use AI, not at design skills or tool familiarity.

How to apply

    Send your resume, plus:

    • Channels you managed: a portfolio of channels or profiles you manage now or managed before, with the progress you drove and proof of performance (for example follower and engagement growth, reach, leads, review rating or response time).

    • Posts that performed: a portfolio of posts you wrote or built that had high engagement or performance, with the thinking behind each one. We want the posts and your reasoning, not graphic design work.

    • A reputation example: one review, complaint or reputation situation you handled: what happened, what you wrote and the result.

TurFresh shares a recruiting platform with our sister company, Express Chipping. As a result, you may see the Express Chipping name in the application URL or automated communications. This position is exclusively with TurFresh.

About the team

The Business Communications team sits within Zillow’s Corporate Affairs organization. It connects each line of business to the rest of Corporate Affairs. The team sets the communications strategy for its businesses and works closely with the media relations, owned content and events teams, so that every launch, announcement and moment of change lands as one coordinated effort.

About the role

The Business Communications team is the layer that connects each line of business to the rest of the Corporate Affairs team. As Sr. Manager, Business Communications for Zillow’s agent and broker businesses, you’ll be the single comms point of contact for GMs and product leaders. You’re accountable for the whole picture, rather than handing them off to several channel teams.


You’ll own the overall narrative and strategy, set priorities, decide the order when demands compete, and run point as strategic PM across media relations, owned content and events. This is a strategy-and-orchestration role, not a hands-on channel role. You won’t pitch reporters or draft content yourself. You’ll set the direction the channel teams build against and keep the work connected.


The agent and broker businesses are technical and high-stakes, and the people you're communicating to are professionals who pay for our products and know this industry as well as you do. The right person has done comms for a business like this before: close to the customer, often touching product, legal, and policy at once, and knows how to guide a large customer base through complicated change while keeping the message clear and credible.


This is a senior role that requires both strategic altitude and operational fluency. You'll hold peer relationships with director-level business stakeholders, represent your businesses back into Corporate Affairs leadership, and be the connective tissue between Zillow's agent and broker priorities and the full suite of comms channels and capabilities.


You will get to:

  • Set the overall communications strategy and narrative for Zillow’s agent and broker businesses, including the high-level messaging, the priorities and the order of work when demands compete.
  • Run point as strategic PM across media relations, owned content and events: set the plan, assign lanes and keep the overall effort coherent.
  • Make sure the business hears from one comms partner and that messages stay aligned across channels and teams.
  • Stay close to the product roadmap and business context so you can anticipate what’s coming and brief channel teams before they need to ask.
  • Work across the organization to find and act on new opportunities, showing what a “big idea” looks like and how to bring it to life.
  • Bring agent and broker priorities to the owned content team, and make sure customer proof points and partner stories are ready when a launch or announcement needs them.
  • Develop issue-specific messaging for agent- and broker-facing frontline teams on sensitive or complex topics. Run messaging trainings, and help business leaders train their own orgs when needed.
  • Identify executive visibility opportunities tied to agent and broker priorities, and work with the broader Communications team to carry them out.
  • Serve as the senior comms contact for agent and broker business leaders: a peer to directors and a trusted resource to VPs and GMs.
  • Represent your businesses clearly and persuasively to Corporate Affairs leadership, including the VP and SVP.
  • Build trusted relationships with product, marketing, legal and other partner teams that move this work forward.
  • Track and report on key metrics across projects, and use results and lessons learned to inform future planning and business decisions.
This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $136,700.00 - $218,300.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $129,800.00 - $207,400.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • You bring 10+ years of communications experience, including comms for a technical, customer-facing business where product, legal and policy often intersect.
  • You have developed and owned a communications strategy yourself, rather than only carrying out one someone else built, and you can guide channel teams toward effective tactics.
  • You can create clarity from ambiguity, sequence competing priorities, and hold the thread across a complex, multi-channel effort and guides channel teams to develop effective tactics

ServiceNow Application Developer

Astreya | Full-Time | ServiceNow Platform Team — ITSM · HAM · SAM


About the Role

Astreya is building ServiceNow into the day-to-day operating platform for our service delivery teams (Fulfillers) across IT Service Management (ITSM), Hardware Asset Management (HAM), and Software Asset Management (SAM). Our ServiceNow Process Advisors define what belongs on the platform, how processes should work, and the governance guardrails the build must follow. We are hiring a ServiceNow Application Developer to turn those designs into working, supportable platform capability.

This is a hands-on build role. You will take approved process designs — intake structures, catalog items, fulfillment workflows, asset lifecycle processes, CMDB data standards — and implement them on the platform: configuring, scripting, testing, and releasing. You will work day-to-day with the Process Advisor, who acts as the process authority for the program, and you will be expected to build to the agreed design rather than around it — favoring out-of-the-box capability and configuration over customization, and raising a flag when a requested build conflicts with the platform’s guardrails or long-term maintainability.

What You Will Do

  • Build to design: Implement approved process designs across ITSM (Incident Management, Request Fulfillment, Service Catalog items, RITM/SCTASK structures, SLA definitions), HAM (asset lifecycle, stockroom and inventory processes), and SAM (software requests, entitlements, license allocation, reclamation workflows).
  • Platform development: Configure and develop on the platform using Flow Designer, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, script includes, notifications, ACLs, and Service Portal / Employee Center configuration — using JavaScript and Glide APIs where scripting is genuinely required.
  • CMDB and data model: Implement and maintain the agreed CMDB and asset data model: CI classes, Asset–CI relationships, identification and reconciliation rules, and data quality jobs, in line with the data standards set by the Process Advisor.
  • Integrations: Build and maintain integrations with adjacent systems (e.g., procurement, discovery, HR, endpoint management) using IntegrationHub, REST APIs, and import sets / transform maps.
  • Quality and release: Write and maintain Automated Test Framework (ATF) coverage for what you build; follow update set / source control discipline, instance hygiene, and release practices across dev, test, and production.
  • Guardrail discipline: Prefer configuration over customization; document every deviation from out-of-the-box behavior and its rationale. Surface conflicts between requested builds and platform guardrails to the Process Advisor and platform owner before building.
  • Fulfiller experience: Support the teams who live in the platform: tune forms, views, and queues for Fulfiller productivity, fix defects quickly, and turn recurring pain points into small platform improvements.
  • Documentation: Maintain clear technical documentation — configuration records, integration specs, runbooks — so what you build is supportable by others.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–6 years of hands-on ServiceNow development and configuration experience, with at least one substantial implementation or major module rollout delivered end-to-end.
  • Strong working knowledge of ITSM applications (Incident, Request, Service Catalog, SLAs) and practical exposure to HAM and/or SAM modules, CMDB structures, and the Asset vs. CI distinction.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript and ServiceNow Glide APIs (GlideRecord, GlideAjax, GlideSystem), Flow Designer, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, and ACLs.
  • Experience building integrations via REST/SOAP, IntegrationHub, and import sets / transform maps.
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification.
  • Disciplined delivery habits: update set / source control hygiene, testing before release, and documentation as part of done — not an afterthought.
  • Ability to work from written process designs and governance standards, ask sharp clarifying questions, and communicate clearly with non-technical process owners.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in ITSM, HAM, or SAM; CAD (Certified Application Developer) is a plus.
  • Experience with Automated Test Framework (ATF), Performance Analytics, or Service Portal / Employee Center customization.
  • Exposure to Discovery, asset integrations (procurement, endpoint management), or software license management tooling.
  • ITIL 4 Foundation certification, or equivalent grounding in ITIL-aligned processes.
  • Experience in managed services or IT services environments where SLA performance directly drives client outcomes.

How This Role Fits

  • You will work alongside a senior ServiceNow Process Advisor (consulting) who owns process design and scoping decisions — what goes into ServiceNow and what stays out. You own the build.
  • You report into Astreya’s ServiceNow platform / program leadership and work daily with operations, service delivery, and asset management stakeholders.
  • Over time, you will become the go-to platform builder for the Fulfiller organization as ServiceNow becomes their primary day-to-day toolset.

Astreya is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.
