raw.excerpt: Who We AreImprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

As a Staff Product Designer, you'll shape the future of Imprint's member experiences, leading complex product initiatives from discovery through execution. You'll combine exceptional design craft with strategic thinking and strong product judgment to identify opportunities, simplify complex problems, and deliver intuitive, high-impact solutions. Partnering closely with Product and Engineering, you'll influence product direction, champion exceptional user experiences, and raise the bar for design craft, collaboration, and decision-making across the organization.

What You’ll Do

Shape Product Strategy & Direction

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to identify high-impact opportunities grounded in customer needs, business goals, and product insights.

  • Proactively define problems, challenge assumptions, and influence product priorities and direction.

  • Lead complex, ambiguous initiatives from early discovery through launch and iteration.

  • Balance near-term product improvements with longer-term opportunities to meaningfully improve the customer experience.

  • Bring clarity and structure to ambiguous problems, helping teams make thoughtful decisions and move forward.

Lead End-to-End Product Design

  • Own the design process from discovery and concept exploration through detailed interaction design, prototyping, and delivery.

  • Translate complex financial products and workflows into simple, intuitive, and engaging experiences.

  • Explore multiple approaches, establish clear design principles, and articulate the rationale behind decisions.

  • Create thoughtful, high-quality experiences that balance usability, accessibility, business objectives, and technical feasibility.

  • Partner with Engineering throughout implementation to ensure the quality and integrity of the shipped experience.

  • Use research, data, and customer feedback to validate solutions and continuously improve the product.

Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Build strong, trusted partnerships with Product Managers and Engineers, operating as an equal partner in shaping product outcomes.

  • Facilitate collaborative problem-solving, bringing teams together around shared goals and thoughtful solutions.

  • Navigate competing priorities and constraints, making pragmatic tradeoffs without losing sight of the customer experience.

  • Communicate design decisions clearly and persuasively, building alignment across stakeholders and leadership.

  • Take shared ownership of product outcomes, not just design deliverables.

Elevate Design Quality & Team Impact

  • Set a high bar for UX craft, interaction design, and the overall quality of our product experiences.

  • Contribute to a culture of thoughtful critique, continuous learning, and collaborative problem-solving.

  • Mentor and support other designers and teammates, helping strengthen their craft, judgment, and strategic thinking.

  • Identify opportunities and propose solutions to improve design practices, workflows, and collaboration across the organization.

  • Contribute to the evolution and adoption of our design system, balancing consistency with opportunities for innovation.

Explore the Future of Product Design

  • Embrace emerging AI tools and workflows to accelerate discovery, exploration, prototyping, and execution.

  • Experiment with new ways of working that increase design velocity without compromising quality.

  • Help shape how Design collaborates with Product and Engineering as AI transforms the product development process.

  • Bring curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to challenge traditional approaches to designing and building software.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 7+ years of product design experience, with a track record of leading complex, high-impact initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration.

  • Exceptional UX and interaction design skills, demonstrated through strong craft, thoughtful problem-solving, and measurable outcomes.

  • Strong product judgment, connecting customer needs with business goals and balancing near-term improvements with long-term vision.

  • Proven experience independently identifying opportunities, framing problems, exploring compelling solutions, and influencing product direction.

  • Strong partnership with Product and Engineering to navigate ambiguity, evaluate tradeoffs, and prioritize solutions based on impact and effort.

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, articulating design rationale, building alignment, and influencing stakeholders at all levels.

  • A pragmatic, iterative approach to design, balancing speed and quality, incorporating feedback, and thoughtfully phasing solutions to deliver value over time.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing complex financial products, consumer fintech experiences, or regulated workflows.

  • Experience working in fast-moving, high-growth startup environments.

  • Experience evolving and scaling design systems, identifying opportunities to improve patterns, strengthen consistency, and contribute to a more cohesive product experience.

  • Familiarity with experimentation, product analytics, and research-driven design.

  • Experience using AI-assisted design, prototyping, or development tools.

  • Familiarity with frontend technologies and modern design-to-development workflows.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12 months:

  • You've led meaningful product initiatives from problem definition through launch, delivering measurable customer and business impact.

  • You've built trusted partnerships with Product, Engineering, Commercial, and other stakeholders, helping shape priorities and improve product decisions.

  • You've introduced thoughtful, innovative and intuitive solutions to complex customer problems while maintaining a high bar for usability and craft.

  • You've helped the team move faster and make better decisions through clear design rationale, effective collaboration, and pragmatic execution.

  • You've elevated the quality of design across the team through mentorship, critique, and shared practices, and contribution to our design system.

  • You've helped evolve how we design and build products, embracing new tools and approaches that increase our effectiveness.

We don't expect every candidate to check every box. If this role excites you and you bring strong fundamentals, we encourage you to apply.

Stack

Figma, Storybook, design tokens. Frontend component libraries (React/TypeScript). AI-assisted design and development tooling.

Learn More

Learn more about how we build at Imprint on our engineering blog:

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Leading configured work computers of your choice

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

  • Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA

  • 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

  • Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

Compensation Range: $190K - $250K

About DirectMeds

At DirectMeds, we prioritize care, trust, and solutions that focus on the individual. Headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, we are a fast-growing national team passionate about transforming the way people access the care they need. If you're driven by purpose and excited by growth, Direct Meds is the place to be.

Fulfillment Care Specialist – Remote

Compensation & Schedule

  • Hourly Base Pay Range: $22-24 per hour
  • Location: Remote
  • Employment Type: Full-Time
  • Department: Customer Care
  • Schedule: Shifts available within 7:00 AM–7:00 PM MST, seven days a week
  • Start Date: As soon as possible
  • Training Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:00 PM MST
  • Training Period: Standard training program followed by two additional weeks of specialized training with the Fulfillment/Logistics team for external hires.

Note: The hourly pay range listed above represents a good-faith estimate of the minimum and maximum target for this position. Actual compensation offered may vary depending on the candidate's geographic location, job-related skills, experience, and education.

About DirectMeds

At DirectMeds, we prioritize care, trust, and solutions that focus on the individual. Headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, we are a fast-growing national team passionate about transforming the way people access the care they need. If you're driven by purpose and excited by growth, Direct Meds is the place to be.

About the Role

The Fulfillment Care Specialist plays an important role in ensuring patients receive the support they need when shipping or delivery concerns arise.

In this position, you'll investigate shipment issues, coordinate with pharmacies and logistics partners, communicate directly with patients, and take ownership of escalations from start to resolution.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems, uncovering details, and making a difference through clear communication and dependable follow-through.

The Ideal Candidate

You're someone who:

  • Takes ownership of challenges and sees them through to resolution.
  • Enjoys investigating issues, finding answers, and identifying solutions.
  • Communicates clearly, professionally, and with empathy.
  • Notice small details that others may overlook.
  • Remains calm and organized while managing multiple priorities.
  • Works independently while collaborating effectively with others.
  • Understands the importance of timely communication and accurate follow-through.
  • Has a genuine desire to help patients and deliver exceptional service.

What You'll Do

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Manage shipping-related escalations involving delayed, lost, damaged, or incomplete deliveries.
  • Investigate shipment concerns using carrier tracking systems, proof of delivery photos, and internal tools.
  • Communicate directly with patients regarding shipping updates, investigation progress, and resolution timelines.
  • Coordinate with pharmacies, logistics teams, and shipping carriers to resolve delivery concerns efficiently.
  • Manage escalation tickets accurately and maintain detailed documentation.
  • Monitor shipping queues and ensure outstanding issues are followed through to resolution.
  • Identify recurring shipping concerns and communicate trends or findings to leadership.
  • Maintain accurate records of shipment investigations, patient interactions, and account updates.
  • Provide professional, empathetic support to patients experiencing shipping-related concerns.
  • Follow established shipping protocols, internal workflows, and escalation procedures.
  • Prioritize urgent situations while managing multiple cases in a fast-paced environment.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and investigative problem-solving abilities.
  • The ability to manage multiple escalations, priorities, and follow-ups simultaneously.
  • Confidence handling sensitive or frustrated patient interactions professionally and empathetically.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Comfort navigating online systems, tracking platforms, and ticketing tools.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach to problem-solving.
  • The ability to work independently while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Reliability, professionalism, and strong follow-through.
  • The ability to quickly learn internal systems, workflows, and procedures.

Preferred Qualifications (Strong Plus)

  • Previous experience in shipping, logistics, fulfillment, customer service, or patient support.
  • Experience handling escalated customer or patient situations.
  • Familiarity with shipping carriers, tracking systems, and proof of delivery investigations.
  • Experience working in pharmacy, healthcare, or related operations.
  • Experience managing high-volume support queues or ticketing systems.

Remote Work Requirements

Candidates must have the following available prior to their start date:

  • Reliable personal laptop or desktop computer (Chromebooks not accepted)
  • Quality headset suitable for patient and team communications
  • High-speed, reliable internet connection
  • Quiet, professional workspace suitable for confidential patient conversations

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Comprehensive benefits package (Health, Dental, and Vision).
  • Fully remote position.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for career growth within a rapidly scaling company.
  • Exposure to innovative therapies in wellness and longevity.

How to Apply

If you're interested in joining DirectMeds as a Fulfillment Care Specialist, we'd love to hear from you!

Please submit your resume and a brief introduction highlighting your relevant customer service, logistics, fulfillment, or problem-solving experience and why you're interested in the role.

DirectMeds is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Creador de contenido audivisual

📍 Valencia/Remoto


Las buenas ideas necesitan personas que sepan contarlas.

En HR Lean estamos creciendo y queremos sumar al equipo colaboradores con creatividad, actitud y ganas de aportar.

Buscamos un/a creador/a de contenido audiovisual freelance que nos ayude a contar lo que hacemos, documentar nuestras experiencias y potenciar nuestra marca personal en LinkedIn e Instagram.

Nos gustaría conocerte si disfrutas detrás de la cámara, tienes buenas ideas y sabes convertirlas en contenido que conecta.

¿Te apetece construir con nosotros? Sigue leyendo.

Tu misión.

Dar vida a las ideas y experiencias de HR Lean con contenido cercano, creativo y profesional, aportando tu mirada desde la preparación hasta la edición final.

¿Qué harás si te unes al equipo?

  • Documentar el antes, durante y después de los eventos que organizamos, o las que asistimos: grabaciones, fotografías, entrevistas y momentos destacados.

  • Grabar y editar entrevistas en diferentes formatos: podcast, jornadas, tallares, entrevistas a pie de calle....

  • Creación de videos y reels para redes sociales.

  • Redactar y diseñar posts y carruseles para LinkedIn e Instagram.

  • Aportar ideas, referencias y nuevos formatos.

  • Creación de landings corporativas.

  • Creación de material gráfico de soporte para nuestras diferentes campañas.

Lo que esperamos de ti

  • Experiencia en grabación, fotografía y edición, con un portfolio que muestre tu trabajo.

  • Buen criterio visual y dominio de herramientas de edición de vídeo y diseño.

  • Creatividad, iniciativa, organización y facilidad para conectar con las personas.

  • Residencia en Valencia o alrededores y disponibilidad para desplazarte puntualmente a Barcelona o Madrid.

  • Valoraremos tu experiencia con startups y empresas innovadoras de consultoría, selección, EdTech, tecnología o publicidad.

  • Si también sabes editar webs y crear landing pages, ¡nos encantará conocer tus proyectos!

Lo que encontrarás

  • Colaboración freelance part-time.

  • Trabajo en remoto y flexibilidad horaria total, coordinándonos para grabaciones, eventos y entregas.

  • Autonomía para proponer ideas y desarrollar tu creatividad.

  • Participación directa en una nueva etapa de crecimiento de HR Lean.

  • Variedad de contenidos, eventos y personas con las que compartir experiencias dentro del ecosistema emprendedor.

Cuéntanos quién eres, qué te inspira y qué ideas traerías a HR Lean.

Para presentar tu candidatura, necesitamos tu portfolio, indicando qué parte realizaste en cada trabajo, y referencias de creadores, marcas o estilos audiovisuales que te gusten y sigas, con enlaces y una breve explicación de qué destacarías.

Puedes atreverte con un breve video, si quieres.

Así será el proceso:

  1. Presentación de portfolio y referencias audiovisuales.

  2. Entrevista online con nosotros.

  3. Un café presencial para conocernos mejor.

  4. Prueba técnica con un caso práctico.

¿Te apetece sumar tu creatividad al equipo? ¡Queremos conocerte!

En HR Lean somos el Talent Partner de startups, scaleups y pymes en fase de crecimiento que entienden que el talento es una de las principales palancas para alcanzar sus objetivos.

Acompañamos a founders y equipos directivos en la incorporación de personas que aporten valor desde el primer día, combinando procesos de selección ágiles, tecnología y una visión 360º del negocio. Porque creemos que construir un gran equipo va mucho más allá de cubrir una vacante.

Somos fans de la metodología Lean y de la mejora continua. Ayudamos a las organizaciones a crecer de forma más ágil, eficiente y sostenible,incorporando el talento adecuado en el momento adecuado y construyendo equipos preparados para afrontar los retos de cada nueva etapa.

Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of iOS development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
  • Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
  • Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.
  • Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.

raw.excerpt: What we're doing at UscreenUscreen is the video monetization platform for businesses building recurring revenue from video content.
raw.description:
What we're doing at Uscreen

Uscreen is the video monetization platform for businesses building recurring revenue from video content. Our customers replace a patchwork stack of separate hosting, community, courses, email, and app vendors with one branded experience across web, mobile, and TV.

The platform is only half of it. We believe growth requires behavior, not just software. Customers don't stall because a feature is missing. They stall because they priced wrong, never built an email list, or launched an offer nobody wanted. Coaching is how we fix that, and it's part of the product rather than an add-on.

The job

You own a segment.

We have a cohort of smaller video businesses where retention is not where it should be. Nobody owns it today. You will. That means the revenue that stays in that segment, and the revenue that grows inside it, is yours. Your lemonade stand, your numbers, your call on how to run it.

This is a coaching role measured in dollars. You'll be accountable for gross revenue retention in your cohort first, and expansion second. Not tickets closed, not calls booked.

It's also a one-to-many job. Your cohort is larger than a 1:1 book, so the work is designing coaching that scales: cohort programs, group sessions, office hours, triggered outreach when the data says a business is drifting. You'll build that motion rather than inherit it.

What you'll do

  • Own gross revenue retention and expansion for an assigned segment of customers
  • Find the pattern in why businesses in your cohort stall, and build coaching that addresses it at scale rather than one conversation at a time
  • Run group coaching sessions, cohort programs, and asynchronous coaching inside Membership+
  • Coach customers through the decisions that move revenue: pricing, packaging, positioning, offer design, email and funnel strategy, retention mechanics
  • Read your own data. Spot the accounts drifting before they churn, and know which interventions actually worked
  • Build the playbooks and session formats that make this repeatable. You're the first person in this seat, and what you build becomes how we scale it
  • Bring what you learn back to Product and Success. You'll be closer to this segment than anyone at the company.

Who we're looking for

Someone who has grown something online and can explain how. Maybe you ran marketing for a small business, coached founders, built your own audience, or worked inside a membership or subscription business. What matters is that you can sit with an operator, see the real constraint, and say the honest thing.

  • 3 to 5 years in coaching, consulting, customer success, or digital marketing, with real ownership of an outcome
  • Comfortable advising solo operators and small teams on how to grow
  • Strong live facilitation: group sessions, workshops, webinars, 1:1 calls
  • Can read a dashboard and form a point of view on retention curves, cohort behavior, and funnel conversion
  • Working fluency with AI tools for research, prep, and synthesis. Our team uses Claude daily to prep sessions, analyze customer data, and build coaching assets. You don't need to be technical, but you should reach for these tools rather than around them.
  • Motivated by being paid on results. A third of this package is variable and there's no ceiling on it.
  • Clear, simple communication. Complex idea in, plain sentence out.

Bonus points if you:

  • Have been a creator, coach, or small business owner yourself
  • Have worked with video businesses, online educators, or subscription and membership businesses
  • Know the surrounding stack: Kit/ConvertKit, YouTube, Kajabi, Circle, Squarespace, Meta and IG
  • Have built a scaled or one-to-many customer program before

What's hard about this job

We'd rather you know now.

  • You'll own a number you can't fully control. Some customers won't take the advice and will churn anyway. You have to be able to own influence over an outcome rather than the outcome itself.
  • It's a lagging metric. Retention moves slowly. Your first two quarters are guaranteed at target because of this, but you'll be doing the work for months before the number reflects it.
  • The motion doesn't exist yet. Playbooks exist for our 1:1 coaching. The scaled version for this segment is an open question you'll help answer. If you need a finished playbook on day one, this will frustrate you.
  • You'll deliver honest assessments to people emotionally invested in what they've built. That takes a specific kind of nerve.

What we offer

  • 100% remote first company
  • Flexible PTO + 8 company holidays
  • Remote, global team
  • Paid parental leave
  • Medical, dental, and vision (US Based)
  • Technology and home office stipend
  • Coworking space stipend
  • Annual learning stipend

Note: Benefits may vary depending on location and local regulations. Final eligibility and coverage details will be shared during the hiring process.

Based in Washington, D.C., Quorum is the leading provider of workflow software and information services for government affairs professionals globally. We serve over 2,000 customers—including over 50% of the Fortune 100—across 30+ countries.

At Quorum, our "product" isn't just our software; it’s our people. We are looking for a 100% remote Account Manager who is a natural relationship-builder and a strategic growth driver. The Impact You’ll Have

About You

  • The Experience: You have 2+ years in Account Management or Customer Success within the SaaS space, with a proven track record of hitting revenue and retention targets.

  • The Communicator: You are confident leading Executive Business Reviews with C-Suite leaders and can translate complex software features into measurable business impact.

  • The "People Person": You establish rapport with ease—whether in-person or online—and naturally channel empathy into effective client advocacy.

About the Account Management Team

We’re responsible for ensuring that clients have an amazing experience with Quorum.

  • We are a Community: We take pride in developing personal relationships with our users and our team. We're very close—we work together, hang out together, and regularly support one another to ensure the success of our clients.

Our Work Environment

  • We are a remote-friendly team with flexible work options: work remotely or, if you're in the area, choose to visit our vibrant, sunlit space in our modern, open-concept office in Washington, D.C.

  • Our office building is located in the heart of downtown DC, easily accessible by metro, bus, and rideshares. It is also in close proximity to great restaurants, food trucks, shopping, and popular happy hour spots.

Benefits

  • Virtual and in-person team events

  • Community groups open to all team members

  • Paid 12 weeks off for parental leave

Compensation

  • Base range of $65,000 - $80,000 based on experience + variable compensation.

  • This is a full-time remote position, Exempt - not eligible for overtime.

Our Commitment to Pay Transparency: What Does That Mean For You?

  • We will not ask you what you are currently earning.

  • We will consider years of relevant experience, relevant professional certifications/education, and performance expectations in setting what we believe is a competitive, fair base salary offer.

  • We will be transparent about our compensation structure so that all candidates have equal access to compensation information and can make an informed decision about whether or not Quorum is the right workplace for them.

We comply with all requirements for US government federal contractors issued by the OFCCP, IFR, and the terms of our government contracts.

EEO/AA/F/M/Vet/Disabled

We are currently hiring for this position in the following states: DC, FL, GA, IL, LA, ME, MD, MA, MI, MO, NE, NJ, NC, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, VT, VA, WV.

raw.excerpt: Position Description:At ServiceTrade, you’ll build technology that matters — for your career, your team, and the thousands of commercial contractors who rely on our platform every day.
raw.description:
Position Description:

At ServiceTrade, you’ll build technology that matters — for your career, your team, and the thousands of commercial contractors who rely on our platform every day. We’re on a mission to partner with commercial trades to deliver technology that enhances technician productivity, improves customer experiences, and drives scalable growth.

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Accounting Integrations who’s excited to make an impact. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the development, testing, and maintenance of scalable integration architectures using JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js. You will design robust REST APIs, webhooks, and event-driven AWS serverless workflows (including Lambda, SQS, and Step Functions) to seamlessly sync data with external accounting platforms. Additionally, you will diagnose and resolve complex system issues, mentor junior engineers, and leverage modern AI-assisted development tools to ensure maximum accuracy, performance, and reliability across our integrations.

Why ServiceTrade:

You’ll belong here from the start.

We bring together kind, curious people with diverse perspectives and trust them with meaningful work. You’ll have ownership, clarity, and support to solve real problems, make a visible impact for our customers, and continue growing as your role evolves.

On the Accounting Integrations team, you’ll have the opportunity to architect and scale mission-critical integrations that seamlessly bridge our platform with external financial ecosystems. You will take full ownership of high-volume, event-driven serverless systems, leverage AI-assisted tools to accelerate innovation, and mentor fellow engineers while tackling complex engineering challenges that directly impact the daily operations of thousands of commercial contractors.

About You:

You are someone who takes full ownership of your work and thrives on delivering solutions. If there’s a problem in our system, no matter where the root cause lies, you pursue it until it’s resolved, ensuring our customers experience a seamless service. You never compromise on quality and are always looking for ways to improve performance, scalability, and efficiency. Your proactive, can-do attitude drives you to find answers, even in the face of complex technical challenges.

Key Responsibilities and Activities:

  • Lead the development, testing, and maintenance of scalable codebase for complex accounting integrations and other products as necessary.
  • Proactively identify, diagnose, and resolve critical issues, implementing preventative measures to guarantee accuracy and reliability.
  • Collaborate with and mentor junior engineers, fostering best practices in advanced software engineering principles and techniques.
  • Establish comprehensive documentation for code, and processes to enable seamless team collaboration and knowledge transfer.
  • Manage daily workload effectively between many priorities.

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Language Expertise: Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js; comfortable working within mixed modern and legacy codebases. Familiarity with Python for data-focused backend systems is a plus.
  • AWS Ecosystem: Experience with AWS infrastructure, including Lambda, SQS/DLQs, S3, DynamoDB, Step Functions.
  • System Design: Proficiency in designing robust Webhooks, REST APIs, OAuth/token flows, and handling retries/idempotency.
  • Data & Infrastructure: Experience with PostgreSQL and MongoDB/DocumentDB. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and event-driven systems.
  • Problem-Solver: A proactive approach to identifying and solving technical challenges with a focus on performance and scalability.
  • AI-Assisted Development: Practical experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate delivery — and the judgment to review, test, and own the output.

A few things you’ll want to know:

What does ServiceTrade do?

ServiceTrade is a best-in-class field service management platform that helps commercial fire protection and mechanical service contractors build efficient and growing businesses. With more than a decade of innovation and 1500 customers, ServiceTrade streamlines operations from the field to the office, boosts technician productivity, and enhances the end-customer experience.

Ok, so why should I care about that?

Our customers do essential work — often behind the scenes — and our software helps them do it better. They’re smart, hardworking people, and we take pride in helping them grow their businesses, earn more revenue, employ more skilled workers, and deliver greater value to their own customers. When you work at ServiceTrade, your impact extends beyond our walls, supporting communities and markets you might never have thought about — and making work that truly matters every day.

What kind of working environment do you have?

We’re a growing business focused on building with intention and operating with purpose. You’ll have meaningful responsibility and the trust to do your best work from the start. We encourage calculated risks and bold experimentation, while providing opportunities to learn, grow, and turn today’s lessons into tomorrow’s breakthroughs—all in service of big ambitions and real customer impact.

Learn more about our culture and values on our About Us page.

What kind of benefits do you offer?

  • Medical through Cigna, PPO and HDHP options, including a Health Savings Account with company contributions Dental and Vision through Unum
  • Flexible Spending Account and Dependant Care Account
  • Company-paid Life insurance, STD and LTD
  • Voluntary benefits including Supplemental Life Insurance, Critical Illness, Accident and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) with up to 3% employer match and NO vesting period
  • Flexible PTO policy
  • 10 company holidays
  • Parental Leave
  • Paid Time Off for Volunteering
  • Employee Reimbursement Program to use for well-being, technology and/or professional development

Want to know more?

Go ahead and apply! Let’s get to know each other.

ServiceTrade is not registered to hire in all 50 states. You must reside in one of the states listed to be considered.

(AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, KY, LA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, VT, WA)

EEO Statement:

ServiceTrade provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

Please Be Aware of Recruiting Scams

To protect yourself against the increasing number of recruiting scams, please make sure that you are communicating with ServiceTrade. We communicate through our corporate website, through corporate emails utilizing our domain name of @, and through servicetrade.greenhouse.io. Be vigilant when checking domains because imitators often make very small changes to trick the eye. Additionally, please know that ServiceTrade does not use text messaging or public messaging platforms, such as Telegram or Whatsapp, to make initial contact with candidates and ServiceTrade will never ask an employment candidate for financial information or for payment of any kind.

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role

Kong is looking for a Director, Performance Marketing to lead and scale our global performance marketing engine.

This role will own Performance Marketing strategy, budget, investment allocation, forecasting, and paid acquisition outcomes across channels, audiences, and regions. You'll be accountable for translating investment into qualified demand, pipeline, and measurable return, continuously determining where to scale, optimize, reallocate, or pull back investment.

This is a hands-on leadership role. We're looking for someone who can set strategy and own the numbers while staying close to the channels, data, and execution. You'll lead agency partners, work closely across Marketing, Sales, Finance, and RevOps, and regularly translate performance into clear recommendations for senior leadership.

What You'll Do

  • Own Performance Marketing targets and strategy: Build and execute the global roadmap required to deliver paid acquisition, qualified demand, pipeline, efficiency, and ROAS goals.

  • Own the Performance Marketing budget: Lead budget planning, forecasting, pacing, and allocation across channels, audiences, regions, and GTM priorities. Continuously make disciplined decisions to scale, optimize, reallocate, or pull back investment based on business impact.

  • Lead Paid Search & Paid Social: Set channel strategy and ensure best-in-class execution, experimentation, optimization, and measurement across our core paid acquisition channels.

  • Turn data into investment decisions: Connect spend and channel performance to Responses/INQs → Qualified Demand → Pipeline → ROAS and use those signals to determine where the next dollar should go.

  • Build a high-velocity experimentation engine: Drive testing across audiences, creative, offers, bidding, channels, conversion paths, and emerging acquisition opportunities.

  • Leverage AI to scale performance: Use AI and automation to accelerate analysis, campaign optimization, creative testing, audience development, experimentation, and operational efficiency.

  • Build internal performance capability: Lead and develop channel specialists while establishing clear operating rhythms, standards, and accountability across the function.

  • Lead agency strategy: Own agency relationships and determine where external partners provide differentiated expertise, specialized capabilities, or incremental execution capacity.

  • Communicate performance to leadership: Deliver clear, concise performance narratives and investment recommendations to Marketing and company leadership, translating complex channel and funnel data into business implications, risks, opportunities, and actions.

  • Lead cross-functionally: Partner across Global Campaigns, Digital Experience, Product Marketing, RevOps, Finance, Sales, and regional teams to align priorities and translate GTM objectives into effective investment and execution.

How We'll Measure Success

You'll be accountable for the business performance and efficiency of Performance Marketing, including:

  • Paid-attributed qualified demand and pipeline

  • ROAS and return on investment

  • Acquisition efficiency

  • Performance against investment forecasts and budget

  • Effective allocation and reallocation of spend

  • Experiment velocity and incremental performance

  • Paid Search and Paid Social performance

Success also means building a trusted Performance Marketing function that can clearly communicate where we're investing, what's working, what isn't, and where the next dollar should go.

What You'll Bring

  • 10+ years of experience across Performance Marketing, Growth Marketing, Paid Media, Demand Generation, or related B2B SaaS disciplines, including experience leading a performance function

  • Deep expertise across Paid Search and Paid Social, with strong knowledge of modern B2B acquisition and measurement

  • Demonstrated ownership of significant global media budgets, including annual planning, forecasting, pacing, allocation, and in-quarter reallocation

  • Strong financial and analytical orientation with the ability to connect investment decisions to qualified demand, pipeline, revenue, and ROI—not just platform metrics

  • A track record of building rigorous experimentation and optimization programs and translating learnings into investment decisions

  • Experience building and developing high-performing internal teams while effectively leveraging agencies and external partners

  • Hands-on understanding of modern advertising platforms, analytics, attribution, automation, and AI-enabled performance tools

  • Exceptional executive communication and storytelling skills, with experience presenting performance, investment recommendations, risks, and business outcomes to senior leadership

  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, build alignment across teams with different priorities, and drive execution

  • A strong operator mentality with the ability to move fluidly between strategy, financial management, analysis, team leadership, and execution

  • Experience in developer, infrastructure, API, cloud, or technical B2B SaaS strongly preferred

About Kong:

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. Who we are

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

What Clinical Operations does at Worldwide


At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we invite you to embark on a rewarding journey within Clinical Operations, where your contributions will leave a profound impact on the lives of patients.


As a Clinical Research Associate (CRA) at Worldwide, you will find yourself working alongside brilliant minds across diverse therapeutic areas, including Cardiovascular, Metabolic, Neuroscience, Oncology, and Rare Diseases. Collaboration with top-tier colleagues from various backgrounds and specialties is not just encouraged; it's ingrained in our culture. Our commitment to advancing clinical research is nurtured within a supportive and team-oriented environment. In a CRA role, you'll receive extensive support through regulatory submissions, TMF management, and in-house CRAs for projects with heavy site management needs.


Through regular touchpoints and coaching conversations with your Line Manager, we ensure that your professional development remains a top priority. We offer a clear career path and development that can lead to Clinical Trial Manager roles. We take pride in our accessible Executive Leadership team, who are equally committed to advancing science and surmounting obstacles to make a difference in the lives of patients around the world.

We offer an unparalleled experience, where you can drive remarkable scientific breakthroughs and be at the very core of every successful clinical trial. Experience a world of difference with us at Worldwide!


What you will do

  • Responsible for managing the research activities at sites participating in Worldwide’s clinical research projects
  • Typically involved in all stages of the clinical study, including identifying potential sites to participate in the research effort, performing various study start-up activities such as working with sites to collect appropriate regulatory documents and supporting the negotiation of contracts and budgets, training the sites to collect data properly and report any potential safety-related events, managing the site's activities during study maintenance, and closing down research activities at the sites once the study has concluded
  • Conduct study initiation visits (SIVs)
  • While most of the site management efforts will be performed remotely, you will be required to ensure compliance with obtaining informed consent, reporting potential safety-related events, and adhering to all applicable regulatory requirements

What you will bring to the role

  • Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills in English
  • Superior organizational skills with attention to detail
  • Ability to work with little or no supervision
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, CTMS, and EDC Systems

Your experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Clinical Research Associate
  • 4-year university degree OR Nursing Degree
  • Experience in CNS is strongly preferred
  • Candidates must reside on the West Coast
  • Willingness to travel regionally required

At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace by providing transparent compensation.

United States of America - $97,000.00 - $193,000.00

In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive benefits package depending on location. We ensure pay equity and transparency and comply with all applicable labor laws. Salary information will be discussed during the interview process, and we encourage candidates to inquire about compensation at any stage.

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

Position Title: Sr. Fire Safety Engineer

Department: Engineering (Primary) but will support other departments

Entity: CS e-Storage
Reports To: Director of Project Engineering, EMEA

Location: Remote -UK based but covers EMEA region

Position Summary:

The Senior Fire Safety Engineer will play a critical role in ensuring the safety, compliance, and performance of our utility-scale and commercial energy storage systems (ESS) deployed throughout the EMEA region. As part of the Energy Storage Solution Management team, this individual will support product design, track evolving fire safety regulations and standards, and provide project-level technical support across multiple phases of ESS deployment.

 

The role requires deep familiarity with UL 9540, 9540A, NFPA 855, BS and IEC standards, and other applicable fire detection and protection standards, along with strong collaboration and documentation skills. The ideal candidate brings a background in fire protection or mechanical engineering, with experience in system-level safety design, regulatory engagement, and large-scale fire testing.

 

Responsibilities

 

Product Design Support

 

  • Provide fire safety guidance during the design and development of BESS enclosures and integrated energy storage solutions for global markets.
  • Evaluate system layouts, battery configurations, fire detection and alarming, ventilation strategies from a safety perspective.
  • Participate in product design reviews and collaborate with product and solution managers to ensure safety considerations are embedded early.
  • Interpret and review third-party fire testing reports and modelling data to recommend design or process improvements.
  • Support fire safety validation through internal and third-party test campaigns, including UL 9540A and IEC 62933-based evaluations.
  • Support system integration testing activities related to fire safety systems

 

Regulatory Tracking, Continuous Improvement, and Documentation

 

  • Monitor updates in fire safety codes and standards (e.g., NFPA 855, UL 9540A, BS/IEC) relevant to energy storage products and technology across global markets.
  • Maintain and update internal fire safety guidelines, technical notes, and design templates based on evolving standards and field experience.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives related to safety documentation, including emergency response plans, fire protection strategies, and permitting support packages.
  • Consolidate feedback from test results, project experience, and internal reviews into actionable improvements for future product iterations.
  • Lead the review or drafting of fire safety documents, including safety manuals and safety training materials.

 

Project Engineering Fire Safety Support

 

  • Provide project-specific technical support on fire safety requirements, including code interpretations, layout reviews, and compliance documentation.
  • Assist in preparing technical documentation for customer due diligence and local planning authority (LPA) submissions, specific to the technology and project design. Includes: Emergency Response Plan (ERP), Hazard Mitigation Analysis (HMA), Heat Flux Analysis (HFA), Fire Risk Assessments (FRA), Dangerous Substances Explosive Atmosphere Regulations (DSEAR).
  • Experience of modelling software such as FDS would be a bonus.
  • Experienced in reviewing fire detection and alarm system designs.
  • Support project engineers in interpreting fire test data and applying protection strategies at the project level.
  • Coordinate with third-party testing labs, consultants, and regulatory bodies to meet project compliance goals.
  • Review project drawings and documentation for compliance with eStorage product design and requirements
  • Review contractual agreements for conformance with our equipment solution
  • Lead resolution of Customer, Insurer, Owners Engineer and Local Planning Authority inquiries related to fire protection and safety strategy implementation.
  • Focused on UK and EU markets
  • Comfortable dealing with Fire and Rescue Service, including site familiarisation visits and training.

 

Qualifications and Experience:

  • Fire Engineering (or related: Mechanical, Building Services, Structural with fire modules)
  • IFireE / MFireE membership with the Institution of Fire Engineers (IFE)
  • Chartered Engineer (CEng) or working toward it
  • Thirdparty accreditation in fire risk assessment (e.g., FRAP, IFSM)
  • Minimum 3 years of fire safety engineering experience, preferably in the energy storage, battery systems, or industrial power sector.
  • Deep understanding of fire protection codes and standards including UL 9540A, NFPA 855, NFPA 68/69, BS7671, BS 5839, BS 9999, BS 7974, BS 5306, PD 7974 series & BS/IEC standards.
  • Experience planning, managing, and reviewing large-scale fire testing programs and interpreting test results and modelling data.
  • Familiarity with ESS hardware development, BESS enclosure designs, fire safety system integration, and emergency response planning.
  • Strong technical communication skills, with experience preparing test reports, compliance packages and local planning authority documentation.
  • Knowledge of industry fire alarm systems and manufacturers, including networking design
  • Ability to collaborate across global teams including product development, compliance, engineering, and external consultants.
  • Flexibility to travel and coordinate across global time zones as needed.

 

Personal Qualifications:

 

  • Comfortable in a collaborative and fluid environment. 
  • An excellent time manager, able to balance multiple projects and prioritize a wide variety of issues, initiatives and objectives concurrently.
  • Good technical writing skills
  • Exceptional ability to simplify and report complicated scenarios to the management team, with outstanding judgment and decision-making abilities. 
  • Solid and effective interpersonal and communication skills (including oral, written and visual)
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships internally and externally with staff, management, clients, suppliers, community partners and external stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated sound judgment and the ability to be decisive in crisis situations.
  • Strong organizational skills with excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Knowledge of BESS product validation, system integration, and testing methodologies.
  • Flexibility to travel up to 10%, including international travel as required , for vendor assessments, testing, and industry events.

• Bachelor’s degree in IT.

At Montera, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Founder-led with $1.5B backed by Stonepeak, Montera is driven by a future-focused vision: to develop and operate hyperscale data centers essential for tomorrow's technology. Our mission is to deliver strategically located, hyperscale data centers designed for speed, reliability, and scalability. Backed by decades of experience in design, construction, and operations, we don’t just build—we execute with purpose.

Our Values

  • Client First Alignment: We align every solution to our clients’ goals.
  • Speed with Certainty: Velocity matters. We deliver with urgency and precision.
  • Operational Excellence: Decades of experience drive our high standards.
  • Safety & Integrity: Safety is non-negotiable. We lead with integrity and transparency.
  • Ownership Mentality: We think like owners, because we are.

Position Overview:

The Vice President of Procurement will lead the strategic planning and execution of Montera’s hyperscale data center equipment procurement program, supporting a national portfolio of Tier 1 market developments across the United States and select markets in Canada. Reporting directly to the Chief Delivery Officer (CDO), this role will design, implement, and manage a scalable, standardized, and high-performance procurement model that ensures timely, cost-effective, and high-quality delivery of Major Capital Equipment (MCE) and related systems across a planned 1.5–2.5 GW IT capacity program.

This executive will serve as the primary interface between leadership, design, construction, commissioning, program controls, operations, and external equipment vendors. The Vice President will ensure that Montera’s procurement strategy drives speed-to-market, cost predictability, quality manufacturing, and operational reliability across all hyperscale campuses.

Requirements

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Construction Management, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
  • 10–15 years of progressive experience in major capital equipment procurement management, equipment manufacturing, or mission-critical infrastructure delivery.
  • Proven success developing and overseeing an equipment procurement program for hyperscale or multi-building data center campuses (50–100 MW+ IT capacity).
  • Experience developing scalable, programmatic procurement models across multiple markets.
  • Strong understanding of MEP design and construction, modular construction, QA/QC programs, and commissioning methodologies.
  • Experience managing executive-level stakeholder and vendor relationships across internal and external organizations.
  • Proficiency in Primavera P6, MS Project, Procore, and cost management systems.

Benefits

Why Join Montera?

At Montera, you’ll shape the next generation of digital infrastructure while being supported by a team that values integrity, collaboration, and long-term partnership. We’re a remote-first company that empowers our people with flexibility, ownership, and meaningful rewards.

Our Benefits at a Glance:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: We pay 90% of health premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Generous Time Off: Up to 8 weeks of paid time off per year, including holidays, PTO, and sick time.
  • Financial Security: 401(k) plan with immediate eligibility, no vesting requirement, and employer match contributions up to 6%.
  • Recognition & Rewards: Annual bonus program to share in our success.
  • Extra Support: Remote work stipend plus phone allowance to help you stay connected.

At Montera, you’ll have the autonomy to do great work and the benefits to thrive personally and professionally.

Job Details

The Director, Commercial Compliance serves as the primary Compliance partner for U.S. pharmaceutical and biosimilar commercialization. The role leads the development and oversight of a risk-based compliance framework for commercialization, advises senior leaders, and provides independent challenge on higher-risk business decisions. The Director supports the compliant execution and continued evolution of the commercialization model while coordinating appropriately with third parties responsible for product development and other external capabilities.


USA - Remote


Primary Duties and Responsibilities:


  • Lead a risk-based commercial compliance strategy aligned with commercialization priorities and business growth.
  • Advise senior leaders and cross-functional teams on pharmaceutical promotion, HCP and patient interactions, patient-support programs, Medical Affairs independence, medical information, market access, pricing, government price reporting, and other commercialization risks.
  • Develop and operationalize compliance policies, procedures, governance, training, certifications, guidance, documentation, and escalation standards for commercial activities.
  • Establish controls that protect independent decision-making, confidential information, appropriate access, and management of actual or perceived conflicts of interest.
  • Design and oversee commercial compliance risk assessments, monitoring, testing, investigations support, issue escalation, corrective action, and validation of remediation.
  • Assess new commercial programs, partnerships, channels, and operating models to identify compliance requirements and address control gaps.
  • Provide compliance guidance regarding interactions and arrangements with GPOs, distributors, MSOs, specialty pharmacies, provider organizations, and other commercial partners.
  • Partner with Legal, Regulatory, Medical, Quality, Commercial, Market Access, Technology, Audit, and other control functions to embed clear compliance accountabilities.
  • Provide concise executive reporting on material risks, compliance readiness, control effectiveness, trends, resource needs, and unresolved issues.
  • Promote ethical decision-making, speak-up culture, and individual accountability through visible leadership and practical compliance guidance.

Experience and Educational Requirements:


  • Bachelor's degree in business, life sciences, healthcare, public policy, compliance, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant compliance certification preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or life-sciences compliance experience, including substantial U.S. commercial compliance responsibility.
  • Demonstrated experience developing, implementing, or enhancing a pharmaceutical commercial compliance program across ongoing commercialization activities.

raw.description:
The Company:
Marigold is a fast-growing marketing technology company helping growing businesses build stronger customer relationships through its three core platforms: Emma, Campaign Monitor, and Vuture. We deliver powerful tools for email, SMS, and marketing automation that elevate engagement and drive real results. Marigold is headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee with offices in Sydney and London.


The Role:
At Emma, we’re looking for a driven, curious software engineer to join our team. The Emma Engineering organization is made up of passionate engineers focused on building elegant, reliable tooling that helps our customers succeed in their email marketing efforts. Our teams operate with clear ownership boundaries, allowing engineers to specialize, deepen their expertise, and build sustainable software that’s easy to support and evolve over time. We take pride in crafting creative, scalable solutions for a wide range of customers—and we genuinely enjoy doing it together.


This is an entry-level, Software Engineer role. On the frontend, we work primarily with React and supporting libraries, including a proprietary UI toolkit. Our backend systems are Python-driven, Django, and AWS-based. Experience in any of these areas is a plus, but a strong desire to learn and grow across the full stack is essential. Within your first six months, you’ll also have opportunities to contribute to additional areas of development as you continue to build your skills and expand your technical foundation.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build and ship code that solves real problems for real customers. Engineering is central to what we do, and you’ll work closely with your team to plan, experiment, and deliver impactful solutions.
  • Collaborate in code reviews, sharing ideas, learning from others, and helping raise the bar on quality and best practices.
  • Get hands-on with how Emma builds intuitive, scalable tooling that helps marketing teams do their best work.
  • Have fun while doing it! We care deeply about our customers, move with intention, and genuinely enjoy building great products together.
  • Use AI-assisted tools thoughtfully to research, prototype, and build, while learning how to apply them responsibly in a production codebase.

About You:

You’re an early-career developer who’s excited to learn, grow, and contribute as part of a collaborative engineering team. While you may not be a master of React, Python, or AWS yet, you bring curiosity, strong potential, and a genuine desire to build your skills and learn best practices. You care deeply about technology, the products you help create, and the customers who rely on them. You enjoy variety in your work, are eager to take on new challenges, and are motivated by opportunities to expand your knowledge and grow alongside a supportive team. You're comfortable using AI tools as part of your everyday workflow, and you know that good engineering still means understanding, questioning, and owning the code you ship.


Ideal Qualifications:

  • Early-career developer or recent graduate with a strong interest in software engineering
  • Foundational experience or exposure to modern technologies such as React, Python, AWS, or similar tools
  • Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies, frameworks, and best practices
  • Passion for building quality products with the end user in mind
  • Comfortable working across different areas of the codebase and contributing where needed
  • Strong collaboration skills and openness to feedback and continuous improvement
  • Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude) to speed up your work, and able to critically review, test, and own the code they help produce

Location Eligibility

This position is eligible for hire in the following US states: Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, and Virginia.

Compensation & Benefits


Compensation:
The base salary range for this role is $70,000 -$80,000 annually.

The compensation range represents the pay the Company reasonably expects to offer for this position. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, experience, qualifications, internal equity, geographic location, and applicable law.


Benefits:

  • Competitive benefits including: medical/dental/vision insurance, life/accident/disabilities insurance, supplemental health benefits, FSA, EAP and pet insurance
  • Generous time off (we call it Open Time Away) as well as paid holidays and a birthday benefit day off.
  • Paid Volunteer Time
  • 401k plan with a company match on your contributions.
  • Employee-centric and supportive remote work environment with flexibility.
  • Support for life events including paid parental leave.

raw.description:
Windows Server Architect

Overview

The Windows Server Architect leads the design and technical direction for migrating a federal client's Windows Server estate, hosted in a FedRAMP-authorized AWS GovCloud environment, from Windows Server 2016 to Windows Server 2019 or 2025 ahead of end of support. As the Windows subject matter expert, the role owns the upgrade architecture end to end, from discovery through hardening, testing, and rollback, and guides DevSecOps, Security, and Test team members to deliver compliant, low-risk upgrades for mission-critical systems.

Key Functions

  • Lead discovery of in-scope servers, cataloging roles, services, installed software, and dependencies.
  • Design the upgrade approach for each server (in-place vs. rebuild), including AMI selection, EC2 sizing, and a phased, wave-based sequence with go/no-go checkpoints between waves.
  • Define and validate OS hardening baselines (e.g., DISA STIGs, CIS Benchmarks, Active Directory Domain) and remediate outstanding security findings.
  • Design secure administrative access, including RDP/jump server configuration and CyberArk privileged access integration.
  • Plan certificate management and renewal, including certificate chain validation.
  • Design Windows IIS-dependent workloads, such as Power BI Gateway servers.
  • Partner with DevSecOps Engineers to automate Windows build standards and correct configuration drift.
  • Partner with the Test Manager on each wave's test strategy, success criteria, and rollback procedures, and maintain the project Risk Register.
  • Produce architecture artifacts (Implementation Blueprint, design documents, runbooks) in Confluence and Jira, ensuring alignment with the client's Technical Reference Model and audit, vulnerability requirements.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree and 7 years of relevant experience.
  • An additional 2 years of experience (9 years total) with an Associate’s Degree in lieu of a Bachelor’s Degree.
  • An additional 4 years of experience (11 years total) with a High School Diploma in lieu of a Bachelor’s Degree.
  • Demonstrated experience leading Windows Server 2016 to 2019 or 2025 migrations in AWS (GovCloud experience preferred), including upgrade planning, testing, and rollback.
  • Hands-on Windows Server OS hardening experience using federal and industry baselines.
  • Experience integrating Windows servers with CyberArk for privileged access management.
  • Deep Windows Server expertise (Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, PKI, patching, Remote Desktop Service) and strong PowerShell skills.
  • Working knowledge of AWS services for Windows workloads (EC2, AMIs, VPC, Systems Manager, EBS snapshots).
  • Experience with windows configuration management using Ansible (WMI, WinRM, PowerShell)
  • Strong technical leadership and communication skills, with the ability to direct engineers and lead discussions with federal stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications or Skills

  • Microsoft Windows Server certification: Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate, or the legacy MCSE: Core Infrastructure; equivalent hands-on experience may be considered.
  • AWS certification (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional).
  • Experience with AWS Systems Manager (Automated system patching)
  • Experience in managing software deployments through group policy.
  • Experience with Microsoft Power BI, including Power BI Gateway administration.
  • Experience configuring and hardening Windows IIS servers1.
  • Experience supporting federal government systems with audit and vulnerability management.

Position Details

  • Employment type: Full-Time, W2
  • Location: 100% Remote (US-based)
  • Hours: 40 hours/week with availability during core business hours of 8am-5pm ET
  • Eligibility: Must be eligible to obtain a Public Trust clearance

raw.description:
BEWERBUNG ÜBER DIE "MITMACHEN"-FUNKTION AUF UNSERER WEBSITE

krisenchat ist innerhalb kürzester Zeit zum größten Online-Beratungsangebot Deutschlands für junge Menschen in Not geworden. Wir sind eine agile Non-Profit-Organisation und bieten Kindern und Jugendlichen rund um die Uhr niedrigschwellige, effektive und wirksame psychosoziale Ersthilfe per Chat an. Seit Mai 2020 konnten die 300+ Krisenberater:innen schon in über 80.000 Krisensituationen helfen. Dabei erfolgt die Krisenberatung komplett remote und ist zeitlich flexibel einteilbar.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgabe wird in der Beratung von Kindern, Jugendlichen und jungen Erwachsenen liegen. Dabei treten häufig Themen, wie Ängste, Einsamkeit, depressive Symptomatiken oder Probleme in der Schule und Familie auf.

Jede Chatschicht geht über einen Zeitraum von 2,5 Stunden, die du dir zu einer freien Zeit deiner Wahl eintragen kannst. Da wir ein 24/7 Angebot sind, kannst du deine Zeit sehr flexibel über den Tag einteilen. Wir wünschen uns mind. 5 Stunden ehrenamtliche Tätigkeit im Monat. Über den genauen Ablauf wirst du in unserem Onboarding (Einführungsprogramm) informiert.

Du brauchst keine Sorgen zu haben, es wird immer ein:e Ansprechpartner:in da sein und in den Chatschichten achten wir darauf, dass ihr nicht alleine seid! Es gibt auch die Möglichkeit sich jederzeit mit einem unserer Team-Mitglieder auszutauschen.

Qualifikation

Um unsere Qualität in der Beratung nachhaltig zu sichern, können bei uns Personen mit einem akademischen Abschluss in den folgenden Fächern beraten:

  • Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium Psychologie oder Bachelorstudent:in mit Zusatzqualifikation oder intensiver Beratungserfahrung (keine Pflichtpraktika)
  • Psychotherapeut:innen in Ausbildung oder abgeschlossen in den nach den Psychotherapierichtlinien anerkannten Verfahren
  • Ärzt:innen mit Zusatzqualifikation Psychotherapie
  • Lehrer:innen und Pädagog:innen mit zusätzlichen psychosozialen Beratungserfahrungen
  • Sozialarbeiter:innen und Sozialpädagog:innen mit staatlicher Anerkennung
  • Nach individueller Prüfung auch andere, ähnliche Hintergründe mit sehr intensiver psychosozialer Beratungserfahrung

Für die Beratung benötigen alle Krisenberater:innen einen PC. Unsere Beratungstätigkeit erfolgt ausschließlich digital und unter Zuhilfenahme weiterer digitaler Werkzeuge. Grundlegende Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Computern werden vorausgesetzt.

Das Beraten von einem Mobilgerät (z.B. Tablet oder Handy) ist grundsätzlich nicht möglich. Kenntnisse der deutschen Sprache (in Schriftform) auf C2 Niveau werden zusätzlich benötigt. Der persönliche Kontakt ist für uns entscheidend - alle Interessent:innen lernen wir zunächst persönlich in einem Video-Call kennen. Das Vorlegen eines erweiterten polizeilichen Führungszeugnisses ist Pflicht.

Benefits

Dein Ehrenamt bei krisenchat ist eine Gelegenheit, Erfahrungen in einem innovativen digitalen Beratungsfeld zu sammeln. Durch die Niedrigschwelligkeit wirst du mit einem breiten Spektrum an Themen und Krisen konfrontiert. So wird dir ermöglicht, deine Kenntnisse im Bereich der Krisenintervention auszubauen. Du wirst eng mit einer sehr engagierten und diversen Community zusammenarbeiten und von den unterschiedlichen Erfahrungen und dem Austausch miteinander profitieren.

Zudem bieten wir kostenfreie Supervisionen in kleinen Gruppen und regelmäßig stattfindende Feedbackgespräche an.

Da uns die Aus- und Weiterbildung unserer Krisenberater:innen sehr am Herzen liegt, bieten wir neben unserem ausführlichen E-Learning-Programm die Teilnahme an diversen Workshops, Fachsprechstunden sowie Vorträgen externer Expert:innen zu unterschiedlichen Fachthemen an. Darüber hinaus hast du bei zahlreichen nicht-fachlichen, analogen und digitalen Austauschformate die Möglichkeit, deine Kolleg:innen kennenzulernen.

Wir sind eine stetig wachsende Gemeinschaft von engagierten und offenherzigen Menschen aus verschiedensten Bereichen der psychosozialen Hilfslandschaft.

Wenn du Interesse daran hast, Teil von krisenchat zu werden und zusammen Kindern, Jugendlichen und jungen Erwachsenen Unterstützung anzubieten, dann bewirb dich gerne über die "Mitmachen"-Funktion unserer Website. Wir freuen uns auf das persönliche Kennenlerngespräch mit dir! Weitere Infos findest du auch auf unserer Website.

Wir sind eine große, tolle Gemeinschaft und freuen uns auf dich! Toll ist auch unsere Webseite - schau einfach mal vorbei!

Our deep understanding of the immune system — and innovative pipeline — enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world.
