About Keyfactor

Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor!

Title: Enterprise Sales Account Executive, Federal (formal title is Sales Director, Federal)

Location: United States, Washington DC Metro Area (Remote)

Experience: Senior Level

Job Function: Sales

Employment Type: Full-time

Industry: Computer and Network Security 

About the position

Keyfactor is seeking a Federal Sales Director to lead and grow our public sector business across U.S. federal civilian, defense, and intelligence agencies. In this role, you will own the federal go-to-market strategy for Keyfactor digital trust solutions, in your assigned territory.

You will work as part of a high-performing federal sales team, develop strategic relationships with agency stakeholders, system integrators, and channel partners, and navigate the federal procurement landscape, including contract vehicles, compliance requirements, and long-cycle opportunities. You will be accountable for pipeline development, forecasting, and revenue attainment, and will work closely with Marketing, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Legal to position Keyfactor as a trusted partner in the federal market.

The ideal candidate brings a proven record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder federal deals, deep familiarity with how agencies buy, and credibility with technical and executive audiences. Experience in cybersecurity, identity, or cryptography is strongly preferred.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Responsibilities

• Understands and contributes to contract negotiations.
• Delivers reliable forecasts and accurate reporting for the territory.
• Collaborates with marketing to build out the go-to-market (GTM) strategy.
• Manages pipeline over long sales cycles.
• Develops new accounts while maintaining and sustaining successful long-term relationships with key decision-makers up to and including the C-level.
• Contributes to the development of product, market, and competitor knowledge.

• Participates in events and tradeshows.

• Maintains a commitment to the company’s sales processes, values, and target visions.

Minimum Qualifications, Education, and Skills

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Technology, or equivalent experience.
• Strong understanding of IT security, PKI, and certificate lifecycle management.
• In-depth knowledge of market dynamics and competitor strategies.
• Familiarity with regulatory requirements in the IT Security industry.
• Experience with and knowledge of MEDDPICC, Solution Selling, and SPIN Selling.
• Ability to develop and execute strategic direction aligned with company goals.
• Proficient in using advanced sales tools and technologies.
• Ability to identify and develop opportunities for future business growth, including strategically important partnerships and key customers.
• Ability to coach others and share knowledge, insights, and skills with the broader team.
• Ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

Compensation

Salary will be commensurate with experience. 

Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits

We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas. 

Here are just some of the initiatives that make our culture special:  

  • Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). Please note that this benefit is subject to change.
  • Comprehensive benefit coverage globally.
  • Paid Parental Leave is available to new parents. Structure varies based on regional/government requirements. In regions where government-paid leave doesn’t exist, like in the U.S., the company offers generous paid parental leave, along with comprehensive adoption and fertility support.
  • Competitive time off globally.
  • Dedicated employee-focused ambassadors via Key Contributors & Culture Committees.
  • DIVERSE Commitment, a call to action for a more inclusive and diverse future in business, society, and technology.
  • The Keyfactor Alliance Program to support DEIB efforts.
  • Wellbeing resources, wellness allowance, mindfulness app free membership, Wellness Wednesdays.
  • Global Volunteer Day, company non-profit matching, and 3 volunteer days off.
  • Monthly Talent development and Cross Functional meetings to support professional development.
  • Regular All Hands meetings – followed by group gatherings.

Our Core Values

Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member:  

Trust is paramount.  

We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business.  

Customers are core.  

We strategize, operate, and execute through a customer-centric view. We prioritize the security interests of our customers, and we act as if their data were our own.  

Innovation never stops, it only accelerates.  

The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve.  

We deliver with agility.   

We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals.  

United by respect.   

Respect for all is what unites us. We promote diversity, inclusivity, equity, and acting with empathy and openness, both in our business and in our communities.  

Teams make “it” happen.  

Vision and goals are not individually achievable – they require teamwork. We pride ourselves in operating as a cohesive team, creating promoters and partners, and winning as one.

The Company:
Marigold is a fast-growing marketing technology company helping growing businesses build stronger customer relationships through its three core platforms: Emma, Campaign Monitor, and Vuture. We deliver powerful tools for email, SMS, and marketing automation that elevate engagement and drive real results. Marigold is headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee with offices in Sydney and London.


The Role:
At Emma, we’re looking for a driven, curious software engineer to join our team. The Emma Engineering organization is made up of passionate engineers focused on building elegant, reliable tooling that helps our customers succeed in their email marketing efforts. Our teams operate with clear ownership boundaries, allowing engineers to specialize, deepen their expertise, and build sustainable software that’s easy to support and evolve over time. We take pride in crafting creative, scalable solutions for a wide range of customers—and we genuinely enjoy doing it together.


This is an entry-level, Software Engineer role. On the frontend, we work primarily with React and supporting libraries, including a proprietary UI toolkit. Our backend systems are Python-driven, Django, and AWS-based. Experience in any of these areas is a plus, but a strong desire to learn and grow across the full stack is essential. Within your first six months, you’ll also have opportunities to contribute to additional areas of development as you continue to build your skills and expand your technical foundation.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build and ship code that solves real problems for real customers. Engineering is central to what we do, and you’ll work closely with your team to plan, experiment, and deliver impactful solutions.
  • Collaborate in code reviews, sharing ideas, learning from others, and helping raise the bar on quality and best practices.
  • Get hands-on with how Emma builds intuitive, scalable tooling that helps marketing teams do their best work.
  • Have fun while doing it! We care deeply about our customers, move with intention, and genuinely enjoy building great products together.
  • Use AI-assisted tools thoughtfully to research, prototype, and build, while learning how to apply them responsibly in a production codebase.

About You:

You’re an early-career developer who’s excited to learn, grow, and contribute as part of a collaborative engineering team. While you may not be a master of React, Python, or AWS yet, you bring curiosity, strong potential, and a genuine desire to build your skills and learn best practices. You care deeply about technology, the products you help create, and the customers who rely on them. You enjoy variety in your work, are eager to take on new challenges, and are motivated by opportunities to expand your knowledge and grow alongside a supportive team. You're comfortable using AI tools as part of your everyday workflow, and you know that good engineering still means understanding, questioning, and owning the code you ship.


Ideal Qualifications:

  • Early-career developer or recent graduate with a strong interest in software engineering
  • Foundational experience or exposure to modern technologies such as React, Python, AWS, or similar tools
  • Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies, frameworks, and best practices
  • Passion for building quality products with the end user in mind
  • Comfortable working across different areas of the codebase and contributing where needed
  • Strong collaboration skills and openness to feedback and continuous improvement
  • Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude) to speed up your work, and able to critically review, test, and own the code they help produce

Location Eligibility

This position is eligible for hire in the following US states: Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, and Virginia.

Compensation & Benefits


Compensation:
The base salary range for this role is $70,000 -$80,000 annually.

The compensation range represents the pay the Company reasonably expects to offer for this position. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, experience, qualifications, internal equity, geographic location, and applicable law.


Benefits:

  • Competitive benefits including: medical/dental/vision insurance, life/accident/disabilities insurance, supplemental health benefits, FSA, EAP and pet insurance
  • Generous time off (we call it Open Time Away) as well as paid holidays and a birthday benefit day off.
  • Paid Volunteer Time
  • 401k plan with a company match on your contributions.
  • Employee-centric and supportive remote work environment with flexibility.
  • Support for life events including paid parental leave.

raw.description:
Windows Server Architect

Overview

The Windows Server Architect leads the design and technical direction for migrating a federal client's Windows Server estate, hosted in a FedRAMP-authorized AWS GovCloud environment, from Windows Server 2016 to Windows Server 2019 or 2025 ahead of end of support. As the Windows subject matter expert, the role owns the upgrade architecture end to end, from discovery through hardening, testing, and rollback, and guides DevSecOps, Security, and Test team members to deliver compliant, low-risk upgrades for mission-critical systems.

Key Functions

  • Lead discovery of in-scope servers, cataloging roles, services, installed software, and dependencies.
  • Design the upgrade approach for each server (in-place vs. rebuild), including AMI selection, EC2 sizing, and a phased, wave-based sequence with go/no-go checkpoints between waves.
  • Define and validate OS hardening baselines (e.g., DISA STIGs, CIS Benchmarks, Active Directory Domain) and remediate outstanding security findings.
  • Design secure administrative access, including RDP/jump server configuration and CyberArk privileged access integration.
  • Plan certificate management and renewal, including certificate chain validation.
  • Design Windows IIS-dependent workloads, such as Power BI Gateway servers.
  • Partner with DevSecOps Engineers to automate Windows build standards and correct configuration drift.
  • Partner with the Test Manager on each wave's test strategy, success criteria, and rollback procedures, and maintain the project Risk Register.
  • Produce architecture artifacts (Implementation Blueprint, design documents, runbooks) in Confluence and Jira, ensuring alignment with the client's Technical Reference Model and audit, vulnerability requirements.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree and 7 years of relevant experience.
  • An additional 2 years of experience (9 years total) with an Associate’s Degree in lieu of a Bachelor’s Degree.
  • An additional 4 years of experience (11 years total) with a High School Diploma in lieu of a Bachelor’s Degree.
  • Demonstrated experience leading Windows Server 2016 to 2019 or 2025 migrations in AWS (GovCloud experience preferred), including upgrade planning, testing, and rollback.
  • Hands-on Windows Server OS hardening experience using federal and industry baselines.
  • Experience integrating Windows servers with CyberArk for privileged access management.
  • Deep Windows Server expertise (Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, PKI, patching, Remote Desktop Service) and strong PowerShell skills.
  • Working knowledge of AWS services for Windows workloads (EC2, AMIs, VPC, Systems Manager, EBS snapshots).
  • Experience with windows configuration management using Ansible (WMI, WinRM, PowerShell)
  • Strong technical leadership and communication skills, with the ability to direct engineers and lead discussions with federal stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications or Skills

  • Microsoft Windows Server certification: Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate, or the legacy MCSE: Core Infrastructure; equivalent hands-on experience may be considered.
  • AWS certification (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional).
  • Experience with AWS Systems Manager (Automated system patching)
  • Experience in managing software deployments through group policy.
  • Experience with Microsoft Power BI, including Power BI Gateway administration.
  • Experience configuring and hardening Windows IIS servers1.
  • Experience supporting federal government systems with audit and vulnerability management.

Position Details

  • Employment type: Full-Time, W2
  • Location: 100% Remote (US-based)
  • Hours: 40 hours/week with availability during core business hours of 8am-5pm ET
  • Eligibility: Must be eligible to obtain a Public Trust clearance

raw.description:
BEWERBUNG ÜBER DIE "MITMACHEN"-FUNKTION AUF UNSERER WEBSITE

krisenchat ist innerhalb kürzester Zeit zum größten Online-Beratungsangebot Deutschlands für junge Menschen in Not geworden. Wir sind eine agile Non-Profit-Organisation und bieten Kindern und Jugendlichen rund um die Uhr niedrigschwellige, effektive und wirksame psychosoziale Ersthilfe per Chat an. Seit Mai 2020 konnten die 300+ Krisenberater:innen schon in über 80.000 Krisensituationen helfen. Dabei erfolgt die Krisenberatung komplett remote und ist zeitlich flexibel einteilbar.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgabe wird in der Beratung von Kindern, Jugendlichen und jungen Erwachsenen liegen. Dabei treten häufig Themen, wie Ängste, Einsamkeit, depressive Symptomatiken oder Probleme in der Schule und Familie auf.

Jede Chatschicht geht über einen Zeitraum von 2,5 Stunden, die du dir zu einer freien Zeit deiner Wahl eintragen kannst. Da wir ein 24/7 Angebot sind, kannst du deine Zeit sehr flexibel über den Tag einteilen. Wir wünschen uns mind. 5 Stunden ehrenamtliche Tätigkeit im Monat. Über den genauen Ablauf wirst du in unserem Onboarding (Einführungsprogramm) informiert.

Du brauchst keine Sorgen zu haben, es wird immer ein:e Ansprechpartner:in da sein und in den Chatschichten achten wir darauf, dass ihr nicht alleine seid! Es gibt auch die Möglichkeit sich jederzeit mit einem unserer Team-Mitglieder auszutauschen.

Qualifikation

Um unsere Qualität in der Beratung nachhaltig zu sichern, können bei uns Personen mit einem akademischen Abschluss in den folgenden Fächern beraten:

  • Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium Psychologie oder Bachelorstudent:in mit Zusatzqualifikation oder intensiver Beratungserfahrung (keine Pflichtpraktika)
  • Psychotherapeut:innen in Ausbildung oder abgeschlossen in den nach den Psychotherapierichtlinien anerkannten Verfahren
  • Ärzt:innen mit Zusatzqualifikation Psychotherapie
  • Lehrer:innen und Pädagog:innen mit zusätzlichen psychosozialen Beratungserfahrungen
  • Sozialarbeiter:innen und Sozialpädagog:innen mit staatlicher Anerkennung
  • Nach individueller Prüfung auch andere, ähnliche Hintergründe mit sehr intensiver psychosozialer Beratungserfahrung

Für die Beratung benötigen alle Krisenberater:innen einen PC. Unsere Beratungstätigkeit erfolgt ausschließlich digital und unter Zuhilfenahme weiterer digitaler Werkzeuge. Grundlegende Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Computern werden vorausgesetzt.

Das Beraten von einem Mobilgerät (z.B. Tablet oder Handy) ist grundsätzlich nicht möglich. Kenntnisse der deutschen Sprache (in Schriftform) auf C2 Niveau werden zusätzlich benötigt. Der persönliche Kontakt ist für uns entscheidend - alle Interessent:innen lernen wir zunächst persönlich in einem Video-Call kennen. Das Vorlegen eines erweiterten polizeilichen Führungszeugnisses ist Pflicht.

Benefits

Dein Ehrenamt bei krisenchat ist eine Gelegenheit, Erfahrungen in einem innovativen digitalen Beratungsfeld zu sammeln. Durch die Niedrigschwelligkeit wirst du mit einem breiten Spektrum an Themen und Krisen konfrontiert. So wird dir ermöglicht, deine Kenntnisse im Bereich der Krisenintervention auszubauen. Du wirst eng mit einer sehr engagierten und diversen Community zusammenarbeiten und von den unterschiedlichen Erfahrungen und dem Austausch miteinander profitieren.

Zudem bieten wir kostenfreie Supervisionen in kleinen Gruppen und regelmäßig stattfindende Feedbackgespräche an.

Da uns die Aus- und Weiterbildung unserer Krisenberater:innen sehr am Herzen liegt, bieten wir neben unserem ausführlichen E-Learning-Programm die Teilnahme an diversen Workshops, Fachsprechstunden sowie Vorträgen externer Expert:innen zu unterschiedlichen Fachthemen an. Darüber hinaus hast du bei zahlreichen nicht-fachlichen, analogen und digitalen Austauschformate die Möglichkeit, deine Kolleg:innen kennenzulernen.

Wir sind eine stetig wachsende Gemeinschaft von engagierten und offenherzigen Menschen aus verschiedensten Bereichen der psychosozialen Hilfslandschaft.

Wenn du Interesse daran hast, Teil von krisenchat zu werden und zusammen Kindern, Jugendlichen und jungen Erwachsenen Unterstützung anzubieten, dann bewirb dich gerne über die "Mitmachen"-Funktion unserer Website. Wir freuen uns auf das persönliche Kennenlerngespräch mit dir! Weitere Infos findest du auch auf unserer Website.

Wir sind eine große, tolle Gemeinschaft und freuen uns auf dich! Toll ist auch unsere Webseite - schau einfach mal vorbei!

Job title: Director, Field Reimbursement – Rare Blood Disorders, West

  • Location: Remote, US

About the Job

In this field-based position, the Director, Field Reimbursement, reports to Senior Director, Field Reimbursement and leads related work within the Rare Blood Disorders Patient Support Services group.


In this field-based position, the Director, Field Reimbursement will be responsible for successfully hiring and leading a Field Reimbursement Manager (FRM) team to become the field subject matter experts relating to patient support, access, reimbursement, prior authorization, appeal, financial assistance, and related work within the Rare Blood Disorders Patient Support Services group throughout the defined geography. The Director will be called upon to successfully lead and motivate their Team to execute the National FRM strategy, supporting the initiatives set forth in the Patient Support Program plan.


Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi

We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system — and innovative pipeline — enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.

Main Responsibilities

  • Manage/Resolve day-to-day related objectives/areas that affect items within the FRM Scope of Work. Escalate to Senior Director when necessary.
  • Lead a team of FRMs in the development of territory and account Patient Support Program plans and account specific strategies and tactics that optimize Program performance.
  • Attract, develop, empower, and retain key talent by using innovative approaches to recognition and minimize regrettable attrition.
  • The FRMs will be the subject matter experts on patient support, access, reimbursement, prior authorizations, appeals, and financial assistance offerings from the Patient Support Program.
  • Spend time in the field with Field Reimbursement Managers to support individual development, help with issue resolution as well as provide coaching, direction, and feedback.
  • Establish positive working relationships with all key customer segments (internal and external).
  • Lead the development, review and implementation of Reimbursement programs and tools that strengthen reimbursement support services
  • Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the patient access journey, reimbursement and coverage issues within the defined geography and maintain open lines of communication within the Patient Service Teams, Market Access, Policy, Public Affairs, and relevant field teams by providing them with timely and actionable information and working together to resolve issues.
  • Uphold and exemplify Sanofi’s core values.

About You

Basic Qualifications:

  • BA/BS Degree required
  • 5+ years’ experience in the pharmaceutical/healthcare industry
  • The Director, Field Reimbursement is expected to be field-based, capable of covering the assigned geography.
  • Valid driver's license

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Specialty Biologics experience strongly preferred
  • Prior experience managing a team of employees or relevant experience.
  • Reimbursement/Access experience strongly preferred
  • Must be an energetic, driven dynamic leader
  • Excellent strategic thinking, analytical, communication and leadership skills required
  • Significant experience and understanding of the ever-changing Payer environment and its impact on access
  • Demonstrated success working in a matrix environment (sales, market access, customer service, medical affairs, marketing) and co-promote
  • Ability to quickly assemble and develop a high performing experienced team

Travel Requirements:

  • 50-75% travel, depending on the defined geography
  • Ability to travel to meetings/trainings/programs as necessary

Why Choose Us

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness program

raw.description:
About Keyfactor

Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor!

Title: Enterprise Sales Account Executive, Federal (formal title is Sales Director, Federal)

Location: United States, Washington DC Metro Area (Remote)

Experience: Senior Level

Job Function: Sales

Employment Type: Full-time

Industry: Computer and Network Security 

About the position

Keyfactor is seeking a Federal Sales Director to lead and grow our public sector business across U.S. federal civilian, defense, and intelligence agencies. In this role, you will own the federal go-to-market strategy for Keyfactor digital trust solutions, in your assigned territory.

You will work as part of a high-performing federal sales team, develop strategic relationships with agency stakeholders, system integrators, and channel partners, and navigate the federal procurement landscape, including contract vehicles, compliance requirements, and long-cycle opportunities. You will be accountable for pipeline development, forecasting, and revenue attainment, and will work closely with Marketing, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Legal to position Keyfactor as a trusted partner in the federal market.

The ideal candidate brings a proven record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder federal deals, deep familiarity with how agencies buy, and credibility with technical and executive audiences. Experience in cybersecurity, identity, or cryptography is strongly preferred.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Responsibilities

• Understands and contributes to contract negotiations.
• Delivers reliable forecasts and accurate reporting for the territory.
• Collaborates with marketing to build out the go-to-market (GTM) strategy.
• Manages pipeline over long sales cycles.
• Develops new accounts while maintaining and sustaining successful long-term relationships with key decision-makers up to and including the C-level.
• Contributes to the development of product, market, and competitor knowledge.

• Participates in events and tradeshows.

• Maintains a commitment to the company’s sales processes, values, and target visions.

Minimum Qualifications, Education, and Skills

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Technology, or equivalent experience.
• Strong understanding of IT security, PKI, and certificate lifecycle management.
• In-depth knowledge of market dynamics and competitor strategies.
• Familiarity with regulatory requirements in the IT Security industry.
• Experience with and knowledge of MEDDPICC, Solution Selling, and SPIN Selling.
• Ability to develop and execute strategic direction aligned with company goals.
• Proficient in using advanced sales tools and technologies.
• Ability to identify and develop opportunities for future business growth, including strategically important partnerships and key customers.
• Ability to coach others and share knowledge, insights, and skills with the broader team.
• Ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

Compensation

Salary will be commensurate with experience. 

Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits

We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas. 

Here are just some of the initiatives that make our culture special:  

  • Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). Please note that this benefit is subject to change.
  • Comprehensive benefit coverage globally.
  • Paid Parental Leave is available to new parents. Structure varies based on regional/government requirements. In regions where government-paid leave doesn’t exist, like in the U.S., the company offers generous paid parental leave, along with comprehensive adoption and fertility support.
  • Competitive time off globally.
  • Dedicated employee-focused ambassadors via Key Contributors & Culture Committees.
  • DIVERSE Commitment, a call to action for a more inclusive and diverse future in business, society, and technology.
  • The Keyfactor Alliance Program to support DEIB efforts.
  • Wellbeing resources, wellness allowance, mindfulness app free membership, Wellness Wednesdays.
  • Global Volunteer Day, company non-profit matching, and 3 volunteer days off.
  • Monthly Talent development and Cross Functional meetings to support professional development.
  • Regular All Hands meetings – followed by group gatherings.

Our Core Values

Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member:  

Trust is paramount.  

We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business.  

Customers are core.  

We strategize, operate, and execute through a customer-centric view. We prioritize the security interests of our customers, and we act as if their data were our own.  

Innovation never stops, it only accelerates.  

The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve.  

We deliver with agility.   

We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals.  

United by respect.   

Respect for all is what unites us. We promote diversity, inclusivity, equity, and acting with empathy and openness, both in our business and in our communities.  

Teams make “it” happen.  

Vision and goals are not individually achievable – they require teamwork. We pride ourselves in operating as a cohesive team, creating promoters and partners, and winning as one.  

Keyfactor is a proud equal opportunity employer including but not limited to veterans and individuals with disabilities. 

REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION: Applicants with disabilities may contact a member of Keyfactor’s People team via and/or telephone at 1.216.785.2990 to request and arrange for accommodations at any time.

HR Talent Coordinator

Are you an organized, detail-oriented HR professional with a passion for talent acquisition and people strategy? Do you enjoy building efficient recruitment processes, enhancing the candidate experience, and fostering strong, lasting employee relationships? If so, Codekeeper offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

We're looking for a proactive and ownership-driven individual to lead recruitment and support HR operations. You’ll play a key role in refining processes, driving continuous improvement, and helping us attract and retain top talent. The ideal candidate is eager to grow within the role, contribute to cross-functional projects, and bring fresh ideas to strengthen our evolving HR practices.

We’re accepting applications over the next two months and will close the position as soon as we find the right fit - so we encourage early applications.


Role Description

The HR Talent Coordinator will be responsible for managing the overall Human Resources (HR) strategies, systems, tactics, and procedures across Codekeeper. They will oversee recruitment activities, including sourcing, attracting, screening, interviewing, and assessing potential candidates, and onboarding new employees.


Key Responsibilities

Recruiting

  • Source, post, and optimize job openings on various platforms

  • Design and manage application and screening processes according to company policies

  • Expand recruitment reach and improve candidate engagement

Screening & Interviewing

  • Collaborate with department managers to define role requirements

  • Conduct initial screening calls and evaluate candidates based on established criteria

Offer Management

  • Present job offers to successful candidates, detailing position terms, remuneration, and benefits

Recruitment Process Optimization

  • Explore new platforms, tools, and strategies to enhance recruitment processes

  • Document procedures and workflows in the HR Recruitment Folder

HR Management

  • Develop, structure, and document HR procedures aligned with company policies

  • Manage onboarding processes to ensure a seamless transition for new hires

Employee Relations

  • Organize three online team gatherings and one offline team event per year to foster engagement and a strong company culture


About the Company

Codekeeper was founded by tech industry professionals to revolutionize software escrow for the cloud era. We offer state-of-the-art software escrow solutions that mitigate third-party risks in business operations. As a remote-first company with a central office in The Hague, we prioritize a healthy, resilient organization to support the development of our robust app.
🌐


What We Offer

  • Passionate and fun-loving colleagues

  • Startup mindset with ample opportunities for growth

  • Regular team activities and gatherings

  • Comprehensive onboarding process with a dedicated ramp-up period

  • A supportive team that values open communication and direct feedback

  • A chance to excel in your career and make a difference


Skills We Are Looking For

  • Proficiency in English, both written and verbal

  • Ability to adapt and multitask in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and strategic thinking skills


Required Experience

  • Background in recruitment, with experience in screening, interviewing, and assessing candidates

  • Experience in performance coaching

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: High Performance Computing Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $130,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a High Performance Computing Engineer with deep expertise in CUDA programming, GPU architecture, and high-performance computing to design and optimize compute-intensive workloads on modern accelerator hardware. This role focuses on extracting maximum performance from GPU platforms for AI training, inference, scientific computing, and high-throughput data processing workloads. The ideal candidate combines low-level systems mastery with strong software engineering practices, and has a track record of delivering measurable performance improvements on production GPU systems. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Six or more years of experience in GPU programming and performance engineering.
  • Deep expertise in CUDA C/C++ and GPU programming models.
  • Strong understanding of modern GPU architectures, memory hierarchies, and execution models.
  • Hands-on experience profiling and optimizing GPU workloads in production.
  • Familiarity with NCCL, MPI, and high-performance interconnect technologies.
  • Experience integrating custom kernels into ML frameworks.
  • Strong C++ skills and familiarity with modern systems programming practices.
  • Solid grounding in linear algebra and numerical methods.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with research and engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Triton, CUTLASS, or other GPU kernel authoring frameworks.
  • Familiarity with TensorRT, FasterTransformer, or vLLM internals.
  • Exposure to compiler infrastructure such as LLVM or MLIR.
  • Open-source contributions to GPU or ML performance libraries.
  • Experience with large-scale distributed training infrastructure.

raw.description:
Title: Director, Field Sales - Industrial Group (Fluke Test & Measurement)

Location:Americas (Remote)

Role Summary

The Director, Field Sales Industrial Group is responsible for the commercial performance of Fluke's industrial field sales organization across the United States. The role leads five District Sales Managers and, through them, the frontline territory sales team, with accountability for bookings, point-of-sale growth, funnel creation and conversion, market-share expansion, and customer retention across the industrial portfolio.

This is a role that balances tactical and strategic work. It sets the field operating rhythm- forecasting, funnel discipline, territory design, performance management while shaping where the organization places its coverage as industrial demand shifts toward data centers, electrification and distributed energy, grid and utility infrastructure, and advanced manufacturing. The Director is expected to be in market with local teams, close to customers and channel partners, and equally comfortable in a quarterly business review and on a plant floor.

The role spans the full industrial commercial value chain: end-user maintenance and reliability organizations, plant and facility engineering teams, electrical and mechanical contractors, industrial and electrical distribution partners, national accounts, OEMs and system integrators, utilities, and early-in-career and workforce training institutions. A working understanding of electrical test and measurement, thermal imaging, power quality, and condition monitoring workflows — and of how distributors and contractors actually buy — is essential.

Fluke has been an anchor business within Fortive for many years and materially influences segment profitability. It offers the opportunity to shape commercial strategy, develop future leaders, and influence growth across one of Fluke’s most important customer segments. This role carries real career upside: it is a proving ground for Vice President and General Manager succession within Fluke and across Fortive operating companies.

How We Sell - Our Commercial Beliefs

These beliefs shape how this role leads, coaches, and measures the field organization. The Director is expected to embody them personally and to build them into district operating rhythm, coaching conversations, and performance expectations.

  • We accelerate innovation through customer centricity:When we listen deeply to customers and understand their toughest challenges, we uncover opportunities to develop solutions that make a real difference.
  • We accelerate commercial execution through trust:Trust underpins all customer relationships, and we earn that credibility through every interaction, every day – even, and especially, before a customer makes a purchase.
  • We delight our existing customers by continuously creating value:Some of our greatest opportunities come from continuing to innovate and create value for the customers who already trust us. Our goal isn’t to close a single deal; it’s to help our users succeed in the long term.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership & Team Performance

  • Lead all aspects of field sales activity across the U.S. , creating a culture of accountability, execution excellence, and consistent delivery against customer and business commitments.
  • Manage, coach, and develop five District Sales Managers by creating an environment of trust, ownership, accountability, and continuous development that enables leaders and sellers to perform at their highest potential.
  • Empower District Sales Manager to make customer-focused business decisions, remove barriers to execution, and drive accountability within their teams.
  • Foster curiosity and a willingness to challenge assumptions, learn from setbacks, and continuously improve individual and organizational performance.
  • Mentor, evaluate, and appraise individual and district performance with a constant performance-improvement focus, applying Situational Leadership and structured coaching models.
  • Measure performance through a defined set of critical metrics, diagnose gaps, take ownership for organizational outcomes and install countermeasures that address root causes rather than symptoms.
  • Promote employee engagement through open communication, connecting individual performance to the commercial strategy, and to Fluke's broader vision.
  • Model in-market leadership by remaining close to customers, frontline sellers, and channel partners, actively listening to feedback and using those insights to improve decisions and organizational effectiveness.
  • Foster a culture of continuous learning, curiosity, and openness to feedback where successes are celebrated and lessons learned are openly shared.

Commercial Strategy & Market Expansion

  • Contribute to the development and execution of the Americas industrial commercial field strategy, translating it into district-level plans, coverage models, and quotas.
  • Shape territory design, coverage, and resource allocation to follow demand while proactively anticipating market shifts, building organizational capability ahead of emerging opportunities, and leading teams through change with clarity and confidence.
  • Identify underpenetrated segments, geographies, and product categories, and direct the organization's effort toward the highest-return growth opportunities.
  • Partner with Business Development, specialist, and key account resources to convert vertical strategies into territory-level execution and multi-site expansion.
  • Analyze competitive activity, pricing dynamics, and displacement risk, and develop field responses that protect installed base and win share.

Funnel Management & Operating Rigor

  • Elevate sales efficiency and drive consistent, repeatable sales processes across all districts while simultaneously growing customer point-of-sale and funnel.
  • Own forecast accuracy and pipeline integrity while fostering disciplined operating mechanisms that enable predictable execution and business performance.
  • Encourage experimentation with new selling approaches, growth initiatives, and customer engagement strategies that improve commercial effectiveness and customer outcomes.
  • Establish and run a disciplined cadence of funnel and pipeline success reviews, with particular focus on large and very large opportunities, hedging strategies, and conversion velocity.
  • Drive demand-generation follow-through, ensuring marketing-generated and event-generated leads are worked to a measurable conversion standard alongside seller-generated pipeline.
  • Use data to manage win rates by category, funnel additions and closed-won trends, coverage ratios, backlog conversion, and lead-time or delivery risk that could affect bookings.

Customer, Channel & Key Account Engagement

  • Establish and manage relationships with key customers and executive stakeholders, facilitating the team's efforts to identify, expand, and close opportunities.
  • Participate in and lead Key Account Reviews and other operational and business reviews, engaging cross-functional stakeholders as appropriate.
  • Strengthen joint execution with electrical and industrial distribution partners — including national and regional distributors — through joint planning, joint selling motions, workshops, and lunch-and-learn programs that expand end-user reach.
  • Champion the customer experience end to end, escalating and resolving barriers to growth such as lead-time visibility, service and calibration responsiveness, order support, and credit or commercial friction.
  • Influence specifications, standards, and approved-vendor decisions at large end users, contractors, and utilities so that Fluke solutions are specified in industrial workflows.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Marketing and Product Management to define industrial customer personas and workflows, and translate field insight into messaging, positioning, and campaign priorities.
  • Deliver structured voice-of-customer to Product Management, Marketing, and commercial leadership to identify emerging customer needs, improve solutions, and drive innovation priorities.
  • Break down organizational barriers and create alignment across commercial, marketing, product and operations teams to improve execution and customer outcomes.
  • Work with Sales Enablement to build segment- and product-specific training for sellers, distributors, and contractor-facing teams, and to raise NPI adoption in the field.
  • Collaborate with Service, Operations, and Customer Support to improve fulfillment, calibration capacity, and post-sale responsiveness where these constrain commercial performance.
  • Coordinate with Channel, National Account, and other Fluke business unit teams to pursue enterprise and cross-portfolio opportunities.

Talent, Culture & Organizational Development

  • Recruit, retain, and cultivate top sales talent; build and maintain a credible succession bench for District Sales Manager and other leadership roles.
  • Develop leadership bench strength by creating meaningful growth opportunities, expanding leadership capability across the organization, and producing future leaders prepared for broader responsibility across Fluke and Fortive.
  • Build engagement and cohesion across a geographically distributed, largely remote sales team.
  • Reinforce a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and safety- and integrity-first customer engagement.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of progressive sales and sales leadership experience in a dynamic, matrixed organization, including experience leading second-line managers.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead organizations through periods of growth, change, and ambiguity while maintaining engagement, accountability, and performance.
  • Demonstrated success creating highly engaged teams through empowerment, coaching, and talent development.
  • Demonstrated ability to build collaborative relationships across functions and incorporate diverse perspectives into decision-making.
  • Proven track record of consistently driving bookings and revenue growth, customer expansion, and market-share gain through the leadership of a distributed field sales organization.
  • Demonstrated success in change management and cross-functional collaboration in a commercially complex environment.
  • Experience owning forecast accuracy, funnel management, and CRM discipline at an organizational level rather than individual level.
  • Experience leveraging customer insights and market trends to influence commercial strategy, solution development, or go-to-market innovation.
  • Experience selling through and with distribution channel partners and building joint go-to-market motions with distributors and contractor networks.
  • Strong executive presence and polish, with the potential and appetite for succession into Vice President or General Manager roles within Fluke and Fortive.
  • Consistent record of building engagement across a virtual sales team while recruiting, retaining, and developing top sales talent.
  • Excellent analytical skills and a validated eye for business, with the ability to balance the needs of the marketplace against sound business judgment.
  • Strong leadership and sales competence paired with a hands-on, 'get it done' mentality that is a hallmark of successful leaders at Fortive.
  • Ability to operate effectively in both highly structured processes and ambiguous, build-it-from-scratch situations.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% across North America.
  • Bachelor's degree required.

Preferred Experience & Skills:

  • Direct experience in test and measurement, electrical or industrial equipment, industrial maintenance and reliability, or adjacent technical industries.
  • Familiarity with industrial customer workflows including electrical troubleshooting, preventive and predictive maintenance, power quality analysis, thermal imaging, and condition monitoring.
  • Experience leading sales into growth verticals such as data centers, distributed energy and EV charging, utilities and power generation, or advanced manufacturing.
  • Experience with national and regional electrical or industrial distribution partners, and with national account structures.
  • Track record of influencing standards, specifications, or approved vendor lists within large end users, contractors, or utilities.
  • Experience improving sales productivity through process design, tooling, analytics, or commercial operating systems.
  • Experience building or scaling business development, specialist, or vertical-focused selling resources within a field organization.
  • Exposure to workforce development, technical education, or early-in-career channel programs as a demand-creation lever.
  • Experience operating within a continuous-improvement or business-system-driven environment.
  • Master of Business Administration (MBA)or advanced degree preferred.

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

Role Title: VA Eligibility Specialist

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is looking for VA Eligibility Specialists to help evaluate and improve AI systems on veterans health care topics. You’ll use your enrollment and eligibility experience to check that questions sound like real veterans and families, and that answers are correct and useful. Accuracy comes first. No AI experience is needed; your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Review sample VA health care questions and flag any that don’t sound like what real veterans or family members ask.

  4. US-based
  5. Able to start quickly and commit 20-30 hours/week
  6. Clear, precise writing

Nice to Have

  1. Experience with veteran outreach and helping veterans apply for health care
  2. Experience creating guides, checklists, or training materials
  3. Experience helping a diverse range of veterans and families, including rural and non-English-speaking clients

raw.description:
About Edged Data Centers Edged is a fast-growing provider of sustainable data centers and energy infrastructure. The company builds and operates a global network of ultra-efficient, AI-ready data centers with waterless cooling for colocation, hyperscale and build-to-suit customers. The highly differentiated infrastructure platform is the first large-scale, global deployment of waterless cooling platform-wide and transforms data center growth into a catalyst for sustainable development. Edged is backed by a deep proprietary technology stack that will include renewable microgrid systems, ultra-clean generators, and waste-to-fuel solutions. The platform is designed for rapid deployment with more than a dozen new data centers operating or under construction across Europe and North America and a gigawatt-scale project pipeline. The North American division of Edged is a joint venture between one of the largest private multinational corporations in the world and an affiliate of Endeavour. Endeavour is a purpose-driven organization helping innovators to develop and launch breakthrough solutions for global challenges in the areas of energy, water, and waste. Endeavour companies are made up of passionate change-makers who want to leave the world better than the way we found it. Today, Endeavour is deploying solutions that are immediately scalable and deliver both high financial returns and positive impact, including EV charging, waterless data center cooling, and advanced energy systems.

Opportunity:

The BMS / Controls Program Manager will be a vital member of the North American division of Edged Data Centers. We are looking for someone who has experience and the ability to design, develop, commission and maintain Data Center critical infrastructure control systems. This role involves ensuring that all systems such as the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS) and any system used to operate HVAC systems, power distribution, and cooling systems operate efficiently, reliably and in compliance with industry standards and regulations. This role will work closely with cross-functional teams such as Network/IT, engineering design, construction, and facility maintenance to develop new processes and ensure efficient operation of data center facilities. The BMS / Controls Program Manager needs to be an agile, team-focused individual, with proven professionalism, who is comfortable in a rapidly changing environment. The right person is trustworthy with confidential information, highly organized, self-motivated, has excellent communication skills, can think strategically, and works equally as well independently as with a team. Edged strives to maintain smooth operations and achieves this by empowering our people, by providing autonomy and flexibility in the way we work, by developing a habit of constant, open communication, and by creating a culture of excellence, appreciation, trust, and respect.

Key Responsibilities

Include but are not limited to:

  • Manage, onboard and lead the BMS contractors, Control system integrators and control installation contractors throughout all phases of the project.
  • Establish a vision and goal for the BMS systems and controls program across all sites. Ensure consistency, standardization, reliability and functionality meets product goals.
  • Develop a BMS Playbook. The playbook will provide guidance for Build out of programs, PLC set up and operation of BMS type systems to include BMS, PMS and EPMS along with any HVAC controls.
  • We have a variety of control systems across various sites so broad experience programming and configuration commissioning will be highly advantageous. Systems include and not limited to Tridium Niagara Front-End Software, Niagara Connect Centralization tools, Distech Controls Hardware, Power Quality Metering, Communication protocol. Proven experience with data collection and conversion software will be highly regarded, as will exposure to DDC, PLC, DCS debugging and programming.
  • Perform BMS inspections (wiring, installation, and commissioning) and validate the status/progress of the projects including supporting the project teams, both internal and external, starting from the early stages of MEP construction by working with project level Construction Managers (both internal and external) to check the health of the project (including schedule).
  • Support incident management on breakdowns associated with BMS systems and or controls.
  • Work with project level Construction Managers, QA/QC Site leads and General Contractor's to ensure creation, accuracy and maintenance of logic driven schedule for construction, commissioning, and packaged equipment BMS activities.
  • Coordinate equipment factory installed controls audits and BMS commissioning to ensure specification/requirement are being adhered and manage correction of all identified deficiencies.

raw.description:
Who We Are

International Justice Mission (IJM) is the global leader in protecting vulnerable people from violence around the world. Our team of over 1,200 professionals are at work worldwide in over 30 offices. Together we are on a mission to rescue millions, protect half a billion, and make justice unstoppable.

We are a global community that cares for one another. We believe that the way we work is as important as the results we achieve. We provide professional excellence with joy and celebration to all those we serve. 

The Need

For over 25 years, IJM has pioneered the work to protect vulnerable people from violence. 9 out of 9 times in the last decade, IJM’s Justice System Strengthening Projects have reduced slavery and violence between 50 and 85% for very large populations of people in poverty. As we grow to expand our impact to protect 500 million people from violence, we are seeking a Sr. Officer, U.S. Philanthropy to cultivate deep, trust-based relationships with existing donors to inspire continued and increased giving, while also identifying and engaging new supporters through strategic networking and regional connections. This leader will play a pivotal role in expanding IJM’s donor footprint and deepening engagement across the region through personalized cultivation, solicitation and stewardship, as well as through collaboration on events and donor experiences. 

This position is remote and requires candidates to be based in the San Francisco, California area. It reports to the Director, U.S. Philanthropy, and requires current authorization to work in the United States. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position, now or in the future.

Responsibilities:

Strategy & Knowledge Development & Implementation:

  • Develop, implement and evaluate strategies to significantly broaden and deepen the base of support from major donors in the region; and
  • Leverage Salesforce to maintain accurate donor records and track engagement; regularly update projections, contact reports, and giving history to drive strategic fundraising decisions and donor stewardship. 

Networking & Partnership:

  • Manage a portfolio of approximately 150 major donors and foundations;
  • Cultivate, solicit, and steward existing donors to increase funding levels;
  • Identify and build relationships with new individuals and foundations, including onboarding major donors transitioning from mid-level portfolios;
  • Coordinate with IJM leaders globally to design engagement opportunities aligned with donor passions and field needs;
  • Collaborate with HQ events team to plan and implement regional events that deepen relationships and attract new supporters;
  • Partner with Mobilization teams to identify and cultivate major donor leads from church and workplace engagement efforts; and
  • Develop and execute strategies to expand the donor base through networks, events, and media-driven opportunities.

Communication:

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage high-potential donors clearly, intelligently, and with compelling passion for the mission;
  • Ability to communicate consistently in the donor’s preferred style, delivering clear, mission-aligned messages that resonate and inspire action; and
  • Proactively communicate with the Senior Manager regarding pressing needs, priorities, and strategic opportunities, while collaborating closely with Senior Associates to ensure seamless execution and alignment across the team.

Documentation, Reporting & Data Management:

  • Leverage Salesforce to maintain accurate donor records and track engagement; regularly update projections, contact reports, and giving history to drive strategic fundraising decisions and donor stewardship. 

Events and Logistics:

  • Facilitate international vision trips that allow donors to experience IJM’s global impact firsthand, ensuring seamless planning and exceptional donor experience.
  • Lead and host high-impact donor events, including The IJM Justice Gathering—our signature regional event drawing 500+ guests annually—to deepen engagement and inspire generosity.
  • Proactively invite and engage donors in virtual and in-person experiences, such as the President’s Weekend and Advocacy Summit, to strengthen relationships and advance mission alignment.

General tasks:

  • Coordinate meetings between the CEO’s office, field leaders, and key stakeholders to ensure timely and effective engagement;
  • Schedule and manage donor and stakeholder meetings, ensuring seamless logistics and follow-up;
  • Collaborate with the Marketing team to review seasonal messaging and ensure donor communications and mailings are accurate and delivered on time;
  • Complete timesheets and expense reports promptly and in compliance with organizational standards; and
  • Participate in IJM’s community of spiritual formation.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required;
  • 5+ years of fundraising experience or equivalent sales experience required;
  • Proven track record of securing $1M+ annually from major donors and foundations, including successful solicitation of principal-level gifts ($1M+), or equivalent in high-value sales;
  • Proven track record of effectiveness as an influencer and collaborator on cross-functional teams;
  • A proven track record of emotionally compelling public speaking and presentation that moves people to action;
  • Experience managing, tracking, and reporting on the financial efforts of a donor portfolio;
  • Extensive experience with donor cultivation, donor portfolio, and moves management;
  • Salesforce Experience a plus;
  • Proven ability to effectively develop, nurture, and maintain individual relationships and the skill to lead those individuals to make joyful financial investments;
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills;
  • Experience speaking to high-potential donors effectively, intelligently, and passionately; and
  • Highly developed capacity to accurately and objectively evaluate the effectiveness and outcomes of donor strategies and to make appropriate adjustments.

Critical Qualities:

  • Mature orthodox Christian faith as defined by the Apostles’ Creed; 
  • Eager commitment to IJM’s Core Values: Christian, Professional and Bridge-Building;
  • Winsome and compelling communicator;
  • Driven and tenacious problem solver;
  • Agile and responsive team player; 
  • Courageous and intuitive decision-maker;
  • Skilled listener with strong emotional intelligence; 
  • Exceptionally high integrity and honesty;
  • High standard of personal discipline;
  • Unwavering positivity and perseverance; 
  • Comfortable engaging with a diverse audience of people and personalities; and 
  • Globally minded.

Application Process:

Upload Resume, Cover Letter & Statement of Faith* in one PDF document.

*What is a statement of faith?
A statement of faith should describe your Christian faith and how you see it as relevant to your involvement with IJM. The statement can either be incorporated into the cover letter or submitted as a separate document and should include, at a minimum, a description of your spiritual disciplines (prayer, study, etc.) and your current fellowship or place of worship.

What does IJM have to offer?

  • Comprehensive Medical/Dental/Vision benefits
  • Monthly commuter and parking benefits in the DC metro area
  • Retirement benefit options
  • Paid leave starting at 23 days
  • 12 holidays (plus early release the day prior)
  • Daily, quarterly, and annual community spiritual formation
  • Robust staff care resources

IJM holds strict safeguarding principles and a zero tolerance to violations of the Safeguarding Policy, Protection against Sexual Exploitation, Abuse and Harassment Policy, and Code of Ethics. Candidate selection is based on technical competence, recruitment, selection and hiring criteria subject to assessing the candidate’s value congruence and thorough background, police clearance, and reference check processes.

At IJM, we’re committed to building a diverse workforce through fair and equitable employment practices. IJM encourages people of any race, color, age, sex, marital status or political ideology to apply for employment. While we welcome everyone into this work, we truly believe that the work we are doing is God’s work, not our own, and practice spiritual disciplines together daily. That’s why we legally require under SEC. 2000e-1 [Section702] of Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 that all employees practice a mature orthodox Christian faith, as defined by the Apostles’ Creed.

IJM requires a background check, police clearance and thorough review of references with an employment offer and/or employment contract.

Position Summary

The Binding Operations Coordinator – Transportation is responsible for the accurate and timely binding of insurance coverage within carrier systems, as well as supporting endorsement processing activities. This role supports underwriting operations by reviewing applications, validating data, ensuring system accuracy, interpreting carrier guidelines, and completing required filings. The Binding Operations Coordinator works closely with underwriters, agents, and carriers to ensure the seamless execution of binding and endorsement activities while maintaining compliance with company and carrier requirements.

What will your job entail?

Key Responsibilities

 

Binding Processing & Execution

  • Review and process bind requests to ensure timely and accurate handling
  • Validate application data against carrier system entries and update information as needed to ensure accuracy and completeness
  • Bind coverage within carrier platforms in accordance with underwriting direction and carrier guidelines
  • Complete required filings and documentation as part of the binding process
  • Verify all binding documentation meets quality standards and compliance requirements
  • Review endorsement requests and determine appropriate processing requirements based on carrier guidelines and policy-specific considerations.

 

Stakeholder Support

  • Partner with underwriters, retail agents, and carrier representatives to facilitate binding activities
  • Respond to inquiries related to binding status, endorsement processing, requirements, and discrepancies
  • Serve as a subject matter resource for offshore processing teams, providing guidance and resolving questions related to complex endorsement scenarios
  • Communicate clearly and professionally to resolve issues and prevent delays in binding
  • Escalate complex issues or discrepancies appropriately

 

Process Execution & Oversight

  • Manage assigned binding and endorsement workload to meet service level expectations and turnaround times
  • Ensure adherence to company policies, carrier guidelines, and regulatory requirements
  • Identify inconsistencies or data issues and take appropriate corrective actions
  • Review and assist with complex endorsement requests that require additional underwriting analysis or specialized handling
  • Support implementation of process improvements and standard operating procedures

 

Collaboration & Training

  • Assist in onboarding and training new team members on binding workflows and systems
  • Collaborate with leadership to enhance operational efficiency and standardization
  • Share knowledge and best practices across the team to improve overall performance

 

Qualifications

  • Experience in insurance operations, underwriting support, or a related role
  • Exposure to transportation insurance or the ability to quickly learn transportation-specific workflows
  • Experience working in a centralized processing or shared services environment is helpful but not required
  • Strong attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and quality control
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills and ability to manage escalated or complex tasks
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to collaborate across multiple stakeholders
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a high-volume, fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Teams, and OneNote is helpful

 

Key Competencies

  • Detail orientation and quality focus
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Process improvement mindset
  • Organization and time management
  • Accountability and ownership

raw.description:
Are you a Kaqchikel language expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful tools for communication, education, and cultural preservation. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can accurately capture Kaqchikel vocabulary, grammar, dialectical variations, and cultural context—helping preserve Mayan knowledge and support authentic linguistic interactions. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for Kaqchikel language specialists who live and breathe regional dialects, phonetics, syntax, idiomatic expressions, oral traditions, and cultural references. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like contextual interpretation, tone and meaning, dialectical distinctions, semantic accuracy, and cultural nuance—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model in Kaqchikel across a wide range of topics, verify linguistic accuracy and cultural relevance, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.

A Master's degree in Linguistics, Indigenous Studies, Translation, or a related field is ideal; professional experience in teaching, translation, language documentation, or community work signals fit. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.

Ready to turn your Kaqchikel expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

We offer a pay range of $8-to-$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. raw.description:
Position Summary

The Binding Operations Coordinator – Transportation is responsible for the accurate and timely binding of insurance coverage within carrier systems, as well as supporting endorsement processing activities. This role supports underwriting operations by reviewing applications, validating data, ensuring system accuracy, interpreting carrier guidelines, and completing required filings. The Binding Operations Coordinator works closely with underwriters, agents, and carriers to ensure the seamless execution of binding and endorsement activities while maintaining compliance with company and carrier requirements.

What will your job entail?

Key Responsibilities

 

Binding Processing & Execution

  • Review and process bind requests to ensure timely and accurate handling
  • Validate application data against carrier system entries and update information as needed to ensure accuracy and completeness
  • Bind coverage within carrier platforms in accordance with underwriting direction and carrier guidelines
  • Complete required filings and documentation as part of the binding process
  • Verify all binding documentation meets quality standards and compliance requirements
  • Review endorsement requests and determine appropriate processing requirements based on carrier guidelines and policy-specific considerations.

 

Stakeholder Support

  • Partner with underwriters, retail agents, and carrier representatives to facilitate binding activities
  • Respond to inquiries related to binding status, endorsement processing, requirements, and discrepancies
  • Serve as a subject matter resource for offshore processing teams, providing guidance and resolving questions related to complex endorsement scenarios
  • Communicate clearly and professionally to resolve issues and prevent delays in binding
  • Escalate complex issues or discrepancies appropriately

 

Process Execution & Oversight

  • Manage assigned binding and endorsement workload to meet service level expectations and turnaround times
  • Ensure adherence to company policies, carrier guidelines, and regulatory requirements
  • Identify inconsistencies or data issues and take appropriate corrective actions
  • Review and assist with complex endorsement requests that require additional underwriting analysis or specialized handling
  • Support implementation of process improvements and standard operating procedures

 

Collaboration & Training

  • Assist in onboarding and training new team members on binding workflows and systems
  • Collaborate with leadership to enhance operational efficiency and standardization
  • Share knowledge and best practices across the team to improve overall performance

 

Qualifications

  • Experience in insurance operations, underwriting support, or a related role
  • Exposure to transportation insurance or the ability to quickly learn transportation-specific workflows
  • Experience working in a centralized processing or shared services environment is helpful but not required
  • Strong attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and quality control
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills and ability to manage escalated or complex tasks
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to collaborate across multiple stakeholders
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a high-volume, fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Teams, and OneNote is helpful

 

Key Competencies

  • Detail orientation and quality focus
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Process improvement mindset
  • Organization and time management
  • Accountability and ownership
