Acute Care Technology

At ZOLL, we're passionate about improving patient outcomes and helping save lives.

We provide innovative technologies that make a meaningful difference in people's lives. Our medical devices, software and related services are used worldwide to diagnose and treat patients suffering from serious cardiopulmonary and respiratory conditions.

The Acute Care Technology division of ZOLL Medical Corporation develops and delivers innovative lifesaving products and software solutions to EMS, hospital, public safety, and military customers globally. Our dedicated employees take pride in their commitment to improving patient outcomes while delivering world-class customer service.

At ZOLL, you won’t just have a job. You’ll have a career—and a purpose.

Join our team. It’s a great time to be a part of ZOLL!

Job Type: Remote

Job Summary

The Clinical Implementation Specialist (CIS) will coordinate post-sale customer education and training initiatives, and act as the clinical and technical expert for the ZOLL hospital product line. Within the direction of the Clinical Education Team, the CIS works collaboratively with the Territory Manager throughout the sales process, and builds deep, long lasting customer relationships to encourage ongoing utilization of ZOLL hospital products and achievement of desired clinical outcomes within an account.

The CIS utilizes principles of adult learning in the assessment, program planning, implementation, and evaluation phases of the educational process. Emphasis is on competency skill assessment and development of all clinical staff through Identification of learning needs. Coordination and provision of educational offerings including orientation, formal continuing education and in-services, are a major function of this role. The CIS serves as a resource to staff of all levels and provides direct training/education of newly hired staff and new customers through facilitation of the preceptor model.

The CIS actively participates in leadership of quality Improvement processes and affecting process and protocol changes within the account's resuscitation algorithm. Other duties assigned may include support to the sales team, speaking opportunities all trade shows, attendance at trade shows for the company booth and training distributor partners as needed, or other functions as needed. The successful CIS develops and maintains customer relationships and is capable of operating in a self-directive role.

The CIS is uniquely assigned to large hospital systems and manages the implementation from a system-wide perspective through end-users.

Essential Functions

  • Act as a project manager in planning/developing/executing all educational and training events in a customer account.
  • Assist with and/or initiating in-servicing events in existing and new accounts.
  • Communicate leads and account updates to outside Territory Manager.
  • Provide input to prepare additional materials as needed in the support of sales and training.
  • Organize and conducting educational events in existing or new accounts.
  • Act as a clinical and technical product expert for all ZOLL Hospital products, in order to discuss the chain of resuscitation.
  • Be a passionate advocate for improving patient outcomes in an inpatient hospital setting.

Required/Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree BA or BS preferred
  • RN, Paramedic, or RT with 5+ years of experience required
  • AHA Instructor - BLS/ACLS/PALS preferred
  • Clinical education experience preferred
  • Project management experience preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to effectively educate clinical personnel
  • Ability to affect change through education and evidence based clinical literature
  • Ability to seamlessly Integrate technology (iPad, Outlook, Microsoft Suite) into work.
  • Demonstrated flexibility, autonomy, self-motivation, and a high level of professional demeanor
  • Ability to work effectively with and direct training and In-servicing programs to achieve highest level of product compliance
  • Ability to lead and influence a cross-functional team and operate in a highly complex environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Must be able to improvise in customer situations to achieve a successful resolution.
  • Comfortable interacting with the C-Suite Team.
  • Must possess a strong personal presence.
  • Ability to handle multiple demands from many people and prioritize effectively
  • Ability to stay calm and demonstrate a "can do" attitude. Finds opportunity in difficulties.
  • Excellent client-facing and internal communication skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Solid organizational skills, including attention to detail and multi-tasking skills.
  • Ability to meet deadlines and follow-up
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office
  • Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills

Travel Requirements

  • Availability to travel up to 75%, current passport required

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

  • Standing - Occasionally
  • Walking - Occasionally
  • Sitting - Constantly
  • Talking - Occasionally

  • Repetitive Motions - Frequently

JOB OVERVIEW:

This position plays a pivotal role in building and leading a newly created inside sales team to drive revenue growth across Henry Schein’s Medical and Dental divisions. The Director of Inside Sales is responsible for the creation, management and execution of sales initiatives, including developing strategies to optimize inside sales processes and expand our customer base, while achieving ambitious targets and fostering a high-performance culture.


Reporting to the Vice President of Sales, the Director will collaborate cross-functionally to align sales efforts with company goals, leveraging data-driven insights to enhance customer engagement and market penetration in the healthcare sector.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Leadership & Team Management
    • Lead the formation and development of the new inside sales team, including recruitment, onboarding, training, and ongoing coaching to build a results-oriented group. Includes Territory funding, creation and expansion.
    • Develop and implement training programs to enhance the skills and performance of the sales team.
    • Conduct regular performance reviews and provide ongoing feedback.
  • Sales Strategy and Execution
    • Design and implement comprehensive sales strategies and initiatives tailored to inside sales channels, focusing on lead generation, customer acquisition, upselling, and retention for medical and dental products.
    • Represent the team in leadership meetings, providing reports on sales performance, forecasts, and strategic initiatives.
    • Set and monitor sales targets, KPIs, and performance metrics; conduct regular reviews to ensure alignment with divisional and company objectives, adjusting tactics as needed to exceed goals.
    • Identify new market opportunities and develop plans to capitalize on them.
  • Business Development
    • Collaborate with marketing, product category, and support teams to integrate sales initiatives with broader business strategies, including demand generation programs and tool optimization.
    • Foster strong customer relationships through virtual channels (phone, email, virtual), ensuring a customer-centric approach that supports healthcare practitioners’ needs.
    • Partner closely with regional management to align on hiring decisions, periodic reviews of episodic/low-volume customers, and ensure success at the regional level.
  • Financial Responsibility
    • Manage day-to-day operations of the inside sales team, including pipeline forecasting, territory planning, and resource allocation to maximize efficiency and productivity.
    • Develop and manage forecasts, sales budget, and financial report to ensure cost-effective allocation of resources.
    • Ensure the team meets or exceeds financial targets and contributes to overall company profitability.
  • Process Improvement
    • Analyze sales data, market trends, and customer feedback to identify opportunities, refine value proposition, and drive continuous improvement in sales processes.
    • Develop incentive programs, performance management systems, and team culture to motivate and retain top talent.
    • Implement best practices and leverage technology to enhance team performance.
    • Ensure compliance with company policies and industry regulations.

SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Proven track record of building and scaling sales teams, achieving or exceeding revenue targets, and executing sales initiatives in a B2B environment.
  • Strong understanding of inside sales techniques, including lead qualification, virtual selling, and CRM systems
  • Experience in healthcare distribution, with knowledge of medical and dental supplies, equipment, and services.
  • Experience launching new sales teams or initiatives in a growth-oriented organization.
  • Proficiency in sales automation tools, data analytics software, and remote team management.

GENERAL SKILLS & COMPETENCIES:

  • Outstanding management and leadership skills and ability to attract, retain, motivate, develop, mentor and coach team members for high performance
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills and ability to resolve disputes effectively
  • Outstanding presentation and public speaking skills
  • Expert independent decision making, analysis and problem-solving skills
  • Understand, interpret and act on financial information and external trends that contributes to business profitability
  • Plan and manage complex and successful projects; understand available resources, develop timeline, budget and assign areas of responsibility
  • Lead teams to achieve company goals and solve complex business issues in creative and effective ways
  • Expert planning and organizational skills and techniques
  • Communicate effectively with senior management and key stakeholders
  • Excellent negotiating skills and ability to effectively manage internal and external relationships

raw.excerpt: Are you a Kaqchikel language expert eager to shape the future of AI?
raw.description:
Are you a Kaqchikel language expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful tools for communication, education, and cultural preservation. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can accurately capture Kaqchikel vocabulary, grammar, dialectical variations, and cultural context—helping preserve Mayan knowledge and support authentic linguistic interactions. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for Kaqchikel language specialists who live and breathe regional dialects, phonetics, syntax, idiomatic expressions, oral traditions, and cultural references. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like contextual interpretation, tone and meaning, dialectical distinctions, semantic accuracy, and cultural nuance—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model in Kaqchikel across a wide range of topics, verify linguistic accuracy and cultural relevance, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.

A Master's degree in Linguistics, Indigenous Studies, Translation, or a related field is ideal; professional experience in teaching, translation, language documentation, or community work signals fit. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.

Ready to turn your Kaqchikel expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

We offer a pay range of $8-to-$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

raw.description:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen Safety & Compliance Specialist mit Schwerpunkt Functional Safety und CE-Management. Die Position ist organisatorisch dem Team Technische Dokumentation zugeordnet und betreut die operative Umsetzung der Anforderungen an funktionale Sicherheit und Produktkonformität.

Die technische Auslegung und Umsetzung verbleiben bei den verantwortlichen Fachbereichen. Der Safety & Compliance Specialist koordiniert die Konformitätsplanung, prüft die Vollständigkeit der Nachweise und unterstützt die Fachbereiche bei der regelkonformen Umsetzung. Wesentliche Safety- oder Konformitätsabweichungen können unmittelbar an den Head of Quality eskaliert werden.

IHRE AUFGABEN

  • Operative Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung des Safety Management Systems gemäß IEC 61508/IEC 61511 sowie des CE-Management-Prozesses.

  • Ermittlung und Bewertung anwendbarer EU-Harmonisierungsrechtsvorschriften, Normen und Konformitätsbewertungsverfahren gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen.

  • Erstellung und Pflege produkt- und projektbezogener Konformitätspläne mit erforderlichen Nachweisen, Verantwortlichkeiten, Freigaben und Terminen.

  • Koordination von Safety- und CE-Prüfpunkten vor Designfreigabe, FAT, Auslieferung und Inverkehrbringen.

  • Planung, Koordination und Moderation von HAZOP, LOPA, FMEA und Risikobeurteilungen sowie Nachverfolgung der vereinbarten Maßnahmen.

  • Festlegung der Anforderungen an Sicherheits- und Konformitätsnachweise sowie Prüfung der Vollständigkeit der von den Fachbereichen bereitgestellten Unterlagen.

  • Planung und Begleitung von Functional Safety Assessments und Konformitätsbewertungen mit externen Prüfstellen oder notifizierten Stellen.

  • Abstimmung CE- und Safety-relevanter Anforderungen an Lieferanten, Materialien, Betriebsanleitungen und technische Dokumentation.

  • Bewertung von Änderungen hinsichtlich Functional Safety, Risikobeurteilung, Konformitätsbewertung und CE-Kennzeichnung.

  • Dokumentation und Eskalation wesentlicher Abweichungen sowie Vorbereitung von Status- und Freigabeempfehlungen für Head of Quality und CTO.

Requirements

IHR PROFIL

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Ingenieur- oder Naturwissenschaften, zum Beispiel Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Maschinenbau oder Verfahrenstechnik.

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in funktionaler Sicherheit nach IEC 61508/IEC 61511; Zertifizierung als Functional Safety Engineer oder Professional von Vorteil.

  • Kenntnisse im CE-Management, in der Konformitätsplanung und in der Anwendung europäischer Harmonisierungsrechtsvorschriften im Maschinen- oder Anlagenbau.

  • Erfahrung mit Risikobeurteilungen sowie idealerweise mit der Moderation von HAZOP und LOPA.

  • Erfahrung in der Prüfung technischer Nachweise und in der Zusammenarbeit mit externen Prüfstellen oder notifizierten Stellen.

  • Strukturierte, verantwortungsbewusste und durchsetzungsfähige Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Moderationskompetenz.

  • Einschlägige Berufserfahrung in Prozessindustrie, Anlagenbau oder Energietechnik sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

WIR BIETEN IHNEN

Gemeinsam wachsen

  • Ein Team, das zusammenhält, Ideen teilt und sich gegenseitig unterstützt.

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen an Ihrer Seite.

  • Regelmäßige Weiterbildungen, Schulungen und Zertifizierungen sowie individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, die Ihre Stärken fördern – fachlich wie persönlich.

Ihre Arbeitswelt

  • Spannende Aufgaben und Projekte in einem wachsenden Unternehmen.

  • Zusammenarbeit mit namhaften Kunden weltweit.

  • Selbstständiges und eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit viel Raum für eigene Ideen – in einem innovativen Team mit starkem Rückhalt.

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, offene Kommunikation und eine familiäre Unternehmenskultur.

Rahmenbedingungen, die Ihnen Sicherheit geben

  • 30 Urlaubstage und stellenabhängig flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle (38,5 Std. oder Teilzeit) mit Gleit- und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

  • Ein unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis und langfristige Perspektiven.

  • Sie profitieren von vielfältigen Zusatzleistungen – unter anderem Zuschuss zur Altersvorsorge, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, mobiles Arbeiten, Mitarbeiterevents, attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte, zahlreiche Benefits über unsere ValueNet-Partnerschaft sowie kostenfreies frisches Obst – und vielen weiteren Angeboten.

Job Description

DUTIES: Responsible for executing both manual and automated test scripts to verify Infotainment component function and performance requirements. Configure benches to support specific test scenarios. Characterize and document defects including identifying steps to reproduce, linking failures to requirements, and collecting all associated test logs. Develop and update test cases as required. Interact with multiple engineering fields including Systems Engineering, Software Development, Validation, and Suppliers to support defect resolution. Plan and manage execution of weekly verification testing. Manage weekly build promotions including sanity test planning, critical issue escalation and develop response to additional test requests. Coordinate test assignments for a large multi-functional team to ensure that all test requirements are met. Lead, collaborate, and improve testing on Infotainment ECU. Verify operation of Infotainment features that function on CAN, Ethernet and LIN communication protocols. Provide regular status updates and complete documentation and test results. Perform diagnostics, partial network, and DPS calibration testing. 100% telecommuting available.

REQUIREMENTS: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field of study. Five (5) years of experience as a Software Test Engineer – Vehicle Software Management, System Test Lead, Senior Staff Systems Engineer, Software Systems Engineer II, Senior Test Engineer, Test Engineer or related occupation. Five (5) years of experience in the following: Automotive SW Testing or Development, including experience with test automation and test or software architecture; LAN/CAN vehicle communication system and CAN based monitoring tools; Vehicle Electrical Architecture and Subsystem Features in the Infotainment domain; and CAPL Programming and Python Programming. Three (3) years of experience in the following: Operating Systems including Android, Linux and QNX; Project and Test Management; and Requirement Analysis and Systems Engineering. Two (2) years of experience in the following: In-Vehicle Network and Diagnostics, Diagnostic Testing.

The Head of AI Automation will drive the end-to-end strategy, development, and execution of AI-driven automation and intelligent systems within a leading fiber broadband and telecommunications company. This role is responsible for modernizing business and network operations through Machine Learning (ML), Generative AI / LLMs, and Robotic Process Automation (RPA) to maximize operational efficiency, elevate customer experience, and reduce cost-to-serve.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic AI & Automation Leadership: Define and execute the enterprise AI and automation roadmap across customer service, billing, sales, technical support, and network operations.
  • Core Process Automation: Identify operational bottlenecks and deploy targeted AI/ML, GenAI, and RPA solutions across front-office and back-office functions.
  • Network & Operational Optimization: Oversee AI-driven initiatives for real-time network monitoring, predictive maintenance, automated fault detection, customer analytics, and intelligent workflow routing.
  • System & Infrastructure Integration: Lead the seamless integration of automation platforms, LLM frameworks, and custom AI models into existing telecommunications platforms (CRM, ERP, Billing/BSS, OSS, and core network architecture).
  • Team & Vendor Management: Direct cross-functional teams of AI/ML engineers, developers, and data scientists while managing technology vendor relationships, solution delivery, and SLAs.
  • Governance & Performance Tracking: Establish responsible AI governance, data privacy protocols, security frameworks, and ROI/KPI tracking mechanisms to demonstrate clear business impact.

Candidate Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field. Master’s degree or relevant certifications preferred.
  • Experience: Minimum 8+ years of technical experience in AI, software engineering, digital transformation, or process automation, including 3–5 years in a managerial or leadership role.
  • Domain Background: Prior leadership experience within an Internet Service Provider (ISP), Telecommunications enterprise, or major Tech infrastructure firm is strongly preferred.

Technical & Strategic Competencies

  • AI & Automation Stack: Expert knowledge of AI/ML algorithms, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), APIs, microservices, and RPA platforms (e.g., UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Microsoft Power Automate).
  • Telecom Domain Knowledge: Direct experience automating enterprise telecom processes—specifically customer operations, dispatch systems, billing engines, and network management platforms (OSS/BSS).
  • Leadership & Execution: Strong track record in vendor negotiation, agile project delivery, cross-departmental stakeholder management, and scalable system deployment.

As the Account Partner for Veeva Development Cloud, you will be part of the foundational team representing the Veeva Development Cloud for European Contract Research Organisations (CROs).

The Account Partner will be responsible for generating opportunities, winning business, and managing strategic relationships with our CRO customers and prospects.

A strong understanding of the life sciences industry and the role of CROs within it, enterprise software sales cycle, and a passion for making market changes with innovative technology are ideal for this role.

Requirements

    • 5+ years of combined experience across sales, account management, and consulting services
    • 2+ years of account management servicing CROs or working in CROs

    • Strategic account planning and execution skills

    • Must be highly self-motivated and able to work with little direct supervision

Nice to Have

    • Experience selling eClinical solutions (EDC, RTSM, eCOA) to CROs and/or Sponsors on a study-by-study basis

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.

Als Key Account Manager (m/w/d) für den Geschäftsbereich des BMF und das ITZBund übernimmst du Verantwortung für einen Top-Kunden der Materna im Public Sector. Du entwickelst bestehende Geschäftsbeziehungen gezielt weiter, erschließt neue Themen und steuerst komplexe Vertriebsprozesse bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren Delivery-Teams zusammen und verbindest Kundenanforderungen mit passenden IT-Lösungen sowie Beratungsleistungen.

Gestalte die Digitalisierung der öffentlichen Verwaltung aktiv mit und komm als Key Account Manager Public Sector (m/w/d)ins Team Materna.

Als Key Account Manager

  • verantwortest du als erfahrene Vertriebs- und Beratungspersönlichkeit eingeständig ein anspruchsvolles Key-Account-Portfolio und entwickelst maßgeschneiderte IT-Lösungen sowie Beratungsleistungen für den Geschäftsbereich des BMF (v. a. FTB, Zoll, BZSt) und das ITZBund.
  • akquirierst du gezielt neue Themenbereiche und entwickelst bestehende Geschäftsbeziehungen kontinuierlich weiter.
  • steuerst du den gesamten Sales‑Cycle – von der ersten Kundenansprache über Account‑Pläne und Wachstumsstrategien bis hin zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss und der Kontrolle definierter Account‑Ziele.
  • führst du Kundenverhandlungen und präsentierst unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit einem starken Delivery-Team überzeugend sowie zielgerichtet bei Kunden und Entscheidern.
  • baust du eigenverantwortlich ein belastbares Kunden‑ und Partnernetzwerk auf und entwickelst dieses strategisch weiter.
  • verbindest du fachliche und technische Kundenanforderungen mit den passenden Kompetenzen und Leistungen innerhalb der Materna-Gruppe.

Dein Profil

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Vertriebserfahrung im komplexen IT- und Projektgeschäft, insbesondere in Softwareentwicklung, IT-Beratung oder vergleichbaren IT-Dienstleistungen
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Vertrieb an große, komplexe Public-Sector-Kunden, insbesondere auf Bundesebene
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Entwicklung strategischer Accounts und im Abschluss komplexer Vertriebsprojekte mit langen Sales Cycles
  • Idealerweise Erfahrung im Geschäftsbereich des BMF, insbesondere mit ITZBund, Zoll oder BZSt, sowie ein bestehendes Netzwerk beim Kunden
  • Gutes IT-Grundverständnis sowie sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1), gute Englischkenntnisse (B2) und bundesweite Reisebereitschaft

Das zeichnet dich persönlich aus

  • Die aktive Kundenansprache gehört zu deinen Stärken. Du entwickelst Geschäftschancen konsequent weiter und richtest dein Handeln auf nachhaltigen Vertriebs- und Account-Erfolg aus.
  • Du analysierst komplexe Sachverhalte strukturiert, arbeitest sorgfältig in Ausschreibungen und Verträgen und behältst auch bei hoher Komplexität den Überblick.
  • Sichere Kommunikation auf unterschiedlichen Ebenen, ein flexibles Eingehen auf Gesprächspartner:innen sowie eine verbindliche und lösungsorientierte Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und internen Schnittstellen zeichnen dich aus.
  • Deinen Standpunkt kannst du klar vertreten und verhandlungsstark und bleibst auch unter hoher Belastung sowie langen Vertriebszyklen fokussiert, selbstsicher und handlungsfähig.

Benefits

  • Flache Hierarchien: Deine Ideen brauchen keine langen Entscheidungswege. Bei uns kannst du anpacken und mitgestalten, wir gewähren den nötigen Freiraum zur Entwicklung von Kundenbeziehungen und Projekten.
  • Vergütung: Der Aufgabe und Erfahrung angemessen, attraktiv und leistungsorientiert.
  • Firmenwagen: Ob auf privaten oder geschäftlichen Wegen – du erhältst deinen Firmenwagen mit europaweit gültiger Lade- oder Tankkarte (alternativ Bahncard 100).
  • Onboarding: Dein Start bei Materna beginnt mit unseren Welcome Days, gefolgt von einer umfassenden Einarbeitung und Unterstützung durch ein starkes Team.
  • Repräsentative Standorte: Wenn du nicht remote arbeitest, bieten wir dir spannende Offices. Unser neues Dortmunder Headquarter mit Restaurant und Gym, in Berlin an der Friedrichstrasse, am Frankfurter Osthafen oder in Hamburg mit Blick auf die Elbphilharmonie.
  • Learning@Materna: Mit über 100 Schulungs- und Weiterbildungsangeboten unterstützen wir dich bei deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung.
    Betriebliche Altersvorsorge: Wir unterstützen dich dabei, dich individuell und langfristig für deine Zukunft abzusichern.

Interessiert? Werde Teil der Materna-Story!

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Unser Auswahlprozess besteht aus zwei Gesprächsrunden. Bei erfolgreicher Bewerbung wirst du zunächst zu einem virtuellen Interview eingeladen.

Wende dich bei Fragen gerne an mich.

Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

Transformar datos complejos en insights accionables de negocio, ayudando a marcas y equipos internos a tomar mejores decisiones a través de análisis, estudios y consultoría estratégica basada en data real de consumo (FMCG).

Advertisement

Are you looking for an awesome new online teaching gig? JadeClass Education Singapore is hiring energetic, confident, and adaptable teachers for our on-line math program. In turn, we will provide you with the students, online-teaching tools, structure, and resources that you will need to teach with confidence.

We are looking for top quality teachers who can commit to a fixed schedule of at least two classes a week, starting in July. We pay $75 for each 90-minute lesson (covering preparation and teaching time). The first time you teach each lesson, we might ask you to record a preview video (without students), for which we'll pay an extra $25.

If you are as excited about online education as we are, then we would love to hear from you!

School Description

JadeClass Education Singapore provides enrichment education to bright students who already have a good command of the English language and plan on continuing their education abroad. We are a group of talented teachers who develop and deliver in-person and online classes in English and STEM. Our students range from 6–16 years old and are carefully screened for English level, behavior, and motivation. We focus on teaching concrete skills that help our students succeed in their learning endeavors.

Job Responsibilities

· Deliver engaging, high-energy online math classes for up to eight students

· Review materials and record lesson-prep as required to ensure quality

· Complete a series of classes without absences or rescheduling

Schedule

Our lessons are typically scheduled during the following times, based on student and teacher availability:

· Fall/Spring term Fri 18:00-21:00 (UTC +8)

Sat 08:30–20:30 (UTC+8)

Sun 08:30–20:30 (UTC+8)

· Summer term: Mon/Thurs 08:30–20:30 (UTC+8)

Wed/Sat 08:30–20:30 (UTC+8)

Course Description

Our small-group, online math courses place a single teacher with 6-8 students. Classes meet online each week, on the ClassIn platform (classin.com) for 90-minutes. Lessons are based around coursework/PPTs developed by our in-house development team. Training and support will be provided.

Technology Requirements

  • Fast and stable internet connection (~20mbps up and down)
  • Modern, reliable computer (~10,000+ on www.cpubenchmark.net/cpu_list.php)

Application Process

If you are interested in applying, please send the following to us at :

· Your resume

· A YouTube/Vimeo link to your introduction video telling us about your teaching background (we will not consider your application without this)

· A link to your speedtest.net results

· Where you found this position

· The name of the position for which you wish to apply

Applicant Requirements

· Experience teaching elementary, middle-school, or high-school math, either online or in person

· Can explain concepts in a clear, simple, and logical fashion

· Can integrate your own personal teaching style with our established standards

· Reliable, organized, and able to prepare for and attend each scheduled lesson

· Positive attitude, engaging personality, talkative

· Neat and professional appearance

· Fluent in English with clear pronunciation

Benefits

Compensation

· 66 USD per hour for each new lesson: $100 per 90-minute lesson.

o Payment is based on the actual teaching of a lesson. This does not include time spent reviewing materials and/or recording a lesson previews (without students) to show that you are fully prepared to teach each class.

· 50 USD per hour for each repeated lesson (i.e. lessons you have previously taught): 75 USD per 90-minute lesson

Remuneration is through Wise (wise.com), monthly, between the 10th and the 12th of the month.

Director, Product Management - Data Platform

Location: San Mateo, CA, Nashville, TN or Remote

The Role

Asurion — the world’s leading connected device protection company, serving 300M+ customers — is looking for a hands-on Director of PM to own the strategy and roadmap for our Data Platform. You understand both sides: how data is produced and how it’s consumed. You know how to build the foundational infrastructure — data catalog, lineage, ingestion pipelines, access governance, and a self-service analytics layer — that turns raw data into a trusted, scalable asset. This is a high-visibility role with broad scope and the mandate to shape how the entire organization works with data.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the Data Platform roadmap: from ingestion and pipeline orchestration to data catalog, lineage tracking, access governance, and the self-service analytics layer.
  • Define how teams onboard data to the platform — establishing contracts, SLAs, quality checks, and documentation standards that make data trustworthy at the source.
  • Drive the self-service experience — so analysts and data scientists can discover, access, and use data in tools like Databricks notebooks or Snowflake without filing tickets.
  • Partner with engineering on architecture decisions: when to use streaming vs. batch, how to structure the lakehouse, what belongs in the warehouse vs. the lake.
  • Align data engineering, analytics, data science, security, and business stakeholders around a shared platform vision.
  • Hire, develop, and lead a high-performing team of data-fluent PMs.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years in product management, with a significant focus on data platform, infrastructure, or analytics products.
  • Fluency with the modern data stack: Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow), Snowflake, Amazon EMR/Spark, and cloud-native data services on AWS or GCP.
  • Experience building or evolving core platform capabilities: data catalog, metadata management, column-level lineage, pipeline orchestration (Airflow, dbt, or similar), RBAC, and data quality frameworks.
  • Understands the producer/consumer dynamic — knows that a great platform is as much about how data gets in as how it gets used.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership; strong communicator from the board room to the engineering standup.
  • Customer-obsessed with a strong bias for outcomes over output.

Nice to Have

  • Experience standing up a data mesh or domain-oriented data ownership model.
  • Familiarity with ML/AI workflows and feature stores that consume platform data.
  • Background partnering with security and privacy teams on governance at scale.

Why Asurion

  • Build at scale — petabytes of data, real-time decisions, 300M+ customers.
  • Greenfield platform scope inside a well-resourced, high-growth organization.
  • Direct influence on how every team across the company discovers and uses data.
  • Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a flexible hybrid work model.
  • Asurion is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive environment for all employees.

raw.description:
Junior to Mid-Level Full-Stack Developer

Remote, Philippines · Full-time independent contractor · 7:00 PM – 4:00 AM PHT, Monday to Friday · USD 1,000 – 1,300 per month

BloomGuarden is a U.S.-based HR company. Alongside our recruiting and HR services, we build our own software, in two product lines:

  • GuardenLabs: a suite of web-based HR tools that help HR and finance teams plan their workforce and make better people decisions.
  • Audelle: a mobile app and API that helps families run their household and manage the staff who work in it.

We are a small team. You join as our second developer and work directly with our senior developer, who reviews your work and helps you grow. From day one you pick up real tasks across both product lines: screens, API endpoints and bug fixes.

You do not need to know everything listed below. You need solid basics, care for detail, and the drive to learn fast.

What You'll Do

Build and ship

  • Build screens in the Audelle mobile app (React Native with Expo) and the API endpoints behind them (Node.js with Express).
  • Fix bugs and add features in the GuardenLabs HR tools (React, Next.js, Vite).
  • Build reusable, responsive React components from a design, and connect them to APIs.
  • Deploy and monitor apps on Vercel, and investigate production errors reported through Sentry.

Work to a quality standard

  • For any business rule (a calculation, a permission, a limit), write the test first, then the code that makes it pass.
  • Check your work the way a user sees it: phone-sized screen first, then desktop, and on the Android emulator for the mobile app.
  • Open a pull request on GitHub for every change, and work through review comments with the senior developer.

Communicate and own your work

  • Keep your tasks current on our Monday.com board with short, plain-English updates, the same day.
  • Ask clear questions early, flag blockers, and write pull request notes another developer can follow.

What You Bring

Non-negotiable tools

  • React.js: you can build a screen from a design and connect it to an API.
  • GitHub: branches, pull requests, code review and merge conflicts.
  • Vercel: you have deployed and managed at least one app on Vercel.

Must-haves

  • About 1 to 3 years of professional experience building web or mobile apps, or equivalent shipped projects (freelance, open source or production side projects you can show us).
  • Good JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript, and good React.
  • Some backend experience: you have written REST endpoints and SQL queries against a real database (PostgreSQL preferred).
  • Experience writing automated tests (Jest, Vitest or similar).
  • Responsive, mobile-first web development, and solid debugging skills.
  • Clear written English. We work remotely and mostly in writing, so your updates and questions must be easy to follow.

Big bonus

  • You use AI coding assistants (such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot) with judgment: you read and test what they produce before you ship it, and you can explain every line you submit.

Nice-to-haves

  • React Native with Expo, or Next.js.
  • Supabase, including row-level security (database rules that decide who can see which rows).
  • Express and Zod; Tailwind CSS or NativeWind; TanStack Query.
  • Stripe payments; Sentry; CI/CD pipelines.
  • Authentication (OAuth, JWT, Supabase Auth, Clerk or similar).
  • Comfort with numbers and spreadsheets. Some of our HR tools are calculation-heavy.
  • Startup or SaaS product experience.

Our Stack

TypeScript · React · Next.js · Vite · React Native / Expo · Node.js / Express · PostgreSQL / Supabase · Tailwind CSS / NativeWind · Vitest / Jest · Stripe · Sentry · Vercel · GitHub · Monday.com

How We Work

  • Code is split into clear layers: routes, controllers and services on the backend; pages, hooks and components on the frontend.
  • Small files, small functions, clear names.
  • Mobile first: every screen works at phone width before desktop.
  • A change is done only when its tests pass and it has been checked by hand in the browser or emulator.
  • Every caught error is reported, never silently ignored.

Our Culture

We hire for the three virtues of the Ideal Team Player (Patrick Lencioni), plus the way BloomGuarden works:

  • Humble: you welcome code review, admit mistakes quickly, and give credit to others.
  • Hungry: you own your tasks end to end, learn fast, and follow through without reminders.
  • People smart: you read the room in writing: you know when to ask, when to update and how to give feedback kindly.
  • BloomGuarden values: integrity (honest status, even when it is bad news), quality over speed, care for the people who use our products, and protecting the data entrusted to us.

Your First Three Months

  • Month 1: set up every project locally, learn the codebase, ship your first small fixes.
  • Month 2: own small features end to end, from board task to merged pull request.
  • Month 3: own a full screen or feature, including its tests, with light review.

Work Setup and Pay

  • Fully remote. You must be based in the Philippines.
  • Working hours: 7:00 PM to 4:00 AM Philippine time, Monday to Friday, the same hours as our senior developer.
  • Full-time engagement as an independent contractor, with no other job or clients during these hours.
  • Pay: USD 1,000 to 1,300 per month. Where you land in the range is set by our structured evaluation: the interview rubric and a short technical exercise.
  • Equipment: a computer that can run the Android emulator, a stable internet connection, a backup power source and a quiet place to work.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Written application: resume, a GitHub or portfolio link, and answers to the three questions below.
  2. Screening call (20–30 min): availability, setup and basics.
  3. Technical exercise: a short take-home task (capped at about 2–3 hours) or a live pairing session, scored on the same criteria for everyone.
  4. Structured interview: same questions for every candidate, scored on a written rubric. Includes a walkthrough of your exercise.
  5. Decision and offer: we aim to decide within 3 business days of your final interview.

To Apply

Answer these three questions in writing (3–5 sentences each):

  1. Describe a feature you built end to end. What was your part, what stack did you use, and how did you test it?
  2. Tell us about a bug that was hard to find. How did you track it down?
  3. How do you use AI coding tools today, and how do you check what they produce?

Equal Opportunity

BloomGuarden is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based only on job-related skills, experience and the needs of the work. We do not discriminate on the basis of age, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital or family status, pregnancy, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, religion, disability, health condition, political belief, or any other status protected by law. Every candidate is assessed with the same structured process and rubric.

If you need an accommodation at any stage of the process, tell us and we will work with you. Please do not include a photo, your age, date of birth, marital status or religion on your resume; we do not use them.

raw.title: Engineering Manager
raw.excerpt: For decades, DTN has been the silent force behind some of the world’s most critical industries—helping businesses navigate complexity, uncertainty, and risk with smarter, faster decisions.
raw.description:
For decades, DTN has been the silent force behind some of the world’s most critical industries—helping businesses navigate complexity, uncertainty, and risk with smarter, faster decisions. From agriculture to energy to weather intelligence, our proprietary Operational Decisioning Platform transforms raw data into decision-grade insights—enabling companies to optimize supply chains, ensure market stability, and safeguard infrastructure against disruption. We don’t follow trends—we set the standard for precision, trust, and operational impact.

DTN is at an exciting inflection point. Building off a foundation of financial strength, profitability, and industry trust, we’re accelerating growth and expanding our global footprint. Our purpose-built solutions—powered by AI and honed by decades of vertical expertise—are helping some of the world’s most significant enterprises thrive amid operational constraints and uncover new opportunities in a fast-changing world.

Job Description:


Position Summary:


DTN is seeking an experienced, hands-on Engineering Manager to lead the engineering team responsible for building the foundational capabilities of our Operational Decisioning Platform (ODP).


The DTN Operational Decisioning Platform is an internal platform that packages cloud infrastructure into purpose-built, higher-level capabilities so that our engineers, solutions teams, and customers can build data products, applications, and AI-powered tools without managing the underlying cloud infrastructure themselves.


The ODP Platform team builds the foundational layer that other teams rely on, including APIs, software development kits (SDKs), command-line interfaces (CLIs), developer tooling, and managed services. Much of this work is greenfield, providing an opportunity to shape the architecture, engineering practices, and long-term evolution of a critical enterprise platform.


This is a hands-on engineering leadership role combining people management, technical direction, platform delivery, and operational ownership. As a player/coach, you will guide the engineers building complex distributed systems, partner closely with Architecture, Product, and platform consumers, and establish the engineering quality and operational rigor required to deliver secure, reliable, and reusable capabilities at scale.


What You Will Be Responsible For:


Engineering Leadership and Team Development

  • Lead and manage a team of platform engineers across multiple experience levels, with responsibility for hiring, onboarding, performance management, professional development, and day-to-day delivery.
  • Coach, mentor, and grow engineers while establishing a healthy, collaborative, high-accountability engineering culture.
  • Set and maintain high standards for engineering quality, technical execution, operational discipline, and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as a hands-on technical leader who can engage deeply in architectural discussions, critically evaluate designs, and help engineers navigate complex technical tradeoffs.

Platform Architecture and Technical Direction

  • Own the platform's technical direction in partnership with senior engineers and architecture stakeholders.
  • Guide the design and implementation of foundational, distributed, multi-account cloud systems built on AWS.
  • Oversee the development of developer-facing APIs, SDKs, CLIs, tooling, and managed services that enable other engineering teams to build on the platform.
  • Lead foundational distributed-systems engineering efforts involving secure cross-account communication, multi-tenant isolation, provisioning, and lifecycle automation.
  • Develop platform abstractions that allow engineers and solutions teams to work with purpose-built operational capabilities rather than raw cloud infrastructure.
  • Guide architectural decisions for new and evolving platform capabilities, including substantial greenfield development.
  • Ensure platform architecture supports scalability, security, maintainability, and long-term reuse across multiple products and teams.

Platform Adoption and Developer Experience

  • Build a shared platform that internal engineering and solutions teams actively want to use and contribute to.
  • Drive an approach in which reusable platform capabilities emerge from real engineering and customer requirements.
  • Establish practices and incentives that encourage teams to consume, improve, and contribute to shared platform components.
  • Make reuse the default by developing capabilities that improve developer productivity and reduce duplicated engineering effort.
  • Partner with Product to deliver visible, usable milestones, including a developer portal, technical documentation, and initial productized platform capabilities.
  • Incorporate feedback from internal and external platform stakeholders into technical priorities and the product roadmap.

Security, Reliability, and Operational Excellence

  • Own the platform's operational contract, ensuring that security, isolation, reliability, and observability guarantees are consistently maintained.
  • Establish and maintain strong cloud identity and access management, isolation boundaries, and appropriate security controls.
  • Guide the implementation of signed and authenticated service-to-service communication, least-privilege access, and secure multi-account architectures.
  • Ensure end-to-end observability, monitoring, and operational visibility are foundational platform capabilities.
  • Own the health of on-call operations, incident response processes, and service-level objectives.
  • Promote reliable engineering practices, including automated testing, infrastructure as code, trunk-based development, and incremental, reversible delivery.
  • Balance platform availability, security, and operational requirements with the need to deliver new capabilities efficiently.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Delivery

  • Partner closely with Architecture, Identity, Product, and Solutions/Field Engineering to ensure platform capabilities meet the needs of teams building on the platform.
  • Translate strategic objectives into actionable engineering roadmaps and measurable delivery milestones.
  • Communicate technical direction, delivery progress, dependencies, and risks to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Balance speed-to-value with the development of durable, scalable, and reusable platform foundations.
  • Coordinate across engineering teams to resolve dependencies, align architectural decisions, and ensure effective delivery.
  • Partner with Product and other stakeholders to ensure that platform investments deliver meaningful business and developer value.

AI-Enabled Engineering and Platform Capabilities

  • Champion modern AI-assisted software development practices, including coding assistants and agentic development tools, to improve engineering productivity and team velocity.
  • Guide the design and integration of AI-augmented capabilities into the platform's modular architecture.
  • Support platform capabilities that incorporate large language models (LLMs), AI agents, and related services.
  • Evaluate how emerging AI development technologies can improve engineering workflows and expand the capabilities available to platform consumers.

What You Will Bring to the Position:


Engineering Experience and Leadership

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years operating at a T3 (Staff) through T5 (Principal) engineering level and at least 2 years in a technical lead or engineering management capacity.
  • Demonstrated experience shipping, operating, and supporting production software systems.
  • Proven ability to hire, coach, mentor, and develop engineers across multiple experience levels.
  • Experience establishing a healthy engineering culture built on accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to provide credible technical leadership while managing engineering delivery, people development, and operational responsibilities.

Cloud-Native Architecture and Distributed Systems

  • Strong technical foundation in AWS cloud-native architecture and distributed systems.
  • Ability to engage deeply with engineers on system architecture, critically review technical designs, and make informed architectural tradeoffs.
  • Experience working with platform engineering, developer tooling, SDKs, infrastructure, or similar teams that build foundational capabilities for other engineers rather than exclusively developing end-user features.
  • Strong understanding of secure multi-account and multi-tenant cloud architectures.
  • Fluency in cloud identity and access management, tenant isolation boundaries, and the security requirements associated with distributed cloud systems.
  • Understanding of the architecture and operational considerations involved in building scalable, secure, and reliable shared platform capabilities.

AI and Modern Engineering Practices

  • Familiarity with modern AI development toolkits and AI-assisted engineering workflows, including coding assistants and agentic development tools.
  • Understanding of how AI-augmented capabilities, including LLMs, agents, and related services, can be incorporated into modular platform components.
  • Ability to guide engineers in adopting AI-assisted development practices that improve productivity without compromising engineering quality.

Communication and Cross-Functional Influence

  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills across Engineering, Product, Architecture, and Go-to-Market organizations.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical decisions, architectural tradeoffs, delivery progress, and risks to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction and coordinate delivery across teams with competing priorities.

What Will Make You Stand Out:


  • Experience building or operating a multi-tenant SaaS platform, cross-account control plane, or internal developer platform at scale.
  • Familiarity with a modern cloud platform technology stack, including TypeScript, Node.js, Terraform, serverless technologies, container services, managed data stores, and cloud security primitives.
  • Experience developing and operating reusable APIs, SDKs, CLIs, developer portals, and shared platform services.
  • Experience driving adoption of internal developer platforms and increasing reuse of shared components across engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated success establishing platform capabilities that improve developer productivity and reduce duplicated engineering effort.
  • Experience working within a forward-deployed or solutions-engineering model in which engineers embedded with customers consume shared platform capabilities.
  • Experience with complex provisioning and lifecycle automation, secure cross-account communication, and multi-tenant infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with modern engineering delivery practices, including trunk-based development, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and incremental, reversible releases.
  • Experience working in operationally complex or data-intensive industries such as energy, logistics, weather, or agriculture.

What You Can Expect from DTN:


  • Competitive Salary
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Flexible working hours
  • Remote work model (position dependent)
  • Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance Plans
  • 6% 401K matching
  • Unlimited access to 13k+ courses via learning platform to support employee career advancement
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Compensation:

The targeted hiring base pay range for this position is between $110,000 and $145,000. DTN is a pay for performance organization, which means there is the opportunity to advance your compensation with performance over time. The actual base pay offered for this position will be dependent upon many factors, including but not limited to: prior work experience, training/education, transferable skills, business needs, internal equity and applicable laws. The targeted hiring base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for market competitive variable pay and benefits.


About DTN:

DTN is a global data and technology company helping operational leaders in energy, agriculture, and weather-driven industries make faster, smarter decisions. Our Operational Decisioning Platform turns complex data into decision-grade insights—empowering customers to expand their margins, accelerate growth, and outpace risk. With more than 1,200 employees globally, DTN serves the companies that feed, fuel, and protect the world.

At DTN, we value clarity,trust, and action. We’re a team of problem-solvers, outcome-drivers, and industry nerds who believe that precision matters – and that mission is at the core of what we do.

  • Trust Built: We earn it. We keep it. We protect it. Our neutrality, precision, and integrity are non-negotiable.

  • Confidence-Driven: We help customers move with clarity and conviction. We bring the data and operational knowledge leaders need to act.

  • Built for Industry: We speak operations because we come from operations. Our expertise is forged in fuel terminals, fields, flight paths, and forecasts.

  • Future-Forward: We see what’s coming- and we’re ready. We help customers lead through change with smarter decisioning.

Recruitment Fraud Notice:

DTN is aware of incidents where external parties have impersonated our organization, issuing fraudulent communications and/or job offers. Please be advised that all legitimate communication from DTN will come from an official @dtn.com email address. Any offers are extended directly by our Talent Acquisition team following a formal interview process.


If you receive a suspicious message or offer claiming to be from DTN, please do not engage. Contact our Talent Acquisition team at to verify the legitimacy of any communication. Report any fraudulent messaging as phishing or spam.

DTN is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage applicants of all backgrounds, including minorities, women, veterans, and individuals with disabilities.

raw.excerpt: About BJAKBJAK is Southeast Asia’s largest digital insurance platform, expanding financial access through automation, data, and digital scale.
raw.description:
About BJAK

BJAK is Southeast Asia’s largest digital insurance platform, expanding financial access through automation, data, and digital scale. As we grow across markets, we are committed to building a platform that is safe, compliant, and trusted.

We are hiring a Head of Compliance (UK) to lead regulatory strategy, risk governance, and compliance operations for our UK market entry and expansion alongside the CEO. This role is expected to hold the SMF16 (Compliance Oversight) Senior Management Function once approved, and will act as our primary point of contact with the FCA.

This is a build role: you'll be creating frameworks, policies, and controls from scratch rather than inheriting an existing function.

Why This Role Matters

The Head of Compliance (UK) will:

  • Design and enforce compliance frameworks that enable safe scaling of digital financial services.

  • Ensure BJAK operates in accordance with UK regulatory standards, especially FCA requirements.

  • Protect consumers through transparent, fair, and ethical practices.

  • Establish BJAK as a trusted partner with regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders.

  • Build compliance capability and culture across the company.

What You Will Do

Regulatory Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain compliance frameworks aligned with UK regulatory requirements.

  • Lead regulatory readiness for market entry, licensing, and ongoing supervision.

  • Serve as the primary contact with the FCA and relevant UK bodies.

  • Interpret regulatory changes and guide business strategy accordingly.

Risk Governance & Compliance Operations

  • Build policies and controls covering AML, KYC, data privacy, consumer duty, distribution, and claims-related compliance.

  • Conduct risk assessments and implement remediation plans for identified gaps.

  • Establish monitoring, testing, and reporting processes for ongoing compliance.

  • Ensure internal audits, compliance reviews, and control testing are operationalised.

Consumer Protection & Business Integrity

  • Embed fairness, transparency, and responsible selling throughout the organisation.

  • Oversee product compliance, marketing reviews, pricing governance, and distribution oversight.

  • Implement complaint handling frameworks aligned with regulatory standards.

Cross-Functional Support & Training

  • Partner with product, operations, legal, marketing, and commercial teams to ensure compliant execution.

  • Provide guidance on regulatory implications of new products, partnerships, or distribution models.

  • Deliver training to ensure teams understand and execute compliance responsibilities.

You Will Thrive in This Role If You

  • See compliance as a strategic enabler, not a blocker.

  • Operate with high integrity, sound judgment, and strong attention to detail.

  • Communicate clearly and influence leaders using data and logic.

  • Enjoy building frameworks and scaling systems from early-stage to mature environments.

  • Thrive in fast-paced, evolving settings where regulation meets innovation.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of compliance, risk, or regulatory experience within financial services, insurance, insurtech, or fintech.

  • Deep understanding of UK regulatory frameworks, including FCA rules and consumer duty requirements.

  • Experience in compliance for digital platforms, distribution, or insurance products (preferred).

  • Proven ability to design policies, conduct risk assessments, and manage complex compliance programs.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including dealing with regulators.

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in start-up or high-growth environments.

  • Previous SMF experience.

  • Background in insurtech, digital distribution, or online marketplaces.

  • Knowledge of GDPR, AML, sanctions, or cross-border compliance.

Location Requirement

  • This role is based in the UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our London office at least 3 days per week.

Why Join Us

  • Shape compliance for a fast-growing international fintech-insurtech platform.

  • Build frameworks that enable safe, inclusive financial access at scale.

  • Work closely with leadership and regulators to drive responsible innovation.

  • Competitive compensation with long-term growth and international career opportunities.

Compensations Range

  • We offer a highly competitive package, ranging from £100,000 to £150,000, reflecting both experience and suitability for this pivotal role.

We’re Civica and we make software that helps deliver critical services for citizens all around the world. From local to state government, to education, to health and care, over 5,000 public bodies across the globe use our software to help provide critical services to over 100 million citizens.

Our aspiration is to be a GovTech champion everywhere we work around the globe, supporting the needs of citizens and those that serve them every day. Building on 21 years of continuous growth and success, we're at a pivotal point on our journey to realise that aspiration.

As a company, we’re passionate about what we do and the citizens we help to serve. If you too would like to help champion the use of technology in public services, to improve outcomes for citizens and public sector organisations, then Civica is the right place for you. We will help you unlock the best version of yourself, achieve growth in your career whilst making a real difference to people and communities.

Why you will love this opportunity as Senior PMO analyst at Civica

We are seeking an experienced Senior PMO Analyst to support the successful delivery of complex Healthcare programmes. Working across a fast-paced portfolio, you will coordinate PMO activities, strengthen governance, provide accurate reporting, and support project and stakeholder management.

You will play a key role in driving PMO best practices, continuous improvement, and effective programme delivery, helping teams achieve successful outcomes across critical IT projects.

This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive, delivery-focused professional who enjoys bringing structure, clarity, and control to complex programmes while contributing to the growth and maturity of PMO capabilities.

Requirements

What you will bring:

  • 3 to 5 years of experience as a PMO Analyst, with a solid and demonstrable understanding of PMO and its related functions.
  • Experience in executing PMO assurance activities, with the capability to conduct and facilitate stage-gate reviews, coordinate project health checks and audits as necessary, while offering recommendations and spearheading continuous improvement initiatives
  • Experience in managing information collection to produce accurate, informative reports, and presentations suitable for executive-level audience (Status Reporting, Board meeting reporting, SLT, Monthly Governance reporting, etc.)
  • Possess a deep knowledge of project management frameworks, including Waterfall and Agile methodologies, as well as a solid grasp of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and project governance specifically tailored for the information technology sector.
  • Proficiency with PMO tools such as MS Project, SharePoint, JIRA, and reporting tools
  • Formal PM certification (PRINCE2, PMP, PMO/PMBoK, or equivalent)
  • Advanced Excel skills, including data analysis and reconciliation
  • Relevant experience in project management offices (PMOs) within a government environment.
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps

If you’re looking for a role where your PMO expertise will be valued, your ideas welcomed, and your impact clearly seen—Civica is the place for you.

Benefits

Why you'll love working with us

We know that when our people are happy, they will work better and have greater work satisfaction. Here's what you can expect:

We're all different - and we love this about us.

We provide an inclusive, safe, and welcoming environment to all Civicans, new and old Focus on learning- there are heaps of opportunities to enable you to grow and be your best.

Giving culture - we encourage you to "give back" with benefits such as our Days of Difference leave where you can volunteer for a charity of your choice.

Flexible Work - we have the technology and tools to support you to work from home and come into our offices now and then to catch up and socialise with colleagues.

Apply for this job - Become part of something special Do you see yourself in this role? If so, then we would love to hear from you.

Job Description

Here at Kraft Heinz, our US Sales team aspires to be an Indispensable Partner that Plays to Win and is acutely focused on Superior Execution every day. This is our guiding compass to grow something great and make life delicious!
﻿ The Customer Sales Analyst (CSA) is an internal sales role that delivers business insights and recommendations to drive top-line growth for the Ahold Delhaize USA Customer Business Teams. Through category research and analysis, the CSA transforms customer, consumer, and internal data into actionable insights that improve business performance. In partnership with the customer business team and sales execution organization, the CSA identifies and addresses new and existing growth opportunities across all Kraft Heinz categories and business teams supporting Ahold Delhaize USA. This position applies category management principles to identify business opportunities and evaluate key sales levers, including promotion, pricing, distribution, and assortment. The CSA also leads information and training activities, manages data to support sales planning, and continuously improves the process of delivering sales intelligence to the team. The ideal candidate can translate data from multiple sources into actionable insights and is proficient in Microsoft Power BI. If you’re looking for an opportunity to make an impact at scale, come grow with us!

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

  • Subject-matter expert in analyzing syndicated, internal shipment, supply chain, and other data to generate actionable insights and recommendations across key sales levers, including distribution and assortment, pricing, and promotion.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends and actionable insights from large datasets.
  • Ensures that the customer, consumer, and category insights are delivered effectively.
  • Conducts quarterly and annual category reviews and periodic assessments.
  • Pulls relevant data and information to build effective selling stories.
  • Develops impactful customer specific selling stories that reflect key category business building initiatives.

Expected Experience & Required Skills

  • Advanced MS Excel expertise for sales analysis, leveraging a capabilities that includes Power Query for multi-source data consolidation, complex arrays (XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH) for dynamic relational mapping, advanced Pivot Tables for dimensional aggregation, and Slicers to build interactive executive dashboards among other advanced functions.
  • Ability to interpret data from various data sources and derive actionable insights to help guide the customer business team
  • Strong sales background with knowledge of business processes and category management
  • Ability to work within a Customer Business Team framework and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to plan, organize and set/achieve priorities when performing work
  • Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, presentation)

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency building reporting and visuals in Microsoft Power BI
  • Knowledge of Python or R for data manipulation and predictive analysis
  • Knowledge of SQL for querying databases, joining tables and optimizing database performance
  • Proficient in DAX calculations, data cleaning and modeling

Work Environment & Schedule

This position is considered a Remote based role that can be performed from a home office Additionally, this role requires the ability to work a salaried, exempt schedule to best execute against customer and internal expectations

Our client, a global leader in digital payments and financial services, is seeking a Creative Marketing Campaign Manager to support a leading enterprise organization in the banking and financial services space. provide operational, project coordination, and tactical marketing support for the Creative Product Marketing team. This role is responsible for helping marketing initiatives move efficiently from intake through execution by supporting marketing operations, project management, stakeholder coordination, and compliance-related processes.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and comfortable working in a large, matrixed organization where processes are not always clearly defined. They should be able to navigate ambiguity, build strong partnerships across teams, and drive work forward while balancing business needs, timelines, and regulatory requirements.

While operational support will be a primary responsibility, this individual may also independently lead smaller tactical marketing initiatives and creative updates from planning through execution.

The Details:

  • Location: Remote within the U.S.
  • Duration: Approximately an 8-month consulting role through Blend with the possibility of extension (must be able to work on Blend’s W2 without sponsorship)
  • Benefits: We do offer benefits to our full-time consultants, including Health, Vision, Dental, 401K plan, Life Insurance, Pretax Commuter Benefits, and an incredibly supportive team cheering you on!

What you’ll do:

Marketing Operations & Workflow Support

  • Manage manual uploads, asset updates, and workflow activities within marketing platforms and content management systems.
  • Support day-to-day marketing execution, including tagging, disclosures, routing, and asset administration.
  • Coordinate and maintain backup documentation required for marketing review, approval, and regulatory processes.
  • Organize project files, asset repositories, and shared resources to ensure documentation is accurate, accessible, and audit-ready.
  • Assist with asset trafficking, launch readiness activities, and workflow coordination across teams.
  • Maintain project trackers, status reports, and operational documentation.

Project Coordination & Tactical Execution

  • Manage project timelines, deliverables, and action items across multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Coordinate work across internal stakeholders, agency partners, creative teams, and business partners.
  • Independently lead smaller tactical marketing projects from intake through completion.
  • Monitor project progress, identify risks and dependencies, and proactively drive resolution.
  • Facilitate stakeholder communication, project updates, meeting follow-ups, and status reporting.
  • Support light tactical execution, including content updates, asset revisions, and implementation of approved changes.

Partner Alignment Support

  • Partner with Legal, Compliance, and business stakeholders to support review and approval processes.
  • Apply approved disclosures, compliance language, and formatting requirements to marketing materials.
  • Prepare and coordinate supporting documentation required for approval processes, including AdTrax submissions and related backup materials.
  • Coordinate implementation of legal and compliance feedback across marketing assets.
  • Experience supporting marketing operations, creative operations, project management, account management, or marketing production teams.
  • Experience working with creative teams, agencies, or marketing organizations.
  • Experience in financial services, banking, insurance, credit card marketing, or another regulated industry is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with compliance review processes, regulated disclosures, and partnering with Legal and Compliance teams.
  • Experience working in large organizations with multiple stakeholder groups and complex approval processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, influence without authority, and move work forward in evolving or undefined processes.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Experience with marketing workflow, content management, and approval platforms such as Knak, Aprimo, AdTrax, or similar tools is a strong plus.
  • Excellent communication, project coordination, and stakeholder management skills.

The starting pay range for this role is $55.00 - $60.00 per hour. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on several factors including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, certifications, training, and location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range and determining factors for compensation are considered for each individual circumstance.
