You can look forward to a range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401K, PTO, commuter benefits, spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage, and EAPs.

A diverse workforce is a strong workforce
To deliver growth at BLEND360 and for our clients, we believe as a Talent Solutions Company, we have a responsibility and unique opportunity to positively impact the workforce. Diversity has played a critical role in our history, our growth, and continues to have a profound impact on our success. We are determined to have equality in the workplace, within our team and as an extension of our clients’ team.

BLEND360 is an equal opportunity employer.

raw.description:
Senior Workday Analyst, HRIS

100% Remote within California, Must reside in California

We are seeking a Senior Workday Analyst, HRIS to join FoundationCCC in its mission of benefiting, supporting, and enhancing the California Community Colleges—the largest and most diverse system of higher education in the nation. Together, we are building stronger communities by getting students and colleges the resources they need to succeed and expanding pathways to economic and social mobility across California. Join us as we continue this important work to uphold the value of community colleges in building a brighter future.


What You’ll Do

This position within Business Systems is responsible for the domain design, configuration, and continuous optimization of Workday as the Foundation's enterprise HRIS platform, spanning HCM, Recruitment, Onboarding, Time Tracking, job classifications, benefits administration, data integrations (I/O), reporting, and payroll.

This position works in close partnership with the Foundation's HRIS team, which provides frontline user education and mid-level functional support. This position serves as the escalation point for complex issues involving major loss of functionality, and as a cross-functional mentor and subject matter expert to the HRIS team, building its capability over time through knowledge transfer. Within the HRIS domain, this position is accountable for platform-level responsibilities: security administration, worktags, data management, vendor tenant access, escalated testing, and vendor and tenant engagement. It partners with Business Systems counterparts on cross-domain items such as worktags. The Foundation's Workday Platform Architect holds full, platform-wide system oversight across HCM and Finance; this position escalates cross-domain or platform-wide architecture decisions to that role rather than carrying them directly.

Under general direction, this position serves as a subject matter expert and internal consultant, exercising independent judgment and discretion to evaluate platform capabilities, determine appropriate technical approaches, and advise HRIS and Business Systems leadership on system design, risk, and roadmap decisions. This position does not supervise staff, but it carries significant cross-functional influence and depends on strong consensus-building skills to align HRIS, IT, and Business Systems stakeholders around shared solutions. Because Workday HRIS touches sensitive employee, compensation, and payroll data across the entire organization, this person must be skilled at building alignment across teams with competing priorities and earning trust without formal authority over the teams whose processes the platform supports.


  • Workday HRIS Platform and Domain Design
    • Deep, hands-on expertise in Workday HCM (or a comparable top-tier enterprise HRIS/HCM platform), including recruitment, onboarding, job classifications and position management, benefits administration, reporting, and payroll.
  • Escalation, Testing, and Team Enablement
    • Leads feature updates and functionality testing, provides troubleshooting and escalation support to the Payroll and Finance teams
    • Serves as a cross-functional mentor and subject matter expert to HRIS support staff, advising on Workday best practices and troubleshooting techniques, supporting resolution of escalated issues, and leading knowledge transfer that builds and maintains internal subject matter expertise, reducing the volume of escalations over time.
  • Security, Data, and Vendor Management
    • Builds and maintains complex integrations (e.g., Workday Studio, EIBs, core connectors) within the HCM domain, built to the integration and security standards set by the Workday Platform Architect, supporting HR, benefits, and payroll data flows.
  • Digital Transformation and Stakeholder Engagement
    • Ability to translate complex technical concepts for HRIS and Payroll support staff and non-technical stakeholders.
    • A consensus-building advisor able to work across HR, IT, and Business Systems, aligning stakeholders with competing priorities and earning trust without direct authority.

Attributes for Success

  • Bachelor's degree in business, information systems, human resources, or a related field, OR an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 7+ years of experience administering, configuring, or designing Workday HCM (or a comparable top-tier enterprise HRIS/HCM platform), including demonstrated experience operating at an advanced configuration level.
  • Experience with a net-new Workday HCM implementation, or a significant re-engineering of an existing Workday HCM tenant, is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience across multiple HR functional areas (HCM, recruitment, onboarding, benefits administration, payroll, reporting).
  • SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or another HR certification is preferred but not required.
  • Project Management certification (e.g., PMP, CAPM) is a plus but not required.
  • Experience in an education or nonprofit environment is a plus.
  • FoundationCCC blends the impact of a non-profit, the culture of an entrepreneurial start-up, and the scale of a state agency
  • We’re recruiting for mission-driven, passionate, equity-minded individuals with a strong desire to impact and change people’s lives for the better
  • Our work holds great weight and responsibility, and the opportunity to impact the lives of millions of individuals in California
  • Innovation, creativity, collaboration, and entrepreneurship are encouraged as employees work to achieve organizational goals
  • Team members are hired for their expertise in niche areas across our areas of impact and higher education overall, and for their knowledge of business, philanthropy, technology, communications, and more.

What we Offer

FoundationCCC is fully committed to a “remote-first” philosophy, and recruits and hires talent across the state in fully remote positions, where virtual work is possible. Our headquarters are located in Downtown Sacramento, just blocks from California’s State Capitol.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, generous PTO, and paid holidays
  • Medical, dental, and vision plans, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts (HSA), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Wellness offerings
  • CalPERS retirement program and optional 403(b) and 457 Retirement plans
  • Carrot reproductive health and fertility support
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness certified employer

To see the full job description, please email .

$120,000.00 - $125,000.00

Final salary and rates are based on education, experience, skills relevant to the role, and internal equity.

Company Overview:

PartsBase Inc. is the world's largest online Aviation Marketplace and Community. Our global community is comprised of over 6,500 companies accessing our technology in over 140+ countries & territories. We work with some of the biggest brands in aviation including Delta, Northrop Gruman, AvAir, Heico, Chevron, Air France Industries, and Air Australia.

PartsBase offers a FULLY remote environment where one can work at the forefront of where the aviation business meets technology. Imagine getting to work with peers worldwide, implementing business technology projects that challenge the boundaries.

Life at PartsBase:

One of the top benefits of working at PartsBase is the culture. We are a TEAM-focused organization, and everyone celebrates each other's successes. Our inclusive culture welcomes all employees and values their unique contributions to our success. Our clients tell us time and time again that our people set us apart from the competition. We naturally strive to hire the very best talent. The ideal candidate is a motivated, well-organized individual who has a deep understanding of prospecting and developing strong relationships with customers.

Opportunity Overview:

Are you passionate about SaaS, and ready to grow your sales career? We are looking for a driven and dynamic Account Executive to help us expand our footprint. As a key player on our Customer Acquisition team, you’ll take the lead in selling PartsBase memberships and promoting digital advertising and PBExpo, our premier annual tradeshow. With a strong product, comprehensive training, and a supportive team behind you, you’ll use consultative selling strategies to identify prospects’ needs and show them how PartsBase delivers unmatched value and results.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive Sales Growth: Proactively engage companies across the aviation, aerospace, and defense sectors via email, phone, video calls, and networking platforms.

  • Build Relationships: Cultivate strong, trust-based relationships with potential clients through active listening, consultative selling, and tailored solutions.

  • Showcase Value: Conduct compelling virtual presentations to demonstrate how PartsBase improves procurement processes and drives growth.

  • Promote Advertising Opportunities: Educate prospects about advertising on the PartsBase platform and at PBExpo, emphasizing ROI and brand exposure.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with marketing, customer success, and product teams to align sales strategies with business goals and share market insights.

  • Continuously Learn: Stay up-to-date on industry trends, prospect feedback, and product developments to refine your approach and deepen your expertise.

Skills and Qualifications:

  • 2-5 years of sales experience.

  • Outstanding presentation, communication, and negotiation skills.

  • Consultative, problem-solving mindset with strong business acumen.

  • Self-motivated and results-driven, with a passion for helping businesses grow.

  • Adaptable, coachable, and eager to continuously learn.

  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Benefits Offered

  • Medical benefits to keep you healthy and secure.

  • Paid time off to recharge and enjoy life outside of work.

  • Competitive base salary + lucrative commissions.

  • Comprehensive training to ensure you’re set up for success.

  • Clear career growth paths and development opportunities.

  • Be part of a fast-growing, innovative company that’s shaping the future of aviation commerce.

Why Join PartsBase?

At PartsBase, you're not just joining another sales team, you're joining a company that has spent 30+ years revolutionizing the aerospace and defense industry through cutting-edge technology, powerful data intelligence, and the world's leading aviation marketplace. Every conversation you have and every relationship you build helps aviation and defense organizations around the globe operate more efficiently and make smarter decisions.

What's In It For You?

• Accelerate Your Career – Learn from experienced sales leaders who are invested in your growth and success.

• Make a Real Impact – Sell industry-leading solutions that support some of the world's most important aerospace and defense organizations.

• Win as a Team – Join a high-energy, collaborative culture where achievements are celebrated and success is shared.

• Work Remote, Forever– Enjoy the flexibility of being part of a fully remote company. Remote work isn't a temporary perk—it's a core part of who we are and will remain a permanent part of our culture.

• Work with Innovation – Gain exposure to cutting-edge technology, AI-driven tools, and one of the largest aviation data platforms in the world.

• Grow with a Market Leader – Build your career at a company trusted by aviation professionals worldwide for more than three decades.

Enjoy More of Your Weekend!

We value work-life balance, which is why our team wraps up one hour early every Friday to get a head start on the weekend.

Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

Build Kong’s India marketing engine from the ground up.

The opportunity

Kong is the AI connectivity company. We help engineering teams manage, secure, and scale the APIs and AI traffic that power modern businesses.

India represents a significant growth opportunity for Kong. We’re looking for a Field Marketing Manager to build our marketing presence in the market from the ground up—turning strategic priorities into programs that create demand, accelerate pipeline, and establish Kong as a leader in API and AI connectivity.

This is a builder’s role. There’s no established playbook, inherited marketing engine, or existing team to lean on. You’ll have the ownership to define the strategy, make the bets, build the programs, and prove what works.

You’ll partner closely with Sales, global marketing, and channel partners to bring Kong’s story to India’s enterprise technology leaders. You’ll be expected to think strategically, execute hands-on, and connect every marketing investment to measurable business outcomes.

Your mission: build a repeatable, scalable marketing engine that drives growth for Kong in India.

What you’ll do

Own the India marketing strategy

  • Define the regional marketing strategy, priorities, and investment plan in alignment with India Sales and global marketing.

  • Identify the industries, enterprise accounts, and buyer segments with the greatest growth potential.

  • Turn market insights into focused programs that generate pipeline and accelerate revenue.

  • Make deliberate choices about where to invest—and where not to.

Build and execute account-based marketing

  • Partner with Sales to develop and prioritize target account lists, buying groups, and account-specific growth strategies.

  • Design and execute ABM programs that engage decision-makers, build buying-group awareness, and create opportunities within strategic accounts.

  • Coordinate campaigns, executive engagement, content, and field activities around account priorities.

  • Measure account engagement, opportunity creation, pipeline influence, and progression through the sales cycle.

Create demand that converts

  • Build integrated demand generation programs across digital, content, email, events, and partner channels.

  • Translate Kong’s global messaging into locally relevant campaigns that resonate with India’s enterprise technology buyers.

  • Work with Sales to define lead qualification, routing, follow-up SLAs, and conversion targets.

  • Continuously optimize programs based on pipeline contribution, conversion rates, and cost efficiency.

Build the India events engine

  • Develop an events strategy spanning executive roundtables, technical workshops, webinars, industry conferences, and flagship experiences.

  • Create programs that bring together engineering leaders, enterprise decision-makers, developers, and strategic customers.

  • Own event planning, audience acquisition, execution, follow-up, and performance measurement.

  • Build a repeatable events model that prioritizes meaningful engagement and commercial outcomes over attendance numbers alone.

Turn partnerships into growth

  • Work with channel and technology partners to develop joint demand generation and co-marketing programs.

  • Equip partners with localized content, campaigns, event resources, and sales enablement.

  • Identify opportunities to extend Kong’s reach through strategic ecosystems and industry relationships.

Establish Kong’s presence in India

  • Adapt global brand campaigns and content for local market needs while maintaining consistency with Kong’s positioning.

  • Build relationships with relevant industry communities, technology leaders, and enterprise decision-makers.

  • Develop programs that strengthen awareness, credibility, and consideration among Kong’s target audiences.

Own the budget and prove impact

  • Manage the India field marketing budget, allocating investment against clear business priorities.

  • Establish dashboards and reporting that connect marketing activity to qualified pipeline, opportunity progression, and revenue outcomes.

  • Share performance transparently, including what worked, what didn’t, and what should change.

  • Build a continuous improvement culture grounded in data, experimentation, and accountability.

What you’ll bring

  • A builder’s mindset. You’ve built a marketing function, regional program, or demand engine from scratch—not just operated an established one.

  • B2B technology marketing experience. You understand how to market complex technology solutions to enterprise buyers and translate technical value into business impact.

  • Strong ABM and demand generation expertise. You know how to prioritize accounts, engage buying groups, generate demand, and build programs that contribute to pipeline.

  • A track record in high-growth environments. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities, limited resources, and the need to move quickly.

  • Cross-functional leadership. You can align Sales, global marketing, partners, and regional stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

  • Events that deliver results. You know how to design experiences that build relationships, create opportunities, and justify the investment.

  • Commercial and analytical rigor. You understand pipeline metrics, conversion rates, campaign performance, and marketing efficiency—and know how to act on the data.

  • Deep knowledge of India’s enterprise technology landscape. You understand the accounts, industries, buying dynamics, and ecosystems that matter.

  • Clear, adaptable communication. You can build credibility with engineers, executives, sales teams, and marketing leaders alike.

What will set you apart

  • Experience marketing APIs, cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, cybersecurity, or AI technologies.

  • Experience building channel marketing or partner-led demand generation programs.

  • Established relationships across India’s enterprise technology, financial services, or global capability center (GCC) ecosystem.

  • Experience working in a global, matrixed organization while building programs tailored to a regional market.

About Kong:

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit .

Speaker Programs Manager

Reports To: Associate Director, Speaker Programs

Department: Corporate Marketing

Location: Remote

Position Summary

Natera is seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Speaker Programs Manager to support day to day operations within the Speakers Program Office.

Reporting to the Associate Director, Speaker Programs, the Speaker Programs Manager will serve as an operational resource for field representatives, speaker faculty, and cross-functional partners. This role will support speaker program operations:including nomination, contracting, compliance, honorarium and expense processing, and payment.

The ideal candidate brings prior experience in speaker bureau execution, HCP engagement, or customer success supporting diagnostics, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or medical device organizations, and thrives in a high-volume, detail-driven environment.

Key Responsibilities

Operations & Compliance

  • Manage speaker programs operations for assigned business unit(s), ensuring consistency, compliance, and operational rigor at every stage.
  • Maintain accurate program records, documentation, and audit-ready files in accordance with company SOPs and regulatory requirements.
  • Proactively identify gaps or risks in program workflows and escalate issues to the Associate Director in a timely manner.
  • Serve as the go-to operational resource for all speaker program activity, providing real-time status visibility to internal stakeholders.
  • Act as the primary liaison between Area Marketing Managers (AMMs) and the Compliance team, managing escalation communications on program-related issues.
  • Track open compliance issues and escalations through to resolution, maintaining complete documentation of all communications and outcomes.
  • Support audit readiness by ensuring all speaker program files are complete, accurate, and organized per compliance and Legal requirements.

Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for field representatives (AMMs and sales teams) and physician speakers on questions related to program requirements, timelines, status, and compliance obligations.
  • Respond to inquiries promptly and accurately, applying a thorough understanding of program policies, SOPs, and applicable healthcare regulations.
  • Contribute to onboarding and training materials to help new field personnel and speakers understand program requirements and workflows.

Honorarium & Expense Management

  • Manage honorarium and expense reimbursement lifecycle: collect, review, and submit required documentation for payment processing.
  • Submit approved payment requests to Accounts Payable in accordance with established deadlines and contracted payment timelines.
  • Track payment status for each speaker engagement and proactively escalate any delays or discrepancies to Finance and the Associate Director.

Speaker Nomination & Contracting Process

  • Oversee speaker nomination and contracting process, coordinating across commercial and medical stakeholders to move nominees through vetting, onboarding, and credentialing steps efficiently.
  • Manage contracting workflows in partnership with Legal and Compliance, ensuring fair market value (FMV) compliance, proper documentation, and timely execution of all speaker agreements.
  • Serve as the operational coordinator for speaker onboarding and annual recertification processes, ensuring all requirements are met on time.

Reporting & Operational Support

  • Maintain and update program tracking tools, dashboards, and databases to support accurate and timely reporting on speaker utilization, payment status, and program activity.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • 3–5 years of experience in speaker bureau execution, HCP engagement, or customer success.
  • Knowledge around healthcare compliance requirements, including HCP contracting, fair market value (FMV), and industry codes of conduct (PhRMA, AdvaMed).
  • Experience supporting high-volume administrative workflows with strong attention to detail and the ability to juggle multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with physician speakers, field sales representatives, and cross-functional partners.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with a track record of meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with honorarium and expense reimbursement workflows and Accounts Payable coordination.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce.com (SFDC) or similar CRM platforms for program tracking and reporting.
  • Knowledge of speaker bureau management platforms and event management tools.
  • Experience in a remote-first, cross-functional work environment.
The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA
$85,000—$110,000 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

raw.description:
Who we are

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

As an Information Security Senior Specialist, you will lead and scale major elements of our security governance in a regulated fintech environment. You’ll own complex, cross-functional GRC domains (e.g., ISMS/ISO 27001 at scale, regulatory readiness, enterprise technology risk, third-party risk for critical vendors, compliance in key partnerships), drive measurable improvement in control effectiveness, and act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders.

What you’ll do

  • Information Security Operating Model & GRC Ownership: Own and evolve one or more GRC domains end-to-end (e.g., ISMS operations, BCM, risk governance), including strategy, annual plan, cadences, and success metrics. Drive control rationalization and proportionality: tighten controls for critical/regulated assets and streamline low-risk areas to ensure an efficient, risk-aligned posture.

  • Risk Management & Strategic Decision Support: Facilitate and challenge high-impact risk assessments (new products, major architectural changes, critical vendors), ensuring consistency and defensible rationale. Drive risk treatment at scale: align owners, negotiate timelines, track commitments, and escalate where residual risk remains above appetite.

  • Audit, Assurance & Continuous Control Testing: Lead complex audits and assessments end-to-end (multi-entity, regulator-facing), including readiness, walkthroughs, and remediation. Design and run a risk-based control testing program to identify weaknesses and drive durable remediation (process fixes, automation, tooling) while translating regulatory requirements into structured internal work programs.

  • Third-Party Risk & Critical Supplier Oversight: Set due diligence depth and ongoing monitoring requirements for critical suppliers (e.g., cloud, payments, identity, SaaS); partner with Procurement/Legal on security contract requirements to ensure enforceable obligations and measurable oversight across the supply chain.

  • Enablement & Leadership through Others: Mentor Specialists, Associates, and Senior Associates; set quality standards for documentation, evidence, and stakeholder engagement. Act as a “GRC translator” for engineering and operations teams, helping them implement requirements efficiently and consistently across the organization.

Who you are

  • Typically 6–10 years of experience in information security GRC, audit/assurance, risk management, compliance, or adjacent security roles.
  • Proven track record leading audits/assessments and driving remediation across multiple teams and systems.
  • Strong working knowledge of ISO 27001 and DORA (and/or SOC 2 / PCI DSS / NIST) with ability to design controls, define evidence, and test effectiveness.
  • Strong understanding of technology risk across cloud, IAM, SDLC governance, incident management, vulnerability management, logging/monitoring, and third-party risk.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to produce executive-ready materials and auditor-facing narratives.

What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
  • Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
  • Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
  • Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
  • Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
  • Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
  • Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
  • Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
  • Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
  • Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
  • Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

.…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

raw.description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Records Clerk to support pre-litigation operations by managing the retrieval, organization, and maintenance of medical and legal records. The ideal candidate will possess strong administrative skills, the ability to handle confidential information, and experience working in a fast-paced legal environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Request and obtain medical records from hospitals, clinics, healthcare providers, DHCS, and CMS health insurance lien departments

  • Request, obtain, and follow up on police reports from multiple jurisdictions

  • Track outstanding record requests and ensure timely retrieval of documents

  • Organize, scan, and index medical records into internal databases for easy access and searchability

  • Conduct case audits to confirm all required medical records and documentation are complete and accurate

  • Maintain strict compliance with HIPAA regulations and firm confidentiality policies

  • Support Pre-Litigation Assistants with case documentation and records management

  • Maintain accurate records, logs, and status updates within the firm’s systems

  • Communicate professionally with healthcare providers, agencies, and internal staff regarding records requests and follow-ups

Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of Records Clerk experience or equivalent administrative experience

  • Strong confidentiality and professionalism when handling client information

  • Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills

  • Superior time management and follow-through abilities

  • Strong verbal, written, and listening communication skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment

  • Consistent attendance and reliability to support team productivity and efficiency

  • Ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines simultaneously

  • Knowledge of personal injury law or prior legal experience preferred

  • Experience with case management software such as Casepeer or Filevine preferred

raw.description:
Job Description:

Toppan Merrill is a global technology leader committed to simplifying the complexity of regulatory disclosure and communications. Our industry leading technology is backed by what we are best known for: unmatched market expertise and unparalleled customer service. Toppan Merrill is a leading partner for the financial, legal, health and capital markets.


At Toppan Merrill, you will find a culture that will encourage, empower and challenge your unique qualities to enable you to reach your full potential. Toppan Merrill leadership is committed to inspire and help you reach that potential. You'll work with dynamic colleagues, experts in their fields, who are eager to share their knowledge with you.


Learn more at . About Toppan Merrill

The Platform Manager – Microsoft Dynamics 365 is responsible for the strategic direction, prioritization, development, and ongoing optimization of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform. This position serves as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technology teams, translating business needs into scalable technology solutions that improve processes, user experience, and organizational effectiveness.

The Product Owner maintains the product roadmap and backlog, establishes priorities based on business value, and partners with cross-functional teams throughout the solution development lifecycle. This role requires a strong understanding of business processes and Microsoft Dynamics 365 capabilities to ensure platform investments deliver measurable value while maintaining appropriate governance, security, data integrity, and system sustainability.

Key Responsibilities & Outcomes [

  • Own and maintain the Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM product vision, roadmap, and backlog, ensuring priorities align with business objectives and organizational strategy.
  • Partner with business leaders, end users, IT, and other stakeholders to understand business processes, identify needs, and define opportunities for platform enhancements.
  • Translate business requirements into clearly defined epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements for development and configuration teams.
  • Prioritize product features, enhancements, defects, and technical improvements based on business value, user impact, risk, dependencies, and available resources.
  • Serve as the primary functional decision-maker for the Dynamics 365 platform, providing direction and clarification to developers, administrators, analysts, architects, and implementation partners.
  • Lead and participate in product discovery, backlog refinement, sprint planning, solution demonstrations, user acceptance testing, release planning, and post-implementation reviews.
  • Evaluate existing processes and system functionality to identify opportunities for automation, standardization, simplification, and improved user experience.
  • Partner with technical teams to support effective platform configuration, integrations, workflows, data management, reporting, security roles, and related Dynamics 365 capabilities.
  • Establish and monitor product performance measures, adoption, user feedback, and business outcomes to evaluate solution effectiveness and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate product priorities, roadmaps, release plans, system changes, dependencies, risks, and implementation impacts.
  • Partner with business leaders, training resources, and subject matter experts to support change management, documentation, communications, training, and user adoption.
  • Maintain knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Microsoft Power Platform capabilities and product roadmaps, evaluating new functionality and emerging technologies for potential business value.
  • Ensure solutions comply with established standards for platform governance, security, data integrity, documentation, change management, regulatory requirements, and system sustainability.
  • Ability to interact with internal/external clients/customers in a professional manner.
  • Miscellaneous duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience implementing and supporting Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions or comparable CRM solutions in a service organization.
  • Demonstrated functional leadership experience working with Microsoft Dynamics 365 in a complex business or enterprise environment.
  • Experience with Power Platform tools (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI)
  • Strong understanding of Dataverse and API integrations.
  • Experience developing and managing platform roadmaps, backlogs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and business requirements.
  • Strong understanding of business process analysis, process improvement, system configuration, data management, integrations, workflows, and reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, manage competing priorities, and influence outcomes without direct authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

We understand that your skills deserve recognition. That's why we offer a competitive pay scale ranging from $115-160k annually, based on experience and expertise. We believe in compensating our dedicated team members fairly for their hard work and commitment. Please note that actual salaries may vary within, above, or below this range based on factors such as education, training, experience, professional achievement, business needs, and location.

Toppan Merrill strives to provide our employees and loved ones with competitive benefits including:

  • Enhanced Medical, Dental, Vision and Life insurance for employees and dependents
  • Employer Contribution to 401K
  • Paid time off including vacation, sick, community involvement, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays.
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid community involvement/volunteer days
  • Wellness Resources and Employee Assistance Programming

Toppan Merrill is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified individuals, including qualified women, minorities, individuals with disabilities and veterans, are encouraged to apply.

raw.description:
Horace Mann is seeking an experienced and technically skilled Large Loss Adjuster to manage high-exposure homeowner property claims, including complex and litigated files. This role requires advanced investigative expertise, strong negotiation skills, and the ability to handle significant financial exposures while delivering exceptional service to policyholders and business partners.

The ideal candidate thrives in complex claim environments, demonstrates strong business acumen, and brings deep knowledge of policy interpretation, dwelling estimating, and litigation management.

Key Responsibilities

Complex Claims Handling

  • Manage and investigate large loss and high-exposure homeowner claims, including litigation files and claims involving public adjusters and attorneys.
  • Verify coverage, interpret policy language, and determine liability and scope of damages.
  • Evaluate claim facts and damage estimates to move claims toward appropriate and timely resolution.
  • Apply in-depth knowledge of homeowners policies and jurisdictional documents to assigned claims.

Investigation & Damage Assessment

  • Conduct on-site inspections as needed to evaluate damages and determine loss exposure.
  • Investigate origin and cause of high-exposure claims, coordinating with insureds, claimants, agents, attorneys, contractors, experts, Special Investigation Unit (SIU), public officials, and other adjusters.
  • Identify prior losses and recognize potential environmental exposures.
  • Reconcile contractor and mitigation estimates and collaborate with vendors to determine appropriate damage valuations.
  • Demonstrate advanced proficiency in Xactimate, including preparation of large loss and total loss estimates (Level 3 certification encouraged).

Negotiation & Resolution

  • Negotiate settlements with insureds, attorneys, and public adjusters in accordance with company best practices.
  • Manage period of restoration for ALE (Additional Living Expense) and Loss of Rent claims.
  • Interpret and apply policies, leases, by-laws, declarations, and contract coverages as they apply to all parties involved.
  • Maintain transparent and timely communication with all stakeholders throughout the claim lifecycle.

Catastrophe & Collaboration

  • Provide assistance during catastrophe events as needed.
  • Participate in special projects and consult on process improvement initiatives.
  • Actively engage in mentoring and training of other claims professionals.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 5–7 years of dwelling estimating experience preferred, with demonstrated sustained technical performance.
  • Proven experience handling homeowner property losses of $50,000 or greater.
  • Strong claims and business acumen with litigation experience.
  • Advanced knowledge of homeowner policy interpretation and coverage analysis.
  • Demonstrated Xactimate expertise; encouraged to pursue Level 3 certification.
  • Ability to work effectively with vendors regarding damage determination and estimate reconciliation.
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment using claims systems and telephony platforms.
  • Maintain and obtain required state adjuster licenses; ability to comply with all jurisdictional regulatory requirements.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, analytical, and decision-making skills.

Additional Information

  • Must obtain and maintain required state adjuster licenses.
  • Periodic travel may be required for inspections or catastrophe support.

Salary Range:

$76,600.00 - $106,450.00 + bonus

Salary is commensurate to experience, location, etc.

Horace Mann was founded in 1945 by two Springfield, Illinois, teachers who saw a need for quality, affordable auto insurance for teachers. Since then, we’ve broadened our mission to helping all educators protect what they have today and prepare for a successful tomorrow. And with our broadened mission has come corporate growth: We serve more than 4,100 school districts nationwide, we’re publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (symbol: HMN) and we have more than $12 billion in assets.

We’re motivated by the fact that educators take care of our children’s future, and we believe they deserve someone to look after theirs. We help educators identify their financial goals and develop plans to achieve them. This includes insurance to protect what they have today and financial products to help them prepare for their future. Our tailored offerings include special rates and benefits for educators.

EOE/Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status

For applicants that are California residents, please review our California Consumer Privacy Notice

All applicants should review our Horace Mann Privacy Policy

raw.title: Founding Harness Engineer - AI Agents (US only)
raw.excerpt: We're hiring for our partner company, an early-stage startup building an AI coworker: an agent that lives inside a team's everyday tools and actually gets work done.
raw.description:
We're hiring for our partner company, an early-stage startup building an AI coworker: an agent that lives inside a team's everyday tools and actually gets work done. They need a senior Founding Harness Engineer to build the layer that makes it behave. How it pulls in context, when it speaks up, which tool it reaches for, when it stops and asks permission, and how it finishes a long task without falling over halfway. You'll join a seasoned founder and a founding team who spent years building technology in the services world. They watched clients ask for agents long before anyone could deliver them, so they know where the real demand is. The role starts as a contract, with a path to full-time once it's clearly working for both sides. It is remote-friendly anywhere in the US, and hours that overlap with Pacific time will make the founder very happy. If you've shipped tool-using agents to real users and want to build the next one from day one, read on.

Our Culture & Values (read before applying)

We move fast. We take ownership. We work with AI, not against it. And we expect everyone to bring ideas, not wait for instructions.

There are no daily checklists, no micromanagement, and no corporate politics. You get autonomy, trust, and a small team that's always ready to help you grow. Here, impact matters more than titles, and curiosity matters more than seniority.

If you want to level up fast and see your work in real users' hands - welcome aboard.

Responsibilities

  • Build the agent runtime: context, tool choice, approval waits, and knowing when to act, ask, or stay quiet
  • Write and keep tuning the system prompts. Proactive is great. Spamming the team channel is not
  • Own the eval and regression harness. Prompt changes are code, so they get tested like code
  • Make long-running work survive interruptions, retries, and the occasional flaky API
  • Put the guardrails in: approval gates for risky actions and strict separation between customers' data
  • Work directly with the founder and early users, and turn what you hear into shipped behavior

Requirements

  • You’ve shipped tool-using LLM agents to real users in production. Demos and prompt wrappers don’t count
  • Good instincts for agent initiative, and the test results to back them up
  • Hands-on experience building eval and regression suites for LLM behavior
  • You understand safe tool execution, prompt injection, and multi-tenant data risk
  • Solid backend skills in Python or TypeScript (async jobs, retries, state)
  • You take a fuzzy problem from prototype to production and can explain the tradeoffs along the way
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; you can explain a tradeoff to a founder or a user without a whiteboard

Nice to have

  • MCP, or integrations with tools like Slack, Gmail, Notion, or Linear
  • Eval and tracing tools such as Braintrust, Langfuse, or LangSmith
  • You’ve been an early engineer at a startup before and still liked it

Benefits

  • A founding seat. You own the agent harness and shape how the product behaves
  • Competitive compensation + equity
  • A direct line to the founder and early users, with no layers in between
  • Remote anywhere in the US, ideally keeping hours that overlap with Pacific time
  • The tools and models you need to do the job properly
  • A small, experienced team that trusts you to run your own work
